8.8.24.h.s: brāhmaṇāccham̐sicamase grahasaṃpātam avanayati na pratiprasthātā bhakṣayati /
8.8.24.h.d: ब्राह्मणाच्छम्̐सिचमसे ग्रहसंपातम् अवनयति न प्रतिप्रस्थाता भक्षयति ।
8.8.24.h.m: He pours the residue of the cup into the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's cup; the pratiprasthātṛ does not consume.

8.8.24.i.s: indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti tṛtīye grahaṇasādanau saṃnamati /
8.8.24.i.d: इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा \\ इति तृतीये ग्रहणसादनौ संनमति ।
8.8.24.i.m: With "for Indra and Agni, you", he adapts the drawing and placing down at the third.

8.8.24.j.m: He does not touch the pot.

8.8.24.k.s: acchāvākacamasamukhyām̐ś camasān unnaya \ sarvam̐ rājānam unnaya mātirīrico daśābhiḥ kalaśau mṛṣṭvā nyubja \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
8.8.24.k.d: अच्छावाकचमसमुख्याम्̐श् चमसान् उन्नय \ सर्वम्̐ राजानम् उन्नय मातिरीरिचो दशाभिः कलशौ मृष्ट्वा न्युब्ज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
8.8.24.k.m: He directs: "Draw the cups headed by the acchāvāka's cup; draw all the king [soma], do not leave any behind; having wiped the two tubs with the fringed filter, invert them!"

8.8.24.l.s: acchāvākacamasamukhyām̐ś camasān unnayati sarvam̐ rājānam unnayati nātirecayati /
8.8.24.l.d: अच्छावाकचमसमुख्याम्̐श् चमसान् उन्नयति सर्वम्̐ राजानम् उन्नयति नातिरेचयति ।
8.8.24.l.m: He draws the cups headed by the acchāvāka's cup; he draws all the king [soma], he does not leave any behind.

8.8.24.m.m: Having wiped the two tubs with the fringed filter, he inverts them.

8.8.24.n.s: acchāvākacamase grahasaṃpātam avanayati na pratiprasthātā bhakṣayati /
8.8.24.n.d: अच्छावाकचमसे ग्रहसंपातम् अवनयति न प्रतिप्रस्थाता भक्षयति ।
8.8.24.n.m: He pours the residue of the cup into the acchāvāka's cup; the pratiprasthātṛ does not consume.

8.8.24.o.s: agniḥ prātaḥsavane pātv asmān iti sam̐sthite juhoti /
8.8.24.o.d: अग्निः प्रातःसवने पात्व् अस्मान् इति सम्̐स्थिते जुहोति ।
8.8.24.o.m: When it has concluded, he offers with: "May Agni protect us at the morning pressing".

8.8.24.r.m: The morning pressing concludes, the morning pressing.

9.1.1.a.m: Beginning with the pressing, the midday pressing is extended.

9.1.1.b.m: The procedure for it is explained by [that of] the morning pressing.

9.1.1.c.m: There are no [cups] for two deities, no season cups, no Aindrāgna or Vaiśvadeva [cups], and no spoon-oblations.

9.1.1.d.m: Having poured out [water] from the vasatīvarī waters, he makes the nigrābhyā waters.

9.1.1.f.m: He hands the soma turban to the grāvastut.

9.1.1.g.m: They press while chanting together, "Here, here!"

9.1.1.h.s: uttamasya paryāyasya madhyame 'bhiṣave bṛhad bṛhat \\ ity abhiṣunvanti /
9.1.1.h.d: उत्तमस्य पर्यायस्य मध्यमे ऽभिषवे बृहद् बृहत् \\ इत्य् अभिषुन्वन्ति ।
9.1.1.h.m: At the middle pressing of the final turn, they press with: "Great, great!"

9.1.1.i.m: At the final pressing, when the King [Soma] has been well gathered,

9.1.1.j.s: devā grāvāṇa indur indra ity avādiṣur \ endram acucyavuḥ paramasyāḥ parāvatas \\ āsmāt sadhasthād oror antarikṣāt \\ ā subhūtam asuṣavur \ brahmavarcasaṃ ma āsuṣavuḥ \ samare rakṣām̐sy avadhiṣur \ apahataṃ brahmajyasya \\ iti pratiprasthātā grāvṇo 'numodate /
9.1.1.j.d: देवा ग्रावाण इन्दुर् इन्द्र इत्य् अवादिषुर् \ एन्द्रम् अचुच्यवुः परमस्याः परावतस् \\ आस्मात् सधस्थाद् ओरोर् अन्तरिक्षात् \\ आ सुभूतम् असुषवुर् \ ब्रह्मवर्चसं म आसुषवुः \ समरे रक्षाम्̐स्य् अवधिषुर् \ अपहतं ब्रह्मज्यस्य \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता ग्राव्णो ऽनुमोदते ।
9.1.1.j.m: with the mantra: "The divine pressing stones have sounded, 'Drop, Indra!' They have brought down Indra from the highest distance, from this common abode, from the wide intermediate space; they have pressed well what has come into being; they have pressed out spiritual luster for me; they have slain the rakṣases in the encounter; crushed is the oppressor of the brahman," the pratiprasthātā applauds the pressing stones.

9.1.1.k.m: Some teach the apportioning of the savanīya oblations at this point.

9.1.1.l.s: dhārāgrahakāle śukrāmanthināv evāgre gṛhītvāgrayaṇaṃ tisṛbhyo dhārābhyo gṛhṇāty ādhavanīyāt tṛtīyāṃ dhārāṃ karoty ukthyaṃ gṛhītvā /
9.1.1.l.d: धाराग्रहकाले शुक्रामन्थिनाव् एवाग्रे गृहीत्वाग्रयणं तिसृभ्यो धाराभ्यो गृह्णात्य् आधवनीयात् तृतीयां धारां करोत्य् उक्थ्यं गृहीत्वा ।
9.1.1.l.m: At the time of taking the continuous stream, having first drawn only the Śukra and Manthin [cups], he draws the āgrayaṇa [cup] from three streams; having drawn the ukthya [cup], he makes the third stream from the ādhavanīya trough.

9.1.1.m.s: ṛtupātrābhyāṃ marutvatīyau gṛhṇītas \\ marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānam iti svena pātreṇādhvaryuḥ pūrvaṃ gṛhṇāti marutvām̐ indra vṛṣabho raṇāya \\ iti svena pātreṇa pratiprasthātottaram /
9.1.1.m.d: ऋतुपात्राभ्यां मरुत्वतीयौ गृह्णीतस् \\ मरुत्वन्तं वृषभं वावृधानम् इति स्वेन पात्रेणाध्वर्युः पूर्वं गृह्णाति मरुत्वाम्̐ इन्द्र वृषभो रणाय \\ इति स्वेन पात्रेण प्रतिप्रस्थातोत्तरम् ।
9.1.1.m.m: With two season cups, the two draw the two Marutvatīya cups: with his own cup, the adhvaryu draws the first with, "The bull accompanied by the Maruts, increasing..."; with his own cup, the pratiprasthātā draws the second with, "Indra accompanied by the Maruts, the bull for battle..."

9.1.1.n.s: gṛhītvā rājānam atipāvayati yāvantaṃ mādhyaṃdināya svanāyāptaṃ manyate /
9.1.1.n.d: गृहीत्वा राजानम् अतिपावयति यावन्तं माध्यंदिनाय स्वनायाप्तं मन्यते ।
9.1.1.n.m: Having drawn [them], he strains across the King [Soma], as much as he considers sufficient for the midday pressing.

9.1.1.o.m: When the stream ceases, having squeezed out the strainer, he sets it down.

9.1.1.p.m: The pouring of the ekadhana waters into the ādhavanīya trough has been explained.

9.1.1.q.s: pavamānagrahān kalaśāñ śukrāmanthināv āgrayaṇam ukthyaṃ ca grahāvakāśair upasthāya niḥsarpantaḥ samanvārabhante /
9.1.1.q.d: पवमानग्रहान् कलशाञ् शुक्रामन्थिनाव् आग्रयणम् उक्थ्यं च ग्रहावकाशैर् उपस्थाय निःसर्पन्तः समन्वारभन्ते ।
9.1.1.q.m: Having stood by the pavamāna cups, the jars, the Śukra and Manthin [cups], the āgrayaṇa, and the ukthya with the cup-presence verses, creeping forth, they touch in line.

9.1.1.r.s: vaipruṣān saptahotāraṃ ca hutvā mādhyaṃdinaṃ pavamānam̐ sarpanti tasya bahiṣpavamānena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ //
9.1.1.r.d: वैप्रुषान् सप्तहोतारं च हुत्वा माध्यंदिनं पवमानम्̐ सर्पन्ति तस्य बहिष्पवमानेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः ॥
9.1.1.r.m: Having offered the drop-oblations and the saptahotṛ [mantra], they creep to the midday pavamāna; the procedure for it is explained by [that of] the bahiṣpavamāna.

9.1.2.a.s: traiṣṭubhaḥ panthās \ rudrā devatā \\ avṛkeṇāparipareṇa pathā svasti rudrān aśīya \\ iti mantram̐ saṃnamati /
9.1.2.a.d: त्रैष्टुभः पन्थास् \ रुद्रा देवता \\ अवृकेणापरिपरेण पथा स्वस्ति रुद्रान् अशीय \\ इति मन्त्रम्̐ संनमति ।
9.1.2.a.m: He adapts the mantra: "The path belongs to the Triṣṭubh metre; the deities are the Rudras; by an unmenaced, unobstructed path may I safely reach the Rudras!"

9.1.2.b.s: uttareṇa havirdhānaṃ gatvottareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ parītya dakṣiṇena vā mārjālīyam antareṇa vā /
9.1.2.b.d: उत्तरेण हविर्धानं गत्वोत्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयं धिष्णियं परीत्य दक्षिणेन वा मार्जालीयम् अन्तरेण वा ।
9.1.2.b.m: Having gone north of the havirdhāna shed, going around north of the āgnīdhra dhiṣṇya hearth, or south [of it], or between the mārjālīya hearth,

9.1.2.c.s: pūrveṇa dvāreṇa sadaḥ praviśyādhvaryur yajamāno brahmā cāvatiṣṭhante 'greṇa praśāstrīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ parītyodgātāro mādhyaṃdinena pavamānena stuvate /
9.1.2.c.d: पूर्वेण द्वारेण सदः प्रविश्याध्वर्युर् यजमानो ब्रह्मा चावतिष्ठन्ते ऽग्रेण प्रशास्त्रीयं धिष्णियं परीत्योद्गातारो माध्यंदिनेन पवमानेन स्तुवते ।
9.1.2.c.m: and having entered the sadas hall by the eastern door, the adhvaryu, the sacrificer, and the brahman stand still; having gone around in front of the praśāstṛ's dhiṣṇya hearth, the udgātṛs chant praise with the midday pavamāna.

9.1.2.d.s: yad anyat paśvānayanāt tat sampreṣyati pratiprasthātar dadhigharmeṇa cara \\ iti saṃpraiṣasyāntam̐ saṃnamati /
9.1.2.d.d: यद् अन्यत् पश्वानयनात् तत् सम्प्रेष्यति प्रतिप्रस्थातर् दधिघर्मेण चर \\ इति संप्रैषस्यान्तम्̐ संनमति ।
9.1.2.d.m: Whatever [ritual action] is other than bringing the victim, that he directs: "Pratiprasthātṛ, proceed with the dadhigharma!" Thus he adapts the end of the ritual direction.

9.1.2.e.m: When the dhiṣṇya hearths have been laid out and sprinkled with clarified butter,

9.1.2.g.m: the pratiprasthātā, having apportioned the animal sacrificial cake, apportions the savanīya oblations.

9.1.2.h.m: Here the sacrificial cake is baked on eleven potsherds.

9.1.2.j.m: When [the oblations] are prepared, the pratiprasthātā proceeds with the dadhigharma.

9.1.2.k.s: yāvatī dyāvāpṛthivī ity āgnīdhrāgāra audumbaryām̐ sruci dadhi gṛhṇāti /
9.1.2.k.d: यावती द्यावापृथिवी इत्य् आग्नीध्रागार औदुम्बर्याम्̐ स्रुचि दधि गृह्णाति ।
9.1.2.k.m: With "As vast as heaven and earth...", he takes curd in an udumbara wood ladle in the āgnīdhra shed.

9.1.2.l.s: vāk ca tvā manaś ca śrīṇītām \\ prāṇaś ca tvāpānaś ca śrīṇītām \\ cakṣuś ca tvā śrotraṃ ca śrīṇītām \\ dakṣaś ca tvā balaṃ ca śrīṇītām \ ojaś ca tvā sahaś ca śrīṇītām \ āyuś ca tvā jarā ca śrīṇītām \ ātmā ca tvā tanūś ca śrīṇītam \\ śṛto 'si śṛtaṃ kṛtaḥ \ śṛtāya tvā śṛtebhyas tvā \\ ity āgnīdhrīye 'dhiśritya /
9.1.2.l.d: वाक् च त्वा मनश् च श्रीणीताम् \\ प्राणश् च त्वापानश् च श्रीणीताम् \\ चक्षुश् च त्वा श्रोत्रं च श्रीणीताम् \\ दक्षश् च त्वा बलं च श्रीणीताम् \ ओजश् च त्वा सहश् च श्रीणीताम् \ आयुश् च त्वा जरा च श्रीणीताम् \ आत्मा च त्वा तनूश् च श्रीणीतम् \\ शृतो ऽसि शृतं कृतः \ शृताय त्वा शृतेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रीये ऽधिश्रित्य ।
9.1.2.l.m: Having placed it on the āgnīdhra fire with: "May speech and mind mix you; may in-breath and out-breath mix you; may sight and hearing mix you; may skill and strength mix you; may vigor and power mix you; may life and old age mix you; may the self and the body mix you! You are cooked, made cooked; to what is cooked [I offer] you, to those who are cooked [I offer] you!"—

9.1.2.m.s: hotar vadasva yat te vādyam iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.1.2.m.d: होतर् वदस्व यत् ते वाद्यम् इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.1.2.m.m: he gives the ritual direction: "Hotṛ, speak what is to be spoken by you!"

9.1.2.n.s: yadi śrāto juhotana \ yady aśrāto mamattana \\ ity ucyamāne śrātam̐ havir iti pratyāha /
9.1.2.n.d: यदि श्रातो जुहोतन \ यद्य् अश्रातो ममत्तन \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने श्रातम्̐ हविर् इति प्रत्याह ।
9.1.2.n.m: When it is being said: "If it is cooked, make the offering; if it is not cooked, exhilarate!", he responds: "The sacrificial oblation is cooked!"

9.1.2.o.s: tam ādāyāhavanīyaṃ gatvāśrāvya pratyāśrāvite dadhigharmasya yaja \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.1.2.o.d: तम् आदायाहवनीयं गत्वाश्राव्य प्रत्याश्राविते दधिघर्मस्य यज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.1.2.o.m: Taking it and going to the āhavanīya fire, having called for the response and when the response has been made, he gives the ritual direction: "Recite the offering verse for the dadhigharma!"

9.1.2.p.s: yam indram āhur varuṇaṃ yam āhur \ yaṃ mitram āhur yam u satyam āhuḥ / \ yo devānāṃ devatamas tapojās \ tasmai tvā tebhyas tvā svāhā \\ iti vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti /
9.1.2.p.d: यम् इन्द्रम् आहुर् वरुणं यम् आहुर् \ यं मित्रम् आहुर् यम् उ सत्यम् आहुः । \ यो देवानां देवतमस् तपोजास् \ तस्मै त्वा तेभ्यस् त्वा स्वाहा \\ इति वषट्कृते जुहोति ।
9.1.2.p.m: When the vaṣaṭ has been uttered, he offers with: "Whom they call Indra, whom they call Varuṇa, whom they call Mitra, and whom they call Truth, who among the gods is most divine, born of austerity—to him [I offer] you, to them [I offer] you, svāhā!"

9.1.2.q.m: Having made the offering at the secondary vaṣaṭ, he carries the portion for consuming.

9.1.2.r.m: Those who [partake] in the Pravargya consume it.

9.1.2.s.m: The mantra for consuming it is the one to be recited in the forest.

9.2.3.a.s: puroḍāśān āsādya taiḥ samavadāya pracarati mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.2.3.a.d: पुरोडाशान् आसाद्य तैः समवदाय प्रचरति माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.2.3.a.m: Having set down the sacrificial cakes, having cut portions from them, he proceeds, giving the ritual direction: "[Recite the offering verse] for the midday pressing!"

9.2.3.b.m: Having proceeded with the animal sacrificial cake, having cut portions [from them], he proceeds with the savanīya oblations.

9.2.3.c.m: The Sviṣṭakṛt offering and the iḍā are common to the animal sacrificial cake and the savanīya oblations.

9.2.3.d.s: ādhavanīyaṃ pūtabhṛty avanīya daśābhiḥ kalaśaṃ mṛṣṭvā nyubjati /
9.2.3.d.d: आधवनीयं पूतभृत्य् अवनीय दशाभिः कलशं मृष्ट्वा न्युब्जति ।
9.2.3.d.m: Having poured the ādhavanīya [soma] into the pūtabhṛt jar, having wiped the jar with the fringes [of the strainer], he turns it upside down.

9.2.3.e.s: unnīyamānebhyo 'nubrūhi \ hotuś camasam anūnnayadhvam \ ubhayataḥśukrān kurudhvam \ acchāvākasya camasādhvaryo 'pi tvam unnayasva \ pratiprasthātaḥ prokṣitāprokṣitāñ chakalān upakalpaya \\ unnetaḥ somaṃ prabhāvaya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.2.3.e.d: उन्नीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \ होतुश् चमसम् अनून्नयध्वम् \ उभयतःशुक्रान् कुरुध्वम् \ अच्छावाकस्य चमसाध्वर्यो ऽपि त्वम् उन्नयस्व \ प्रतिप्रस्थातः प्रोक्षिताप्रोक्षिताञ् छकलान् उपकल्पय \\ उन्नेतः सोमं प्रभावय \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.2.3.e.m: He directs: "Recite [the introductory verse] for the [cups] being drawn! Fill after the cup of the hotṛ! Make them possess clarified soma on both sides! Camasādhvaryu of the acchāvāka, you too draw! Pratiprasthātṛ, prepare the sprinkled and unsprinkled chips of wood! Unnetṛ, make the soma plentiful!"

9.2.3.f.s: hotṛcamasamukhyān ekādaśa camasān unnayati purastād āgnīdhracamasād acchāvākacamasam unnayati /
9.2.3.f.d: होतृचमसमुख्यान् एकादश चमसान् उन्नयति पुरस्ताद् आग्नीध्रचमसाद् अच्छावाकचमसम् उन्नयति ।
9.2.3.f.m: He draws eleven cups beginning with the hotṛ's cup; he draws the acchāvāka's cup before the āgnīdhra's cup.

9.2.3.g.s: mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya niṣkevalyasya bhāgasya śukravato manthivato madhuścuta indrāya somān prasthitān preṣya \ madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasādhvaryavo vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛtāñ juhuta \ hotrakāṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ sakṛtsakṛd dhutvā śukrasyābhyunnīyopāvartadhvam iti saṃpreṣyati yat prāk punarabhyunnītebhyas tasmin kṛte prasarvaṇamantrair hotrakāḥ prasṛpya punarabhyunnītānāṃ yajanti /
9.2.3.g.d: माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य निष्केवल्यस्य भागस्य शुक्रवतो मन्थिवतो मधुश्चुत इन्द्राय सोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \ मध्यतःकारिणां चमसाध्वर्यवो वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृताञ् जुहुत \ होत्रकाणां चमसाध्वर्यवः सकृत्सकृद् धुत्वा शुक्रस्याभ्युन्नीयोपावर्तध्वम् इति संप्रेष्यति यत् प्राक् पुनरभ्युन्नीतेभ्यस् तस्मिन् कृते प्रसर्वणमन्त्रैर् होत्रकाः प्रसृप्य पुनरभ्युन्नीतानां यजन्ति ।
9.2.3.g.m: He directs: "For the midday pressing, for the unmixed share, for Indra who possesses the Śukra, who possesses the Manthin, from whom honey drips, urge the set-forth somas! Camasādhvaryus of the central officiants, make the offering at the vaṣaṭ and the secondary vaṣaṭ! Camasādhvaryus of the minor priests, having offered once each, having filled up with Śukra, turn back!" When what precedes the refills has been performed, the minor priests, having crept forth with the creeping mantras, offer for the refills.

9.2.3.h.s: ayāḍ agnīt \\ iti hotur ākhyāya niravadāya hotra iḍām ādadhāty upahūyamānām upodyacchante camasām̐ś camasādhvaryavaḥ /
9.2.3.h.d: अयाड् अग्नीत् \\ इति होतुर् आख्याय निरवदाय होत्र इडाम् आदधात्य् उपहूयमानाम् उपोद्यच्छन्ते चमसाम्̐श् चमसाध्वर्यवः ।
9.2.3.h.m: Having announced to the hotṛ, "The Agnīdh has sacrificed!", having cut portions, he places the iḍā for the hotṛ; while it is being invoked, the camasādhvaryus raise the cups.

9.2.3.i.m: He does not place a chip of the iḍā for the acchāvāka.

9.2.3.j.s: yathācamasaṃ camasino bhakṣayanti teṣāṃ vyākhyāto bhakṣamantraḥ /
9.2.3.j.d: यथाचमसं चमसिनो भक्षयन्ति तेषां व्याख्यातो भक्षमन्त्रः ।
9.2.3.j.m: The cup-holders consume according to their cups; the mantra for consuming for them has been explained.

9.2.3.k.s: sanneṣu nārāśam̐seṣu dakṣiṇena vedim avasthitāsu dakṣiṇāsu dākṣiṇāni juhoti yathā vaisarjanāni /
9.2.3.k.d: सन्नेषु नाराशम्̐सेषु दक्षिणेन वेदिम् अवस्थितासु दक्षिणासु दाक्षिणानि जुहोति यथा वैसर्जनानि ।
9.2.3.k.m: When the nārāśaṃsa cups are deposited and the sacrificial gifts are stationed to the south of the altar, he offers the dakṣiṇā oblations in the manner of the vaisarjana offerings.

9.2.3.l.s: pracchādanārthasya vāsaso daśāyām̐ hiraṇyaṃ baddhvājye 'vadhāya srugdaṇḍe vāsaso 'ntam upaniyamya \\ ud u tyam \\ citram iti dvābhyām̐ śālāmukhīye juhoti śeṣam ājyasya karoti /
9.2.3.l.d: प्रच्छादनार्थस्य वाससो दशायाम्̐ हिरण्यं बद्ध्वाज्ये ऽवधाय स्रुग्दण्डे वाससो ऽन्तम् उपनियम्य \\ उद् उ त्यम् \\ चित्रम् इति द्वाभ्याम्̐ शालामुखीये जुहोति शेषम् आज्यस्य करोति ।
9.2.3.l.m: Having tied gold in the fringe of a garment intended for covering, having placed it in clarified butter, and having bound the edge of the garment to the handle of the offering ladle, he offers into the śālāmukhīya fire with two verses: "Up that..." and "Wonderful..."; he leaves a remainder of the clarified butter.

9.2.3.m.s: nīyamānāsu pūrvaḥ pratipadya \\ agne naya \\ iti nayavatyarcāgnīdhre juhoti /
9.2.3.m.d: नीयमानासु पूर्वः प्रतिपद्य \\ अग्ने नय \\ इति नयवत्यर्चाग्नीध्रे जुहोति ।
9.2.3.m.m: While they are being led, having stepped forward first, he offers into the āgnīdhra fire with a verse containing the word 'lead': "O Agni, lead..."

9.2.3.o.s: divaṃ gaccha suvaḥ pata \\ iti hiraṇyam̐ hutvodgṛhṇāti /
9.2.3.o.d: दिवं गच्छ सुवः पत \\ इति हिरण्यम्̐ हुत्वोद्गृह्णाति ।
9.2.3.o.m: With 'Go to heaven, fly to the light,' having offered gold, he takes it up.

9.2.3.p.s: vaneṣu vy antarikṣaṃ tatāna \\ iti dvitīyāṃ yady ano ratho 'dhīvāso vā dīyate /
9.2.3.p.d: वनेषु व्य् अन्तरिक्षं ततान \\ इति द्वितीयां यद्य् अनो रथो ऽधीवासो वा दीयते ।
9.2.3.p.m: With 'He stretched the atmosphere across the forests,' [he offers] the second [oblation] if a cart, a chariot, or an outer garment is given.

9.2.3.q.s: prajāpate na tvad etāni \\ iti tṛtīyāṃ yady aśvaḥ puruṣo hastī vā dīyate /
9.2.3.q.d: प्रजापते न त्वद् एतानि \\ इति तृतीयां यद्य् अश्वः पुरुषो हस्ती वा दीयते ।
9.2.3.q.m: With 'O Prajāpati, none other than you [encompasses] these,' [he offers] the third [oblation] if a horse, a man, or an elephant is given.

9.2.3.r.s: nītāsu dakṣiṇāsu yajñapatim ṛṣaya enasāhur iti //
9.2.3.r.d: नीतासु दक्षिणासु यज्ञपतिम् ऋषय एनसाहुर् इति ॥
9.2.3.r.m: When the dakṣiṇās have been led away, [beginning with] 'The seers spoke of the lord of the sacrifice as having sin,'

9.2.4.a.m: he offers the Vaiśvakarmaṇa oblations on the āgnīdhra fire with five [verses].

9.2.4.b.s: yathāgṛhītaṃ marutvatīyāv ādāya \\ indrāya marutvate 'nubrūhi \\ indrāya marutvate preṣya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.2.4.b.d: यथागृहीतं मरुत्वतीयाव् आदाय \\ इन्द्राय मरुत्वते ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इन्द्राय मरुत्वते प्रेष्य \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.2.4.b.m: Having taken the two Marutvatīya cups as they were drawn, he gives the ritual direction: 'Recite [the introductory verse] for Indra accompanied by the Maruts,' 'Prompt [the hotṛ to recite the offering verse] for Indra accompanied by the Maruts.'

9.2.4.d.m: They consume [the soma] with the pratiprasthātṛ's vessel, as in the case of the Ṛtu cups.

9.2.4.e.m: The hotṛ [consumes] twice; the other two once each.

9.2.4.f.s: mārjālīye pātraṃ prakṣālya hotuḥ sakāśe nidadhāti /
9.2.4.f.d: मार्जालीये पात्रं प्रक्षाल्य होतुः सकाशे निदधाति ।
9.2.4.f.m: Having rinsed the vessel at the mārjālīya, he places it near the hotṛ.

9.2.4.g.s: janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya \ mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ / \ avardhann indraṃ marutaś cid atra \ mātā yad vīraṃ dadhanad dhaniṣṭhā / \ indra marutva iha pāhi \\ ity anyatareṇa svena pātreṇābhakṣitena tṛtīyaṃ marutvatīyaṃ kalaśāc chastravantaṃ gṛhṇāti /
9.2.4.g.d: जनिष्ठा उग्रः सहसे तुराय \ मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो बहुलाभिमानः । \ अवर्धन्न् इन्द्रं मरुतश् चिद् अत्र \ माता यद् वीरं दधनद् धनिष्ठा । \ इन्द्र मरुत्व इह पाहि \\ इत्य् अन्यतरेण स्वेन पात्रेणाभक्षितेन तृतीयं मरुत्वतीयं कलशाच् छस्त्रवन्तं गृह्णाति ।
9.2.4.g.m: With 'Fierce, he was born for swift strength, / delightful, most powerful, possessed of manifold pride; / the Maruts magnified Indra here, / when the most generous mother bore the hero. / O Indra, accompanied by the Maruts, drink here,' he draws the third Marutvatīya cup accompanied by the śastra from the trough using the other unconsumed vessel of his own.

9.2.4.h.m: Touching the Ṛtu cup, he responds [to the recitation].

9.2.4.i.s: ukthaṃ vāci \\ iti śastraṃ pratigīrya sarvatra mādhyaṃdine savane japati /
9.2.4.i.d: उक्थं वाचि \\ इति शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य सर्वत्र माध्यंदिने सवने जपति ।
9.2.4.i.m: With 'The uktha has been recited,' having responded to the śastra, he murmurs everywhere at the midday pressing.

9.2.4.j.s: śastraṃ pratigīrya graham ādatte camasām̐ś camasādhvaryavas \\ ukthaśā yaja somasya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati / vyākhyātam anuprakampanaṃ grahanārāśam̐sānaṃ bhakṣa āpyāyanasādane ca nārāśam̐sānām /
9.2.4.j.d: शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य ग्रहम् आदत्ते चमसाम्̐श् चमसाध्वर्यवस् \\ उक्थशा यज सोमस्य \\ इति संप्रेष्यति । व्याख्यातम् अनुप्रकम्पनं ग्रहनाराशम्̐सानं भक्ष आप्यायनसादने च नाराशम्̐सानाम् ।
9.2.4.j.m: Having responded to the śastra, he takes the cup, and the camasādhvaryus take the goblets; he issues the ritual direction: 'Pronouncing the uktha, offer of the soma.' The trembling along [with the recitation], the consuming of the cups and the Nārāśaṃsa goblets, and the swelling and setting down of the Nārāśaṃsa goblets have been explained.

9.2.4.k.s: mahām̐ indro ya ojasā \ mahām̐ indro nṛvat \\ ity anyatareṇa śukrapātreṇa māhendraṃ kalaśāt stutaśastravantaṃ gṛhṇāti /
9.2.4.k.d: महाम्̐ इन्द्रो य ओजसा \ महाम्̐ इन्द्रो नृवत् \\ इत्य् अन्यतरेण शुक्रपात्रेण माहेन्द्रं कलशात् स्तुतशस्त्रवन्तं गृह्णाति ।
9.2.4.k.m: With 'Indra is great, who by might...' and 'Indra is great, manly...' he draws the Māhendra cup accompanied by praise and recitation from the trough using the other Śukra vessel.

9.2.4.l.s: tam̐ sādayitvā stotram upākaroti tad vyākhyātam apavṛtte stotre śastram upākaroti tad vyākhyātam /
9.2.4.l.d: तम्̐ सादयित्वा स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति तद् व्याख्यातम् अपवृत्ते स्तोत्रे शस्त्रम् उपाकरोति तद् व्याख्यातम् ।
9.2.4.l.m: Having set it down, he introduces the stotra; that has been explained. When the stotra has ended, he introduces the śastra; that has been explained.

9.2.4.m.s: śastraṃ pratigīrya graham ādatte camasām̐ś camasādhvaryavaḥ /
9.2.4.m.d: शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य ग्रहम् आदत्ते चमसाम्̐श् चमसाध्वर्यवः ।
9.2.4.m.m: Having responded to the śastra, he takes the cup, and the camasādhvaryus take the goblets.

9.2.4.n.s: atigrāhyān itare 'dhvaryava āgneyaṃ pratiprasthātaindraṃ neṣṭā sauryam unnetā /
9.2.4.n.d: अतिग्राह्यान् इतरे ऽध्वर्यव आग्नेयं प्रतिप्रस्थातैन्द्रं नेष्टा सौर्यम् उन्नेता ।
9.2.4.n.m: The other adhvaryus [take] the Atigrāhya cups: the pratiprasthātṛ the one for Agni, the neṣṭṛ the one for Indra, and the unnetṛ the one for Sūrya.

9.2.4.o.s: ukthaśā yaja somasya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati \\ agne tejasvin tejasvī \\ ity etair yathārūpam atigrāhyāñ juhvati /
9.2.4.o.d: उक्थशा यज सोमस्य \\ इति संप्रेष्यति \\ अग्ने तेजस्विन् तेजस्वी \\ इत्य् एतैर् यथारूपम् अतिग्राह्याञ् जुह्वति ।
9.2.4.o.m: He gives the ritual direction: 'Pronouncing the uktha, offer of the soma.' With 'O Agni, possessed of splendor, splendid...' they offer the Atigrāhya cups according to their characteristic form.

9.2.4.p.s: mayi medhām \\ mayi prajām ity etair yathārūpam atigrāhyān bhakṣayanti /
9.2.4.p.d: मयि मेधाम् \\ मयि प्रजाम् इत्य् एतैर् यथारूपम् अतिग्राह्यान् भक्षयन्ति ।
9.2.4.p.m: With 'In me intelligence...' and 'In me offspring...' they consume the Atigrāhya cups according to their characteristic form.

9.2.4.q.m: All [portions] are consumed; there is neither swelling nor setting down.

9.2.4.r.m: They proceed with the three Ukthya divisions as previously.

9.2.4.s.s: indrāya tvā \\ iti sarvatra grahaṇasādanau saṃnamataḥ /
9.2.4.s.d: इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति सर्वत्र ग्रहणसादनौ संनमतः ।
9.2.4.s.m: Everywhere they adapt the drawing and setting-down mantras with 'For Indra you.'

9.2.4.t.s: viśve devā maruta indro asmān iti sam̐sthite juhoti /
9.2.4.t.d: विश्वे देवा मरुत इन्द्रो अस्मान् इति सम्̐स्थिते जुहोति ।
9.2.4.t.m: With 'May all the gods, the Maruts, and Indra [protect] us,' he makes the offering when [the midday pressing] is concluded.

9.2.4.u.s: praśāstaḥ prasuva \\ iti saṃpreṣyati sarpata \\ ity āha praśāstā saṃtiṣṭhate mādhyaṃdinam̐ savanam //
9.2.4.u.d: प्रशास्तः प्रसुव \\ इति संप्रेष्यति सर्पत \\ इत्य् आह प्रशास्ता संतिष्ठते माध्यंदिनम्̐ सवनम् ॥
9.2.4.u.m: He gives the ritual direction: 'O director, impel!' The praśāstṛ says: 'Crawl!' The midday pressing concludes.

9.3.5.a.m: The third pressing, beginning with the Āditya cup, is performed.

9.3.5.b.m: Its procedure has been explained by that of the midday pressing.

9.3.5.c.d: अपिधाय हविर्धानस्य द्वारे यदा बहवो ऽन्तर्वेदि ।
9.3.5.c.m: Having closed the two doors of the havirdhāna [hall], when many are inside the vedi,

9.3.5.e.s: antarvedi yajamānaḥ patnī ca bhavato 'thādityaṃ gṛhṇāti /
9.3.5.e.d: अन्तर्वेदि यजमानः पत्नी च भवतो ऽथादित्यं गृह्णाति ।
9.3.5.e.m: the sacrificer and his wife are inside the vedi; then he draws the Āditya cup.

9.3.5.f.s: yasya bhrātṛvyaḥ somena yajeta yāvad ādityaṃ gṛhṇīyāt tāvad bahirvedi tiṣṭhet /
9.3.5.f.d: यस्य भ्रातृव्यः सोमेन यजेत यावद् आदित्यं गृह्णीयात् तावद् बहिर्वेदि तिष्ठेत् ।
9.3.5.f.m: He whose rival is sacrificing with soma should stand outside the vedi for as long as he draws the Āditya cup.

9.3.5.g.s: kadācana starīr asi \\ iti ya ādityasthālyām̐ somas tasyaikadeśam ādityapātreṇa gṛhṇāti /
9.3.5.g.d: कदाचन स्तरीर् असि \\ इति य आदित्यस्थाल्याम्̐ सोमस् तस्यैकदेशम् आदित्यपात्रेण गृह्णाति ।
9.3.5.g.m: With 'Never are you barren,' he draws a portion of the soma that is in the Āditya pot with the Āditya vessel.

9.3.5.h.m: With 'Never do you become heedless,' [he takes] boiled and curdled milk.

9.3.5.i.s: yajño devānāṃ pratyeti \\ iti ya ādityasthālyām̐ somas tam̐ sarvaṃ gṛhṇāti /
9.3.5.i.d: यज्ञो देवानां प्रत्येति \\ इति य आदित्यस्थाल्याम्̐ सोमस् तम्̐ सर्वं गृह्णाति ।
9.3.5.i.m: With 'The sacrifice of the gods returns,' he takes all of the soma that is in the Āditya pot.

9.3.5.j.m: With 'O radiant Āditya,' he mixes the Āditya cup with the Upāṃśusavana pressing stone.

9.3.5.k.s: yā divyā vṛṣṭis tayā tvā śrīṇāmi \\ ity ādityaṃ payasā dadhnā vopariṣṭād vṛṣṭikāmasya śrīṇīyāt /
9.3.5.k.d: या दिव्या वृष्टिस् तया त्वा श्रीणामि \\ इत्य् आदित्यं पयसा दध्ना वोपरिष्टाद् वृष्टिकामस्य श्रीणीयात् ।
9.3.5.k.m: With 'With that heavenly rain I mix you,' he should mix the Āditya cup from above with milk or curd for one desiring rain.

9.3.5.l.m: According to some, he does not take curd from the middle.

9.3.5.m.m: Into it he puts down the Upāṃśusavana pressing stone.

9.3.5.n.m: Having raised it up, he obtains an omen:

9.3.5.o.s: yady uddrutasya kṣipram̐ stokaḥ praskanded varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syād yadi ciram avarṣukaḥ /
9.3.5.o.d: यद्य् उद्द्रुतस्य क्षिप्रम्̐ स्तोकः प्रस्कन्देद् वर्षुकः पर्जन्यः स्याद् यदि चिरम् अवर्षुकः ।
9.3.5.o.m: if, as it is raised, a drop quickly falls, Parjanya will be rainy; if after a long time, it will not be rainy.

9.3.5.q.s: ā samudrād āntarikṣāt \\ iti darbhair ācyāvayati /
9.3.5.q.d: आ समुद्राद् आन्तरिक्षात् \\ इति दर्भैर् आच्यावयति ।
9.3.5.q.m: With 'From the ocean, from the atmosphere,' he stirs it with darbha blades.

9.3.5.r.s: ahaṃ parastād aham avastāt \\ iti darbhair hastena vāpidadhāti /
9.3.5.r.d: अहं परस्ताद् अहम् अवस्तात् \\ इति दर्भैर् हस्तेन वापिदधाति ।
9.3.5.r.m: With 'I above, I below,' he covers it with darbha blades or with his hand.

9.3.5.s.s: sūryo mā devo devebhyaḥ pātu \\ ity uttiṣṭhati /
9.3.5.s.d: सूर्यो मा देवो देवेभ्यः पातु \\ इत्य् उत्तिष्ठति ।
9.3.5.s.m: With 'May the divine Sūrya protect me from the gods,' he stands up.

9.3.5.t.s: kavir yajñasya vitanoti panthām iti harati /
9.3.5.t.d: कविर् यज्ञस्य वितनोति पन्थाम् इति हरति ।
9.3.5.t.m: With 'The wise one extends the path of the sacrifice,' he carries it.

9.3.5.u.s: ādityebhyaḥ priyebhyaḥ priyadhāmabhyaḥ priyavratebhyo mahasvasarasvapatibhya uror antarikṣasyādhyakṣebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ādityebhyaḥ priyebhyaḥ priyadhāmabhyaḥ priyavratebhyo mahasvasarasvapatibhya uror antarikṣasyādhyakṣebhyaḥ preṣya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati //
9.3.5.u.d: आदित्येभ्यः प्रियेभ्यः प्रियधामभ्यः प्रियव्रतेभ्यो महस्वसरस्वपतिभ्य उरोर् अन्तरिक्षस्याध्यक्षेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ आदित्येभ्यः प्रियेभ्यः प्रियधामभ्यः प्रियव्रतेभ्यो महस्वसरस्वपतिभ्य उरोर् अन्तरिक्षस्याध्यक्षेभ्यः प्रेष्य \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ॥
9.3.5.u.m: He gives the ritual direction: 'Recite for the Ādityas, the beloved, of beloved abodes, of beloved vows, masters of the great gathering, overseers of the wide atmosphere,' 'Prompt [the hotṛ] for the Ādityas, the beloved, of beloved abodes, of beloved vows, masters of the great gathering, overseers of the wide atmosphere.'

9.3.6.a.s: yās te viśvāḥ samidhaḥ santy agne \\ iti darbhān āhavanīye prāsyānyatrekṣamāṇo juhoti /
9.3.6.a.d: यास् ते विश्वाः समिधः सन्त्य् अग्ने \\ इति दर्भान् आहवनीये प्रास्यान्यत्रेक्षमाणो जुहोति ।
9.3.6.a.m: With 'Whatever kindling sticks of yours there are, O Agni,' having thrown the darbha blades into the āhavanīya fire, he offers while looking elsewhere.

9.3.6.b.m: With 'Make the earth swell,' he should make the offering for one who desires rain.

9.3.6.d.s: nānuvaṣaṭkaroti na bhakṣayati sūdavat pātram̐ sādayati /
9.3.6.d.d: नानुवषट्करोति न भक्षयति सूदवत् पात्रम्̐ सादयति ।
9.3.6.d.m: He does not pronounce the secondary vaṣaṭ; he does not consume it; he sets down the vessel as containing the remnant.

9.3.6.e.m: Having poured out [water] from the Vasatīvarī waters, he prepares the Nigrābhyā waters.

9.3.6.f.s: ya upām̐supātre 'm̐śus tam ṛjīṣe 'pisṛjyādābhyām̐śum upām̐śupāvanau carjīṣaṃ tūṣṇīm abhiṣunvanti /
9.3.6.f.d: य उपाम्̐सुपात्रे ऽम्̐शुस् तम् ऋजीषे ऽपिसृज्यादाभ्याम्̐शुम् उपाम्̐शुपावनौ चर्जीषं तूष्णीम् अभिषुन्वन्ति ।
9.3.6.f.m: Having added the stalk that is in the Upāṃśu vessel to the soma residue, they press silently the Adābhya stalk, the Upāṃśu-strainers, and the soma residue.

9.3.6.g.m: He does not hand over the soma-turban to the grāvastut.

9.3.6.h.m: The pratiprasthātṛ does not applaud the pressing stones.

9.3.6.i.m: Here, some teach the handing out of the savanīya offerings.

9.3.6.j.s: dhārāgrahaṇakāla āgrayaṇaṃ catasṛbhyo dhārābhyo gṛhṇāty ādityapātrāc caturthīṃ dhārāṃ karoti /
9.3.6.j.d: धाराग्रहणकाल आग्रयणं चतसृभ्यो धाराभ्यो गृह्णात्य् आदित्यपात्राच् चतुर्थीं धारां करोति ।
9.3.6.j.m: At the time of taking the continuous stream, he draws the Āgrayaṇa cup from four streams; he makes the fourth stream from the Āditya vessel.

9.3.6.k.s: taṃ gṛhītvā rājānam atipāvayati yāvantaṃ tṛtīyasavanāyāptaṃ manyate viramati dhārā prapīḍya pavitraṃ nidadhāti /
9.3.6.k.d: तं गृहीत्वा राजानम् अतिपावयति यावन्तं तृतीयसवनायाप्तं मन्यते विरमति धारा प्रपीड्य पवित्रं निदधाति ।
9.3.6.k.m: Having taken it, he filters the King [soma] as much as he thinks sufficient for the third pressing; the stream stops; having squeezed the strainer, he puts it down.

9.3.6.l.s: yat prāk pavamānagrahebhyas tasmin kṛta āgnīdhrāgāre patny āśiraṃ mathitvāpareṇa dvāreṇa havirdhāne praviśya \\ asme devāso vapuṣe cikitsata \\ iti catasṛbhir āśiraṃ yajamānaḥ patnī ca tiraḥpavitraṃ pūtabhṛty avanayataḥ /
9.3.6.l.d: यत् प्राक् पवमानग्रहेभ्यस् तस्मिन् कृत आग्नीध्रागारे पत्न्य् आशिरं मथित्वापरेण द्वारेण हविर्धाने प्रविश्य \\ अस्मे देवासो वपुषे चिकित्सत \\ इति चतसृभिर् आशिरं यजमानः पत्नी च तिरःपवित्रं पूतभृत्य् अवनयतः ।
9.3.6.l.m: When that which comes before the Pavamāna cups has been done, the sacrificer's wife, having churned the milk-mixture in the āgnīdhra room and having entered the havirdhāna [hall] by the western door, the sacrificer and his wife pour the milk-mixture through the strainer into the pūtabhṛt with the four verses beginning with 'O gods, take heed of this our form.'

9.3.6.m.s: pavamānagrahān kalaśān āgrayaṇaṃ ca grahāvakāśair upasthāya niḥsarpantaḥ samanvārabhante /
9.3.6.m.d: पवमानग्रहान् कलशान् आग्रयणं च ग्रहावकाशैर् उपस्थाय निःसर्पन्तः समन्वारभन्ते ।
9.3.6.m.m: Having attended upon the Pavamāna cups, the troughs, and the Āgrayaṇa cup with the cup-veneration mantras, they hold on to one another while crawling out.

9.3.6.n.s: vaipruṣān saptahotāraṃ ca hutvārbhavaṃ pavamānam̐ sarpanti tasya mādhyaṃdinena savanena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ //
9.3.6.n.d: वैप्रुषान् सप्तहोतारं च हुत्वार्भवं पवमानम्̐ सर्पन्ति तस्य माध्यंदिनेन सवनेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः ॥
9.3.6.n.m: Having offered the drops and the Saptahotṛ mantras, they crawl to the Ārbhava Pavamāna; its procedure has been explained by that of the midday pressing.

9.3.7.a.s: jāgataḥ panthās \\ ādityā devatā \\ avṛkeṇāparipareṇa pathā svasty ādityān aśīya \\ iti mantram̐ saṃnamati /
9.3.7.a.d: जागतः पन्थास् \\ आदित्या देवता \\ अवृकेणापरिपरेण पथा स्वस्त्य् आदित्यान् अशीय \\ इति मन्त्रम्̐ संनमति ।
9.3.7.a.m: He adapts the mantra: "The path belongs to the jagatī; the Ādityas are the deities; by a wolf-free, unobstructed path may I attain safely to the Ādityas".

9.3.7.b.s: yad anyad dhiṣṇiyaviharaṇāt tat saṃpreṣyati pratiprasthātaḥ paśau saṃvadasva \\ iti saṃpraiṣasyāntam̐ saṃnamati /
9.3.7.b.d: यद् अन्यद् धिष्णियविहरणात् तत् संप्रेष्यति प्रतिप्रस्थातः पशौ संवदस्व \\ इति संप्रैषस्यान्तम्̐ संनमति ।
9.3.7.b.m: Whatever else [there is] aside from distributing the dhiṣṇyas, he directs that; he adapts the end of the direction: "Pratiprasthātṛ, engage in dialogue regarding the animal!"

9.3.7.c.s: avihṛteṣv avyāghāriteṣu dhiṣṇiyeṣu stīrṇe barhiṣi pratiprasthātā savanīyān nirvapati /
9.3.7.c.d: अविहृतेष्व् अव्याघारितेषु धिष्णियेषु स्तीर्णे बर्हिषि प्रतिप्रस्थाता सवनीयान् निर्वपति ।
9.3.7.c.m: When the dhiṣṇyas have not been distributed and not smeared with butter, and the barhis has been spread, the pratiprasthātṛ portions out the pressing cakes.

9.3.7.d.m: Here the sacrificial cake is on twelve potsherds.

9.3.7.e.m: There is no animal sacrificial cake.

9.3.7.f.s: aṣṭākapālān sarvatra savanīyān eke samāmananty ekādaśakapālān eke dvādaśakapālān eke /
9.3.7.f.d: अष्टाकपालान् सर्वत्र सवनीयान् एके समामनन्त्य् एकादशकपालान् एके द्वादशकपालान् एके ।
9.3.7.f.m: Some teach pressing cakes on eight potsherds everywhere, some on eleven potsherds, some on twelve potsherds.

9.3.7.g.m: When [the fires] are adorned, the pratiprasthātṛ enters upon the sacrificial framework of the animal beginning with the dialogue.

9.3.7.h.s: tasya dakṣiṇena havirdhānam uttareṇa vā samavattaṃ pariharati /
9.3.7.h.d: तस्य दक्षिणेन हविर्धानम् उत्तरेण वा समवत्तं परिहरति ।
9.3.7.h.m: To the south or to the north of the havirdhāna [hall], he brings around its portioned cut.

9.3.7.i.s: na yajamāno bhakṣān bhakṣayati bhakṣaṇam eke samāmananti /
9.3.7.i.d: न यजमानो भक्षान् भक्षयति भक्षणम् एके समामनन्ति ।
9.3.7.i.m: The sacrificer does not consume the portions; some teach consumption.

9.3.7.j.s: puroḍāśān āsādya taiḥ samavadāya pracarati tṛtīyasya savanasya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati d
9.3.7.j.d: पुरोडाशान् आसाद्य तैः समवदाय प्रचरति तृतीयस्य सवनस्य \\ इति संप्रेष्यति द्
9.3.7.j.m: Having placed down the sacrificial cakes, having cut off portions from them, he proceeds; he directs: "... of the third pressing!"

9.3.7.k.s: ādhavanīyaṃ pūtabhṛty avanīya daśābhiḥ kalaśaṃ mṛṣṭvā nyubjati \\ unnīyamānebhyo 'nubrūhi \ hotuś camasam anūnnayadhvam \\ tīvrām̐ āśīrvataḥ kurudhvam \ acchāvākasya camasādhvaryo 'pi tvam unnayasva \\ unnetaḥ somaṃ prabhāvaya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.3.7.k.d: आधवनीयं पूतभृत्य् अवनीय दशाभिः कलशं मृष्ट्वा न्युब्जति \\ उन्नीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \ होतुश् चमसम् अनून्नयध्वम् \\ तीव्राम्̐ आशीर्वतः कुरुध्वम् \ अच्छावाकस्य चमसाध्वर्यो ऽपि त्वम् उन्नयस्व \\ उन्नेतः सोमं प्रभावय \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.3.7.k.m: Having poured the ādhavanīya into the pūtabhṛt, having wiped the tub with the fringed filter, he inverts it; he directs: "Recite for those being drawn! Draw following the hotṛ's cup! Make [the somas] strong and mixed with boiled milk! Cup-adhvaryu of the acchāvāka, you too draw! Unnetṛ, make the soma abound!"

9.3.7.l.m: He draws eleven cups headed by the hotṛ's cup.

9.3.7.m.m: At the time of proceeding, he proceeds only with the ready [cups].

9.3.7.n.s: tṛtīyasya savanasyarbhumato vibhumataḥ prabhumato vājavataḥ savitṛvato bṛhaspativato viśvadevyāvatas tīvrām̐ āśīrvata indrāya somān prasthitān preṣya \ madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasādhvaryavo vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛtāñ juhuta \ hotrakāṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ sakṛtsakṛd dhutvā tīvrasyāśīrvato 'bhyunnīyopāvartadhvam iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.3.7.n.d: तृतीयस्य सवनस्यर्भुमतो विभुमतः प्रभुमतो वाजवतः सवितृवतो बृहस्पतिवतो विश्वदेव्यावतस् तीव्राम्̐ आशीर्वत इन्द्राय सोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \ मध्यतःकारिणां चमसाध्वर्यवो वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृताञ् जुहुत \ होत्रकाणां चमसाध्वर्यवः सकृत्सकृद् धुत्वा तीव्रस्याशीर्वतो ऽभ्युन्नीयोपावर्तध्वम् इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.3.7.n.m: He directs: "Prompt the set-out somas of the third pressing, accompanied by the Ṛbhus, accompanied by Vibhvan, accompanied by Prabhu, accompanied by Vāja, accompanied by Savitṛ, accompanied by Bṛhaspati, accompanied by the Viśvedevas, strong, mixed with boiled milk, for Indra! Cup-adhvaryus of the central officiants, offer [the cups] vaṣaṭ-called and second-vaṣaṭ-called! Cup-adhvaryus of the minor priests, having offered once each, having poured in more of the strong [soma] mixed with boiled milk, come back!"

9.3.8.a.s: etaiḥ punarabhyunnītāñ juhoti vaṭ svayamabhigūrtāya namas \\ ity anuvaṣaṭkārān /
9.3.8.a.d: एतैः पुनरभ्युन्नीताञ् जुहोति वट् स्वयमभिगूर्ताय नमस् \\ इत्य् अनुवषट्कारान् ।
9.3.8.a.m: With these [mantras] he offers the cups that have been filled again; with "Vaṭ, homage to the self-willing one", the second vaṣaṭ-calls.

9.3.8.b.s: tṛmpantām̐ hotrā madhor ghṛtasya \\ iti hutān anumantrayate /
9.3.8.b.d: तृम्पन्ताम्̐ होत्रा मधोर् घृतस्य \\ इति हुतान् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
9.3.8.b.m: With "May the Hotrās be sated with sweet ghee", he accompanies the offered [oblations].

9.3.8.c.s: yathācamasaṃ camasino bhakṣayanti teṣāṃ vyākhyāto bhakṣamantraḥ /
9.3.8.c.d: यथाचमसं चमसिनो भक्षयन्ति तेषां व्याख्यातो भक्षमन्त्रः ।
9.3.8.c.m: The cup-holders consume [the soma] each from his cup; the mantra for consuming [it] has been explained.

9.3.8.d.s: sanneṣu nārāśam̐seṣu svam̐svaṃ camasaṃ nyante trīm̐strīn puroḍāśaśakalān dakṣiṇata upāsyanti /
9.3.8.d.d: सन्नेषु नाराशम्̐सेषु स्वम्̐स्वं चमसं न्यन्ते त्रीम्̐स्त्रीन् पुरोडाशशकलान् दक्षिणत उपास्यन्ति ।
9.3.8.d.m: When the nārāśaṃsa [cups] have been deposited, each [cup-holder] casts aside to the south, near his own cup, three pieces of sacrificial cake each.

9.3.8.e.s: tat kṛtvā prācīnāvītāni kṛtvā ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ vyākhyāya dānaprabhṛtīn pratyāyanāntān piṇḍapitṛyajñamantrāñ japanti /
9.3.8.e.d: तत् कृत्वा प्राचीनावीतानि कृत्वा षड्ढोतारं व्याख्याय दानप्रभृतीन् प्रत्यायनान्तान् पिण्डपितृयज्ञमन्त्राञ् जपन्ति ।
9.3.8.e.m: Having done that and wearing the sacred cord over the right shoulder, having recited the ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula, they murmur the piṇḍapitṛyajña mantras beginning with the giving [of the lumps] and ending with the return.

9.3.8.f.s: tasmin kṛte vāmam adya savitar ity eteṣām ekenāntaryāmapātreṇa sāvitram āgrayaṇād gṛhṇāti /
9.3.8.f.d: तस्मिन् कृते वामम् अद्य सवितर् इत्य् एतेषाम् एकेनान्तर्यामपात्रेण सावित्रम् आग्रयणाद् गृह्णाति ।
9.3.8.f.m: When that is done, with one of these [cups], with the antaryāma cup, he draws the sāvitra [cup] from the āgrayaṇa [vessel] with [the mantra]: 'Today, O Savitṛ, desirable [wealth]...'

9.3.8.g.s: na sādayaty upaniṣkramya devāya savitre 'nubrūhi \ devāya savitre preṣya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.3.8.g.d: न सादयत्य् उपनिष्क्रम्य देवाय सवित्रे ऽनुब्रूहि \ देवाय सवित्रे प्रेष्य \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.3.8.g.m: He does not deposit [it]; having stepped out, he directs: 'Recite for god Savitṛ,' [and] 'Prompt [the hotṛ to offer] for god Savitṛ.'

9.3.8.h.s: hutvā nānuvaṣaṭkaroti na bhakṣayati sūdavat pātram̐ sādayati /
9.3.8.h.d: हुत्वा नानुवषट्करोति न भक्षयति सूदवत् पात्रम्̐ सादयति ।
9.3.8.h.m: Having offered, he does not perform the secondary vaṣaṭ-call, nor does he consume [it]; he deposits the cup as it was before.

9.3.8.i.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ suśarmāsi supratiṣṭhānas \\ ity etenaiva pātreṇābhakṣitena vaiśvadevaṃ kalaśāc chastravantaṃ gṛhṇāti /
9.3.8.i.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ सुशर्मासि सुप्रतिष्ठानस् \\ इत्य् एतेनैव पात्रेणाभक्षितेन वैश्वदेवं कलशाच् छस्त्रवन्तं गृह्णाति ।
9.3.8.i.m: With that very cup, unconsumed, with: 'You are taken with a support; you are well-protecting, well-grounded...,' he draws the vaiśvadeva [cup], accompanied by a śastra, from the dronakalaśa.

9.3.8.j.s: ekayā ca daśabhiś ca svabhūte \\ ity etasyām̐ śasyamānāyāṃ prātaryujau vimucyethām iti pratiprasthātā dvidevatyapātrāṇi vimucyāparayā dvārā nirhṛtya mārjālīye prakṣālya pūrvayā dvārā prapādyāyataneṣu sādayati /
9.3.8.j.d: एकया च दशभिश् च स्वभूते \\ इत्य् एतस्याम्̐ शस्यमानायां प्रातर्युजौ विमुच्येथाम् इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता द्विदेवत्यपात्राणि विमुच्यापरया द्वारा निर्हृत्य मार्जालीये प्रक्षाल्य पूर्वया द्वारा प्रपाद्यायतनेषु सादयति ।
9.3.8.j.m: While 'With one and with ten, O self-become...' is being recited [by the hotṛ], the pratiprasthātā, with 'May the two harnessed in the morning be unyoked,' unyokes the cups for the two deities, brings them out by the western door, washes them on the mārjālīya, brings them in by the eastern door, and deposits them in their places.

9.3.8.k.s: pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī ṛtāvṛdhā \\ ity etasyām̐ śasyamānāyām anyataratomodaṃ pratigṛṇāti modā moda ivothāmoda iva \\ iti /
9.3.8.k.d: प्र द्यावा यज्ञैः पृथिवी ऋतावृधा \\ इत्य् एतस्याम्̐ शस्यमानायाम् अन्यतरतोमोदं प्रतिगृणाति मोदा मोद इवोथामोद इव \\ इति ।
9.3.8.k.m: While 'Forth, O heaven and earth, by sacrifices, growing by order...' is being recited, he responds with the moda-response on one side: 'Joy, joy indeed! Exultation, joy indeed!'

9.3.8.m.s: ukthaṃ vācīndrāya \\ iti śastraṃ pratigīrya sarvatra tṛtīyasavane japati /
9.3.8.m.d: उक्थं वाचीन्द्राय \\ इति शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य सर्वत्र तृतीयसवने जपति ।
9.3.8.m.m: Having responded to the śastra, he murmurs everywhere at the third pressing: 'The hymn of praise has been spoken to Indra.'

9.3.8.n.s: śastraṃ pratigīrya graham ādatte camasām̐ś camasādhvaryavaḥ /
9.3.8.n.d: शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य ग्रहम् आदत्ते चमसाम्̐श् चमसाध्वर्यवः ।
9.3.8.n.m: Having responded to the śastra, he takes the cup, and the cup-adhvaryus their cups.

9.3.8.o.m: He proceeds with it as with the vaiśvadeva [cup] at the morning pressing.

9.4.9.a.m: He undertakes the rites [of the offering] to Soma, beginning with the arranging of the vessels.

9.4.9.b.m: He ladles out the caru for Soma.

9.4.9.d.s: ājyasyāvadāya ghṛtasya yaja \\ iti saṃpreṣyati vaṣaṭkṛte hutvā /
9.4.9.d.d: आज्यस्यावदाय घृतस्य यज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति वषट्कृते हुत्वा ।
9.4.9.d.m: having cut off [a portion] of clarified butter, he directs: 'Recite the offering verse for the ghee'; when the vaṣaṭ-call is made, having offered,

9.4.9.e.s: atraiva tiṣṭhan saumyasya hastena pūrvam avadānam avadyati mekṣaṇenottaram udaṅṅ atikramyāśrāvya pratyāśrāvite saumyasya yaja \\ iti saṃpreṣyati vaṣaṭkṛte dakṣiṇāmukhas tiṣṭhan dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhe juhoti /
9.4.9.e.d: अत्रैव तिष्ठन् सौम्यस्य हस्तेन पूर्वम् अवदानम् अवद्यति मेक्षणेनोत्तरम् उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्याश्राव्य प्रत्याश्राविते सौम्यस्य यज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति वषट्कृते दक्षिणामुखस् तिष्ठन् दक्षिणार्धपूर्वार्धे जुहोति ।
9.4.9.e.m: standing right there, he cuts off the first portion of the caru for Soma with his hand and the second with the stirring-stick; having stepped across to the north, having made the call and when the response is made, he directs: 'Recite the offering verse for Soma'; when the vaṣaṭ-call is made, standing facing south, he offers into the southeastern half.

9.4.9.f.m: 'Recite the offering verse for the ghee,' [he directs] as before.

9.4.9.g.m: Some teach the offering on the other side.

9.4.9.h.m: Having filled it with clarified butter, they carry it to the udgātṛs.

9.4.9.i.s: satro ta etad yad u ta iha \\ ity avekṣante /
9.4.9.i.d: सत्रो त एतद् यद् उ त इह \\ इत्य् अवेक्षन्ते ।
9.4.9.i.m: They look into it with: 'Soma-sacrificer, this is yours which is here in you...'

9.4.9.j.m: For in it they see themselves.

9.4.9.k.s: ya ātmānaṃ na paripaśyeditāsuḥ syād abhidadiṃ kṛtvā yan me manaḥ parāgatam ity avekṣeta /
9.4.9.k.d: य आत्मानं न परिपश्येदितासुः स्याद् अभिददिं कृत्वा यन् मे मनः परागतम् इत्य् अवेक्षेत ।
9.4.9.k.m: He who does not see himself, his life-breath would depart; having made a gift, he should look [into it] with: 'Whatever mind of mine has departed...'

9.4.9.l.m: One who is diseased or one who desires food should eat it;

9.4.9.m.s: yo vālam annādyāya san nānnam adyāt tena prāśyaḥ /
9.4.9.m.d: यो वालम् अन्नाद्याय सन् नान्नम् अद्यात् तेन प्राश्यः ।
9.4.9.m.m: or by him who, though capable of food, does not eat food, it is to be eaten.

9.4.9.n.m: With splinters [of wood], the āgnīdhra distributes the dhiṣṇya hearths so that they blaze.

9.4.9.o.s: navagṛhītam ājyam adhvaryur gṛhītvā jvalato vyāghārayati /
9.4.9.o.d: नवगृहीतम् आज्यम् अध्वर्युर् गृहीत्वा ज्वलतो व्याघारयति ।
9.4.9.o.m: The adhvaryu, having taken clarified butter in nine drawings, sprinkles [the hearths] while they blaze.

9.4.9.p.m: He leaves a residue of the clarified butter; they keep the dhiṣṇya hearths [alight].

9.4.9.q.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ bṛhaspatisutasya te \\ ity upām̐śupātreṇa pātnīvatam āgrayaṇād gṛhṇāti /
9.4.9.q.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ बृहस्पतिसुतस्य ते \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुपात्रेण पात्नीवतम् आग्रयणाद् गृह्णाति ।
9.4.9.q.m: With: 'You are taken with a support; of you, pressed by Bṛhaspati...,' he draws the pātnīvata [cup] from the āgrayaṇa [vessel] with the upāṃśu cup.

9.4.9.r.m: Having mixed it with clarified butter from the residue of the sprinkling of the dhiṣṇya hearths, he does not deposit it.

9.4.9.s.s: upaniṣkramya \\ agnīt pātnīvatasya yaja \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.4.9.s.d: उपनिष्क्रम्य \\ अग्नीत् पात्नीवतस्य यज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.4.9.s.m: Having stepped out, he directs: 'Āgnīdhra, recite the offering verse for the pātnīvata.'

9.4.9.t.m: When the vaṣaṭ-call is made with 'O Agni, possessing a wife!', he offers.

9.4.9.v.m: According to some, he performs the secondary vaṣaṭ-call inaudibly.

9.4.9.w.s: agnīn neṣṭur upastham āsīda \ neṣṭaḥ patnīm udānaya \\ udgātrā patnīm̐ saṃkhyāpaya \\ unnetar hotṛcamasamukhyām̐ś camasān unnayan hotṛcamase dhruvāyāvakāśaṃ kuru \ sarvam̐ rājānam unnaya mātirīrico daśābhiḥ kalaśau mṛṣṭvā nyubja \\ iti saṃpreṣyati //
9.4.9.w.d: अग्नीन् नेष्टुर् उपस्थम् आसीद \ नेष्टः पत्नीम् उदानय \\ उद्गात्रा पत्नीम्̐ संख्यापय \\ उन्नेतर् होतृचमसमुख्याम्̐श् चमसान् उन्नयन् होतृचमसे ध्रुवायावकाशं कुरु \ सर्वम्̐ राजानम् उन्नय मातिरीरिचो दशाभिः कलशौ मृष्ट्वा न्युब्ज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ॥
9.4.9.w.m: He directs: 'Āgnīdhra, sit in the lap of the neṣṭṛ; neṣṭṛ, bring up the sacrificer's wife; cause the sacrificer's wife to look toward the udgātṛ; unnetṛ, drawing the cups of which the hotṛ's cup is the foremost, make space for the dhruvā cup in the hotṛ's cup; draw all the King [Soma], do not leave any surplus, wipe the two tubs with the fringes and turn them upside down.'

9.4.10.a.s: antarā neṣṭāraṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ cāgnīdhro vyavasṛpya bhakṣayaty upasthe vā neṣṭur āsīno nopastha āsīta yady upastha āsīta klībaḥ syāt /
9.4.10.a.d: अन्तरा नेष्टारं धिष्णियं चाग्नीध्रो व्यवसृप्य भक्षयत्य् उपस्थे वा नेष्टुर् आसीनो नोपस्थ आसीत यद्य् उपस्थ आसीत क्लीबः स्यात् ।
9.4.10.a.m: Having crept between the neṣṭṛ and the dhiṣṇya hearth, the āgnīdhra consumes [it], or sitting in the lap of the neṣṭṛ; he should not sit in the lap: if he should sit in the lap, he would become impotent.

9.4.10.b.m: He draws the cups of which the hotṛ's cup is the foremost.

9.4.10.d.m: Having kindled the dhiṣṇya hearths, he brings forward the Agniṣṭoma chant.

9.4.10.e.s: avisrasya nīvīr āvir iva nābhīḥ kurvāṇāḥ sarve sakarṇaprāvṛtā bhavanti /
9.4.10.e.d: अविस्रस्य नीवीर् आविर् इव नाभीः कुर्वाणाः सर्वे सकर्णप्रावृता भवन्ति ।
9.4.10.e.m: Without untying their waist-tucks, making their navels as if visible, all [remain] with their ears covered.

9.4.10.g.m: according to some, the officiating priests and the sacrificer [also].

9.4.10.h.s: viśvasya te viśvāvato vṛṣṇiyāvatas \\ ity udgātrā patnīm̐ saṃkhyāpayati /
9.4.10.h.d: विश्वस्य ते विश्वावतो वृष्णियावतस् \\ इत्य् उद्गात्रा पत्नीम्̐ संख्यापयति ।
9.4.10.h.m: With: 'Of thee, who possessest all, who art full of seed...', he causes the sacrificer's wife to look toward the udgātṛ.

9.4.10.i.s: agan devān yajñas \\ iti patnī dakṣiṇam ūruṃ nagnaṃkṛtya vaṅkṣaṇānāviṣkṛtya /
9.4.10.i.d: अगन् देवान् यज्ञस् \\ इति पत्नी दक्षिणम् ऊरुं नग्नंकृत्य वङ्क्षणानाविष्कृत्य ।
9.4.10.i.m: With: 'The sacrifice has gone to the gods,' the sacrificer's wife baring her right thigh, exposing her groin;

9.4.10.j.s: svāhākṛtāḥ samudreṣṭhās \\ ity abhyantaram ūror udīcī patnī pannejanīr ūruṇopapravartayati /
9.4.10.j.d: स्वाहाकृताः समुद्रेष्ठास् \\ इत्य् अभ्यन्तरम् ऊरोर् उदीची पत्नी पन्नेजनीर् ऊरुणोपप्रवर्तयति ।
9.4.10.j.m: with: 'Hallowed by svāhā, standing in the ocean...', the sacrificer's wife, facing north, rolls the foot-washing water along the inner side of her thigh with her thigh.

9.4.10.k.s: saṃkhyāpanam upapravartanaṃ cā tṛtīyasyāḥ stotrīyāyāḥ kriyate /
9.4.10.k.d: संख्यापनम् उपप्रवर्तनं चा तृतीयस्याः स्तोत्रीयायाः क्रियते ।
9.4.10.k.m: The causing to look and the rolling along are performed until the third stotriya verse.

9.4.10.l.s: svāduṣ kilāyaṃ madhumām̐ utāyam ity etasyām̐ śasyamānāyām ubhayatomodaṃ pratigṛṇāti madā moda iva \ modā moda iva \\ ity āhāvād ūrdhvaṃ vyāhāvāt siddhaḥ pratigaraḥ /
9.4.10.l.d: स्वादुष् किलायं मधुमाम्̐ उतायम् इत्य् एतस्याम्̐ शस्यमानायाम् उभयतोमोदं प्रतिगृणाति मदा मोद इव \ मोदा मोद इव \\ इत्य् आहावाद् ऊर्ध्वं व्याहावात् सिद्धः प्रतिगरः ।
9.4.10.l.m: While 'Sweet indeed is this, and honeyed is this...' is being recited, he responds with the moda-response on both sides: 'Joy, joy indeed! Exultation, joy indeed!'; after the call, following the alternate call, the response is established.

9.4.10.m.s: bhūtam asi bhūte mā dhās \\ iti pratiprasthātā dhruvam abhimantrayate /
9.4.10.m.d: भूतम् असि भूते मा धास् \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता ध्रुवम् अभिमन्त्रयते ।
9.4.10.m.m: With: 'Thou art being; place me in being,' the pratiprasthātā addresses the dhruva cup.

9.4.10.n.m: With: 'I take hold of thee for heaven and earth,' he takes hold of it.

9.4.10.o.s: viśve tvā devā vaiśvānarāḥ pracyāvayantu \\ iti dhruvam̐ sthānāt pracyāvayati /
9.4.10.o.d: विश्वे त्वा देवा वैश्वानराः प्रच्यावयन्तु \\ इति ध्रुवम्̐ स्थानात् प्रच्यावयति ।
9.4.10.o.m: With: 'May the Viśve Devas, Vaiśvānaras, dislodge thee,' he moves the dhruva cup from its place.

9.4.10.p.s: divi devān dṛm̐hāntarikṣe vayām̐si \\ iti harati /
9.4.10.p.d: दिवि देवान् दृम्̐हान्तरिक्षे वयाम्̐सि \\ इति हरति ।
9.4.10.p.m: With: 'Strengthen the gods in heaven, the birds in the atmosphere,' he carries it.

9.4.10.q.s: dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣā \\ ava somaṃ nayāmasi \\ iti hotṛcamase dhruvam avanayati paridhānīyāyām̐ śasyamānāyām̐ sakṛcchastāyām ādito vā śastrasya //
9.4.10.q.d: ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषा \\ अव सोमं नयामसि \\ इति होतृचमसे ध्रुवम् अवनयति परिधानीयायाम्̐ शस्यमानायाम्̐ सकृच्छस्तायाम् आदितो वा शस्त्रस्य ॥
9.4.10.q.m: With: 'The steadfast with the steadfast oblation, / we pour down the Soma,' he pours the dhruva cup into the hotṛ's cup while the concluding verse is being recited, or when it has been recited once, or at the beginning of the śastra,

9.4.11.b.s: śastraṃ pratigīrya hotṛcamasam adhvaryur ādatte camasām̐ś camasādhvaryavas \\ ukthaśā yaja somānām iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.4.11.b.d: शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य होतृचमसम् अध्वर्युर् आदत्ते चमसाम्̐श् चमसाध्वर्यवस् \\ उक्थशा यज सोमानाम् इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.4.11.b.m: Having responded to the śastra, the adhvaryu takes the hotṛ's cup, and the cup-adhvaryus their cups; he directs: 'Reciter of the uktha, recite the offering verse for the Somas.'

9.4.11.c.m: The consumption of the cups has been explained.

9.4.11.d.m: They are consumed in their entirety; there is no swelling nor depositing.

9.4.11.e.s: agnīd aupayajān aṅgārān āhara \\ ity etatprabhṛti pāśukaṃ karma pratipadyate /
9.4.11.e.d: अग्नीद् औपयजान् अङ्गारान् आहर \\ इत्य् एतत्प्रभृति पाशुकं कर्म प्रतिपद्यते ।
9.4.11.e.m: Beginning with 'Āgnīdhra, bring the coals for the subsidiary offerings,' he undertakes the animal rite.

9.4.11.f.s: nānūyājānte svaruṃ juhoti na hṛdayaśūlena caranti yady anūbandhyā bhavati /
9.4.11.f.d: नानूयाजान्ते स्वरुं जुहोति न हृदयशूलेन चरन्ति यद्य् अनूबन्ध्या भवति ।
9.4.11.f.m: He does not offer the chip of sacrificial post at the end of the after-offerings, nor do they proceed with the heart-spit, if there is a concluding animal sacrifice.

9.4.11.g.m: When the enclosing sticks have been cast [into the fire], having made an oblation with the rinsings, they proceed with the hāriyojana cup.

9.4.11.h.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ harir asi hāriyojanas \\ ity unnetā droṇakalaśena hāriyojanam̐ sarvam āgrayaṇaṃ gṛhṇāti /
9.4.11.h.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ हरिर् असि हारियोजनस् \\ इत्य् उन्नेता द्रोणकलशेन हारियोजनम्̐ सर्वम् आग्रयणं गृह्णाति ।
9.4.11.h.m: With the mantra, "You are taken with a support; you are the bay horse, belonging to the yoker of bay horses," the unnetṛ priest draws the entire āgrayaṇa cup as the hāriyojana cup by means of the droṇakalaśā trough.

9.4.11.i.s: taṃ bahvībhir dhānābhiḥ śrītvā na sādayati /
9.4.11.i.d: तं बह्वीभिर् धानाभिः श्रीत्वा न सादयति ।
9.4.11.i.m: Having mixed it with many parched grains, he does not set it down.

9.4.11.j.s: śīrṣann adhi nidhāyopaniṣkramya \\ indrāya harivate 'nubrūhi \\ indrāya harivate preṣya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati dhānāsomebhyo 'nubrūhi \ dhānāsomān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti vā /
9.4.11.j.d: शीर्षन्न् अधि निधायोपनिष्क्रम्य \\ इन्द्राय हरिवते ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इन्द्राय हरिवते प्रेष्य \\ इति संप्रेष्यति धानासोमेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \ धानासोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति वा ।
9.4.11.j.m: Having placed it upon his head and stepped forth, he issues the ritual direction: "Recite for Indra, lord of the bay horses! Prompt [the hotṛ to offer] for Indra, lord of the bay horses!" or: "Recite for the parched grains and soma! Prompt [the hotṛ to offer] for the parched grains and soma that have been set forth!"

9.4.11.k.s: harīḥ stha haryor dhānās \\ iti vikramya vaṣaṭkṛte juhoty anuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā harati bhakṣam /
9.4.11.k.d: हरीः स्थ हर्योर् धानास् \\ इति विक्रम्य वषट्कृते जुहोत्य् अनुवषट्कृते हुत्वा हरति भक्षम् ।
9.4.11.k.m: Stepping out with the words, "You are the bay horses; you are the parched grains of the two bay horses," when the vaṣaṭ call is uttered, he offers; when the anuvaṣaṭ call is uttered, having made the offering, he brings the portion for consumption.

9.4.11.l.s: tam̐ sarve samaśaḥ prativibhajyonnetary upahavam iṣṭvā \\ iṣṭayajuṣas te deva soma \\ iti ciściṣākāraṃ dhānā bhakṣayanti /
9.4.11.l.d: तम्̐ सर्वे समशः प्रतिविभज्योन्नेतर्य् उपहवम् इष्ट्वा \\ इष्टयजुषस् ते देव सोम \\ इति चिश्चिषाकारं धाना भक्षयन्ति ।
9.4.11.l.m: Having divided it equally among all, and having sought invitation through the unnetṛ priest, they consume the parched grains making a crunching sound, with the mantra: "Of you, whose yajus formulas have been offered, O divine soma..."

9.4.11.m.m: Biting [them] without breaking [them with teeth], making hollows of the parched grains, and casting [the residue] out.

9.4.11.n.s: āpūryāḥ sthā mā pūrayata \\ ity uttaravedyāṃ dhānā niṣṭhīvyopavapanti rayyai tvā \ poṣāya tvā \\ iti vā /
9.4.11.n.d: आपूर्याः स्था मा पूरयत \\ इत्य् उत्तरवेद्यां धाना निष्ठीव्योपवपन्ति रय्यै त्वा \ पोषाय त्वा \\ इति वा ।
9.4.11.n.m: With the mantra, "You are the fulfillers; do you fill me!" they spit out the parched grains onto the uttaravedī and scatter them, or with: "For wealth, for you! For prosperity, for you!"

9.4.11.o.s: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam ity āgnīdhrāgāre dadhidrapsān bhakṣayanti /
9.4.11.o.d: दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषम् इत्य् आग्नीध्रागारे दधिद्रप्सान् भक्षयन्ति ।
9.4.11.o.m: With the mantra, "I have praised Dadhikrāvan..." they consume the curds-drops in the āgnīdhra fire chamber.

9.4.11.p.s: ekadhanapariśeṣān yathācamasaṃ vyāsicya hariṇīr dūrvāḥ saṃplomnāyya tīvrīkṛtya rasaṃ janayitvā \\ apsu dhautasya soma deva te \\ iti rasam avaghreṇa bhakṣayitvā cātvāle 'vanayanti /
9.4.11.p.d: एकधनपरिशेषान् यथाचमसं व्यासिच्य हरिणीर् दूर्वाः संप्लोम्नाय्य तीव्रीकृत्य रसं जनयित्वा \\ अप्सु धौतस्य सोम देव ते \\ इति रसम् अवघ्रेण भक्षयित्वा चात्वाले ऽवनयन्ति ।
9.4.11.p.m: Having poured out the remnants of the ekadhana waters according to their cups, having gathered green dūrvā grass and made it pungent, thus generating juice, and having consumed the juice by smelling it with the mantra, "Of you, washed in water, O divine soma..." they pour it into the cātvāla pit.

9.4.11.q.s: yan ma ātmano mindābhūt \\ iti mindayāhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante //
9.4.11.q.d: यन् म आत्मनो मिन्दाभूत् \\ इति मिन्दयाहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते ॥
9.4.11.q.m: With the mindā verse, "Whatever blemish has come to my self..." they attend upon the āhavanīya fire.

9.4.12.a.s: devakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \ manuṣyakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \ pitṛkṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \\ ātmakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \ parakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \\ enasa enaso 'vayajanam asi \ yac cāham eno vidvām̐ś cakāra yac cāvidvām̐s tasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \\ iti pratimantram āhavanīye śakalān abhyādadhati /
9.4.12.a.d: देवकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \ मनुष्यकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \ पितृकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \\ आत्मकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \ परकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \\ एनस एनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \ यच् चाहम् एनो विद्वाम्̐श् चकार यच् चाविद्वाम्̐स् तस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \\ इति प्रतिमन्त्रम् आहवनीये शकलान् अभ्यादधति ।
9.4.12.a.m: With each mantra: "You are the expiation of sin caused by the gods; you are the expiation of sin caused by men; you are the expiation of sin caused by the ancestors; you are the expiation of sin caused by oneself; you are the expiation of sin caused by another; you are the expiation of sin upon sin; and what sin I committed knowingly and what sin unknowingly, of that sin you are the expiation" — they throw wood splinters onto the āhavanīya fire.

9.4.12.b.s: ubhā kavī yuvānā \ satyādā dharmaṇaspatī / \ satyasya dharmaṇaspate \ vi sakhyāni sṛjāmahe \\ iti sakhyāni visṛjante /
9.4.12.b.d: उभा कवी युवाना \ सत्यादा धर्मणस्पती । \ सत्यस्य धर्मणस्पते \ वि सख्यानि सृजामहे \\ इति सख्यानि विसृजन्ते ।
9.4.12.b.m: With the verse, "Both sages, youthful, truth-receivers, lords of cosmic order; O lord of truth, of cosmic order, we dissolve our bonds of friendship" — they dissolve the bonds of friendship.

9.4.12.c.m: When the veda broom is touched, they perform the panī offerings.

9.4.12.d.s: stīrṇe vede navagṛhītam ājyam adhvaryur gṛhītvā dhātā rātis \\ ity antarvedy ūrdhvas tiṣṭhañ juhvāhavanīye nava samiṣṭayajūm̐ṣi juhoti /
9.4.12.d.d: स्तीर्णे वेदे नवगृहीतम् आज्यम् अध्वर्युर् गृहीत्वा धाता रातिस् \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेद्य् ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठञ् जुह्वाहवनीये नव समिष्टयजूम्̐षि जुहोति ।
9.4.12.d.m: When the veda broom has been spread out, the adhvaryu, having taken nine ladlings of clarified butter, standing erect inside the altar, offers the nine samiṣṭayajus oblations into the āhavanīya fire with the juhū ladle, with the verse: "Dhātṛ is generosity..."

9.4.12.e.s: yaṃ kāmayeta pramāyukaḥ syād iti sruveṇa tasya jihmas tiṣṭham̐s tūṣṇīṃ prahvo vā /
9.4.12.e.d: यं कामयेत प्रमायुकः स्याद् इति स्रुवेण तस्य जिह्मस् तिष्ठम्̐स् तूष्णीं प्रह्वो वा ।
9.4.12.e.m: For one whom he desires, "May he perish," he stands askew or bent low, [offering] silently with the dipping spoon.

9.4.12.f.s: idaṃ tṛtīyam̐ savanaṃ kavīnām iti sam̐sthite juhoti /
9.4.12.f.d: इदं तृतीयम्̐ सवनं कवीनाम् इति सम्̐स्थिते जुहोति ।
9.4.12.f.m: When it is concluded, he offers with the mantra: "This is the third pressing of the sages..."

9.4.12.g.s: praśāstaḥ prasuva \\ iti saṃpreṣyati sarpata \\ ity āha praśāstā saṃtiṣṭhate tṛtīyasavanam //
9.4.12.g.d: प्रशास्तः प्रसुव \\ इति संप्रेष्यति सर्पत \\ इत्य् आह प्रशास्ता संतिष्ठते तृतीयसवनम् ॥
9.4.12.g.m: He gives the ritual direction: "O director, prompt!" The director says: "Creep forward!" The third pressing is concluded.

9.5.13.a.m: He commences the framework of the purificatory bath.

9.5.13.b.m: Whatever is performed there, that we shall explain.

9.5.13.c.s: agnīn anvādhāya vedaṃ kṛtvāgīn paristīrya pāṇī prakṣālyolaparājīm̐ stīrtvā yathārthaṃ pātrāṇi prayunakti /
9.5.13.c.d: अग्नीन् अन्वाधाय वेदं कृत्वागीन् परिस्तीर्य पाणी प्रक्षाल्योलपराजीम्̐ स्तीर्त्वा यथार्थं पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति ।
9.5.13.c.m: Having fueled the fires, fashioned the veda broom, strewn around the fires, washed his hands, and strewn a row of coarse grass, he sets out the sacrificial utensils according to need.

9.5.13.e.m: At the time of apportioning the oblation, he apportions an oblation for Varuṇa on a single potsherd.

9.5.13.f.m: He mixes the flour with water purified by means of a mantra.

9.5.13.g.m: Having poured the washings of the dough for the one that covers, he proceeds with the ritual direction.

9.5.13.h.s: yad anyad idhmābarhiṣaḥ patnīsaṃhanāc ca tat saṃpreṣyati /
9.5.13.h.d: यद् अन्यद् इध्माबर्हिषः पत्नीसंहनाच् च तत् संप्रेष्यति ।
9.5.13.h.m: Whatever is other than the kindling wood and sacred grass, and other than the girding of the sacrificer's wife, that he directs.

9.5.13.i.s: yat prāg ājyagrahaṇāt tat kṛtvā pratihṛtya gārhapatya ājyāni gṛhṇāti /
9.5.13.i.d: यत् प्राग् आज्यग्रहणात् तत् कृत्वा प्रतिहृत्य गार्हपत्य आज्यानि गृह्णाति ।
9.5.13.i.m: Having performed whatever precedes the taking of clarified butter, he turns around and takes the portions of clarified butter at the gārhapatya fire.

9.5.13.j.m: All [offerings consist of] four ladlings, or twice in the upabhṙt ladle.

9.5.13.k.d: अलंकृत्य पुरोडाशम् उत्तरे ऽम्̐से ऽवभृथम्̐ सम्̐सादयति ।
9.5.13.k.m: Having garnished the sacrificial cake, he places together the materials of the purificatory bath at the northern shoulder [of the altar]:

9.5.13.l.s: puroḍāśam ājyāny audumbarīm adhiṣavaṇaphalake ravarapām̐sūn ṛjīṣaṃ ca yat kiṃca somaliptam anyatra catasṛbhyaḥ somasthālībhya āgrayaṇasthālyā ukthyasthālyā ādityasthālyā dhruvasthālyāḥ /
9.5.13.l.d: पुरोडाशम् आज्यान्य् औदुम्बरीम् अधिषवणफलके रवरपाम्̐सून् ऋजीषं च यत् किंच सोमलिप्तम् अन्यत्र चतसृभ्यः सोमस्थालीभ्य आग्रयणस्थाल्या उक्थ्यस्थाल्या आदित्यस्थाल्या ध्रुवस्थाल्याः ।
9.5.13.l.m: The sacrificial cake, the clarified butter portions, the post of udumbara wood, the two pressing boards, the dust of the sound-holes, the soma residue, and whatever is smeared with soma, except for the four soma jars, namely the āgrayaṇasthālī, the ukthyasthālī, the ādityasthālī, and the dhruvasthālī.

9.5.13.m.s: āyurdā agne haviṣo juṣāṇas \\ iti juhoti yatarasminn agnau śrapayati /
9.5.13.m.d: आयुर्दा अग्ने हविषो जुषाणस् \\ इति जुहोति यतरस्मिन्न् अग्नौ श्रपयति ।
9.5.13.m.m: With the mantra, "O Agni, giver of life, enjoying the oblation..." he offers on whichever fire he cooks [the sacrificial cake].

9.5.13.o.s: prastotaḥ sāmāni gāya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati saha patnyā triḥ sarve sāmno nidhanam upayanti /
9.5.13.o.d: प्रस्तोतः सामानि गाय \\ इति संप्रेष्यति सह पत्न्या त्रिः सर्वे साम्नो निधनम् उपयन्ति ।
9.5.13.o.m: he gives the ritual direction: "O prastotṛ, sing the sāman chants!" Together with the sacrificer's wife, they all join three times in the finale of the sāman.

9.5.13.p.s: urum̐ hi rājā varuṇaś cakāra \\ iti cātvālaṃ gatvā vadanti cātvālād vā prayānto vadanti /
9.5.13.p.d: उरुम्̐ हि राजा वरुणश् चकार \\ इति चात्वालं गत्वा वदन्ति चात्वालाद् वा प्रयान्तो वदन्ति ।
9.5.13.p.m: With the verse, "King Varuṇa has made a broad path..." they speak having gone to the cātvāla pit, or they speak while proceeding from the cātvāla pit.

9.5.13.q.m: They step out towards the north between the cātvāla pit and the rubbish heap.

9.5.13.r.m: Going to the purificatory bath in any direction is handed down by tradition.

9.5.13.s.m: "One must not proceed via the north," say some authorities.

9.5.13.t.s: madhyadeśe dvitīyam̐ sāmno nidhanam upayanty udakānte tṛtīyam /
9.5.13.t.d: मध्यदेशे द्वितीयम्̐ साम्नो निधनम् उपयन्त्य् उदकान्ते तृतीयम् ।
9.5.13.t.m: They join in the second finale of the sāman in the intermediate region, and the third at the edge of the water.

9.5.13.u.s: śataṃ te rājan bhiṣajaḥ sahasram ity apo dṛṣṭvā japanti /
9.5.13.u.d: शतं ते राजन् भिषजः सहस्रम् इत्य् अपो दृष्ट्वा जपन्ति ।
9.5.13.u.m: Having seen the water, they murmur: "A hundred are your physicians, O King, a thousand..."

9.5.13.v.s: abhiṣṭhito varuṇasya pāśas \\ ity udakāntam abhitiṣṭhanti /
9.5.13.v.d: अभिष्ठितो वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इत्य् उदकान्तम् अभितिष्ठन्ति ।
9.5.13.v.m: They step upon the edge of the water with the words: "Stepped upon is the noose of Varuṇa."

9.5.13.w.m: Having stepped into the water, standing, they perform the rites of the purificatory bath.

9.5.13.x.s: oḍhāsu devatāsūdakam upavājya sruvāghāram āghārya \\ agnīd udakaṃ triḥ saṃmṛḍḍhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.5.13.x.d: ओढासु देवतासूदकम् उपवाज्य स्रुवाघारम् आघार्य \\ अग्नीद् उदकं त्रिः संमृड्ढि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.5.13.x.m: When the deities have been invoked, having fanned the water, and having poured the continuous stream of clarified butter with the dipping spoon, he directs: "O āgnīdhra, cleanse the water three times!"

9.5.13.y.m: When it has been cleansed, having thrown a blade of grass into the water,

9.5.13.z.s: agner anīkam apa āviveśa \\ iti srucyam āghārayati /
9.5.13.z.d: अग्नेर् अनीकम् अप आविवेश \\ इति स्रुच्यम् आघारयति ।
9.5.13.z.m: with the mantra, "The face of Agni has entered the water..." he pours clarified butter with the offering ladle.

9.5.13.aa.m: He chooses the ancestral invocation just as at the upasads.

9.5.14.a.m: "Stand!" — this is the extent of the ancestral invocation.

9.5.14.b.m: He performs the fore-offerings without the one concerning the sacred grass.

9.5.14.c.m: He does not bring together the clarified butter from the upabhṙt ladle.

9.5.14.d.m: The two clarified butter portions contain verses with the word 'water' [ap].

9.5.14.e.m: Having proceeded with those two, he sacrifices to Varuṇa with the sacrificial cake.

9.5.14.f.m: Having cut off the entire sacrificial cake, he sacrifices to Agni and Varuṇa as the two Sviṣṭakṛts.

9.5.14.g.s: agnīd udakam̐ sakṛt saṃmṛḍḍhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
9.5.14.g.d: अग्नीद् उदकम्̐ सकृत् संमृड्ढि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
9.5.14.g.m: He gives the ritual direction: "O āgnīdhra, cleanse the water once!"

9.5.14.h.s: apabarhiṣāv anūyājau yajati devau yaja yaja \\ iti pūrvam anūyājam̐ saṃpreṣyati yaja \\ ity uttaram /
9.5.14.h.d: अपबर्हिषाव् अनूयाजौ यजति देवौ यज यज \\ इति पूर्वम् अनूयाजम्̐ संप्रेष्यति यज \\ इत्य् उत्तरम् ।
9.5.14.h.m: He offers the two after-offerings without the one concerning sacred grass. For the first after-offering he gives the direction: "Sacrifice to the two gods, sacrifice!" For the latter: "Sacrifice!"

9.5.14.j.s: yat te grāvṇā cicchiduḥ soma rājan \ priyāṇy aṅgāni svadhitā parūm̐ṣi / \ tat saṃdhatsvājyenota vardhayasva \\ anāgaso adham it saṃkṣayema / \ yat te grāvā bāhucyuto acucyavur \ naro yat te duduhur dakṣiṇena / \ tat ta āpyāyatāṃ tat te \ niṣṭhyāyatāṃ deva soma / \ yat te tvacaṃ bibhidur yac ca yonim \\ yad āsthānāt pracyuto venasi tmanā / \ tvayā tat soma guptam astu naḥ \ sā naḥ saṃdhāsat parame vyoman / \ ahāc charīraṃ payasā sametya \\ anyo'nyo bhavati varṇo asya / \ tasmin vayam upahūtās tava smas \\ ā no bhaja sadasi viśvarūpe \\ iti catasṛbhir udumbaraśākhayā dadhnarjīṣam abhijuhoti pañcabhiḥ saptabhir navabhir ekādaśabhis trayodaśabhir vā /
9.5.14.j.d: यत् ते ग्राव्णा चिच्छिदुः सोम राजन् \ प्रियाण्य् अङ्गानि स्वधिता परूम्̐षि । \ तत् संधत्स्वाज्येनोत वर्धयस्व \\ अनागसो अधम् इत् संक्षयेम । \ यत् ते ग्रावा बाहुच्युतो अचुच्यवुर् \ नरो यत् ते दुदुहुर् दक्षिणेन । \ तत् त आप्यायतां तत् ते \ निष्ठ्यायतां देव सोम । \ यत् ते त्वचं बिभिदुर् यच् च योनिम् \\ यद् आस्थानात् प्रच्युतो वेनसि त्मना । \ त्वया तत् सोम गुप्तम् अस्तु नः \ सा नः संधासत् परमे व्योमन् । \ अहाच् छरीरं पयसा समेत्य \\ अन्योऽन्यो भवति वर्णो अस्य । \ तस्मिन् वयम् उपहूतास् तव स्मस् \\ आ नो भज सदसि विश्वरूपे \\ इति चतसृभिर् उदुम्बरशाखया दध्नर्जीषम् अभिजुहोति पञ्चभिः सप्तभिर् नवभिर् एकादशभिस् त्रयोदशभिर् वा ।
9.5.14.j.m: With four verses: / "Whatever of your dear limbs the stones cut off, O King Soma, / whatever joints the sacrificial knife [severed], / heal that with clarified butter and increase; / guiltless, may we dwell together! / / Whatever of you the stones shaken by arms caused to fall, / whatever the men milked with the right hand, / may that swell for you, may that solidify for you, O divine Soma! / / Because they pierced your skin and your womb, / because fallen from your place you yearn in your heart, / by you, O Soma, let that be guarded for us; / may that be our union in the highest heaven! / / Leaving behind his body, having united with milk, / he assumes one color after another; / invited to that [place] of yours we are, / grant us a share in the all-formed assembly!" / with a branch of the udumbara tree, he offers curds over the soma residue, with four, five, seven, nine, eleven, or thirteen [verses].

9.5.14.k.s: ṛjīṣasya srucaṃ pūrayitvā samudre te hṛdayam ity apsūpamārayati /
9.5.14.k.d: ऋजीषस्य स्रुचं पूरयित्वा समुद्रे ते हृदयम् इत्य् अप्सूपमारयति ।
9.5.14.k.m: Having filled an offering ladle with soma residue, he dips it into the water with [the mantra]: 'Thy heart is in the ocean...'

9.5.14.l.s: apsu dhautasya soma deva te \\ iti yo bhindūnām uccarati tam avaghreṇa bhakṣayaty upaspṛśati vā /
9.5.14.l.d: अप्सु धौतस्य सोम देव ते \\ इति यो भिन्दूनाम् उच्चरति तम् अवघ्रेण भक्षयत्य् उपस्पृशति वा ।
9.5.14.l.m: With: 'Of thee, O divine Soma, washed in the waters...', he consumes by smelling or touches whatever [drop] rises up from the drops.

9.5.14.m.m: With: 'O purificatory bath, downward-moving...', they throw in [the equipment of] the purificatory bath.

9.5.14.n.m: With: 'O divine waters...', they revere [the waters].

9.5.14.o.m: With: 'Kind to us...', they purify themselves.

9.5.15.a.s: unnetar vasīyo na unnayābhi \\ ud u tye madhumattamās \\ giraḥ stomāsa īrate \ satrājito dhanasā akṣitotayas \\ vājayanto rathā iva \ kaṇvā iva bhṛgavaḥ sūryā iva \ viśvam id dhītam ānaśur ity unnetāram̐ saṃpreṣyati /
9.5.15.a.d: उन्नेतर् वसीयो न उन्नयाभि \\ उद् उ त्ये मधुमत्तमास् \\ गिरः स्तोमास ईरते \ सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयस् \\ वाजयन्तो रथा इव \ कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव \ विश्वम् इद् धीतम् आनशुर् इत्य् उन्नेतारम्̐ संप्रेष्यति ।
9.5.15.a.m: He directs the unnetṛ: 'O unnetṛ, lead us up to better fortune. / Upward indeed those sweetest / songs, the chants arise, / winning everywhere, gaining wealth, of unexhausted aid, / striving for prize like chariots; / like the Kaṇvas, like the Bhṛgus, like the suns, / they have attained all that is meditated upon.'

9.5.15.b.s: ud eta prajām uta varco dadhānās \\ yuṣmān rāya uta yajñā asṛkṣata / \ gāyatraṃ chando 'nusam̐rabhadhvam \ athā syāma surabhayo gṛheṣu \\ ity unnetā hotṛprathamān yajamānaprathamān vonnayati /
9.5.15.b.d: उद् एत प्रजाम् उत वर्चो दधानास् \\ युष्मान् राय उत यज्ञा असृक्षत । \ गायत्रं छन्दो ऽनुसम्̐रभध्वम् \ अथा स्याम सुरभयो गृहेषु \\ इत्य् उन्नेता होतृप्रथमान् यजमानप्रथमान् वोन्नयति ।
9.5.15.b.m: The unnetṛ leads them out, with the hotṛ first or with the sacrificer first, with: 'Come up, bearing offspring and luster! / Wealth and sacrifices have reached you. / Take hold along with the gāyatrī metre; / then may we be fragrant in our homes.'

9.5.15.c.s: pratiyuto varuṇasya pāśas \\ ity udakāntaṃ pratiyauti /
9.5.15.c.d: प्रतियुतो वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इत्य् उदकान्तं प्रतियौति ।
9.5.15.c.m: With: 'Averted is Varuṇa's noose...', he stirs back the edge of the water.

9.5.15.d.s: pratyasto varuṇasya pāśas \\ ity udakāntaṃ pratyasya /
9.5.15.d.d: प्रत्यस्तो वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इत्य् उदकान्तं प्रत्यस्य ।
9.5.15.d.m: With: 'Cast away is Varuṇa's noose...', having thrown [water] against the water's edge,

9.5.15.f.s: apāma somam amṛtā abhūma \\ iti mahīyāṃ japantaḥ / unnetāraṃ puras kṛtvāpratīkṣam āyanti /
9.5.15.f.d: अपाम सोमम् अमृता अभूम \\ इति महीयां जपन्तः । उन्नेतारं पुरस् कृत्वाप्रतीक्षम् आयन्ति ।
9.5.15.f.m: murmuring the Mahīyā [verse]: 'We have drunk Soma, we have become immortal...', placing the unnetṛ in front, they walk without looking back.

9.5.15.g.m: Beyond the cow-pen, they purify themselves.

9.5.15.h.d: एधो ऽस्य् एधिषीमहि \\ इत्य् आहवनीये समिधो ऽभ्यादधति ।
9.5.15.h.m: With: 'Thou art fuel, may we flourish...', they place the kindling sticks onto the āhavanīya fire.

9.5.15.i.m: With: 'I have gone along the waters...', they stand revering [the fire].

9.5.15.j.m: Likewise the sacrificer's wife, having laid [firewood] on the gārhapatya fire, stands revering [it].

9.6.16.a.m: In the eastern hall, he sets in motion the sacrificial framework of the concluding rite.

9.6.16.b.m: Its procedure is explained by [that of] the introductory rite.

9.6.16.c.m: He ties up the after-offering firewood stick.

9.6.16.d.s: yasyām̐ sthālyāṃ prāyaṇīyam̐ śrapayati tasyām̐ saniṣkāsāyāṃ tena mekṣaṇena śrapayati /
9.6.16.d.d: यस्याम्̐ स्थाल्यां प्रायणीयम्̐ श्रपयति तस्याम्̐ सनिष्कासायां तेन मेक्षणेन श्रपयति ।
9.6.16.d.m: In the same cooking-pot in which he cooks the introductory [mess of boiled rice], while it still has scrapings in it, he cooks with the same stirring stick.

9.6.16.f.s: na juhvām ājyaṃ gṛhṇāti yadi prayājā na bhavanti /
9.6.16.f.d: न जुह्वाम् आज्यं गृह्णाति यदि प्रयाजा न भवन्ति ।
9.6.16.f.m: He does not take clarified butter into the juhū ladle if there are no fore-offerings.

9.6.16.h.s: pathyām̐ svastim uttamām ājyena devatāṃ yajati /
9.6.16.h.d: पथ्याम्̐ स्वस्तिम् उत्तमाम् आज्येन देवतां यजति ।
9.6.16.h.m: He sacrifices to the deity Pathyā Svasti last, with clarified butter.

9.6.16.i.s: na sthālīṃ niṣkāsaṃ mekṣaṇaṃ ca nidadhāti /
9.6.16.i.d: न स्थालीं निष्कासं मेक्षणं च निदधाति ।
9.6.16.i.m: He does not lay down the cooking-pot, the scrapings, and the stirring stick.

9.6.16.j.m: He leaves no remnant in the dhruvā ladle.

9.6.16.l.m: He sets in motion the sacrificial framework of the concluding animal sacrifice.

9.6.16.m.m: Its procedure is explained by the independent animal sacrifice.

9.6.16.n.m: He brings forward a barren cow dedicated to Mitra and Varuṇa.

9.6.16.o.s: tisro vā dvirūpāṃ maitrāvaruṇīṃ bahurūpāṃ vaiśvadevīm̐ śitipṛṣṭhāṃ bārhaspatyām iti /
9.6.16.o.d: तिस्रो वा द्विरूपां मैत्रावरुणीं बहुरूपां वैश्वदेवीम्̐ शितिपृष्ठां बार्हस्पत्याम् इति ।
9.6.16.o.m: Or three: a two-colored one dedicated to Mitra and Varuṇa, a multi-colored one dedicated to the All-Gods, and a white-backed one dedicated to Bṛhaspati.

9.6.16.p.s: upām̐śu madhyato vaiśvadevyā pracaraty āśrutapratyāśrute apy upām̐śu bhavata uccair itarābhyām /
9.6.16.p.d: उपाम्̐शु मध्यतो वैश्वदेव्या प्रचरत्य् आश्रुतप्रत्याश्रुते अप्य् उपाम्̐शु भवत उच्चैर् इतराभ्याम् ।
9.6.16.p.m: In the middle, he proceeds inaudibly with the one dedicated to the All-Gods; the ritual call and response are also inaudible; with the other two [he proceeds] aloud.

9.6.16.q.s: anūbandhyāyāḥ paśupuroḍāśaṃ nirūpya daivikāni havīm̐ṣy anunirvapati /
9.6.16.q.d: अनूबन्ध्यायाः पशुपुरोडाशं निरूप्य दैविकानि हवीम्̐ष्य् अनुनिर्वपति ।
9.6.16.q.m: Having apportioned the animal cake for the concluding animal sacrifice, he subsequently portions out the Devikā oblations.

9.6.16.r.m: He portions out a sacrificial cake on twelve potsherds for Dhātṛ, according to the traditional text.

9.6.16.s.m: These messes of boiled rice are cooked in milk in the soma pots.

9.6.16.t.s: anūbandhyāyāḥ paśupuroḍāśasya devikāhavīṣāṃ ca samānam̐ sviṣṭakṛdiḍam /
9.6.16.t.d: अनूबन्ध्यायाः पशुपुरोडाशस्य देविकाहवीषां च समानम्̐ स्विष्टकृदिडम् ।
9.6.16.t.m: The Sviṣṭakṛt offering and the iḍā are common to the animal cake of the concluding animal sacrifice and to the Devikā oblations.

9.6.16.u.m: He recites the introductory verse addressed to Mitra and Varuṇa.

9.6.16.w.s: anūyājānte svaruṃ juhoti hṛdayaśūlena carati yathā purastāt /
9.6.16.w.d: अनूयाजान्ते स्वरुं जुहोति हृदयशूलेन चरति यथा पुरस्तात् ।
9.6.16.w.m: At the end of the after-offerings, he offers the chip of the sacrificial post and proceeds with the heart-spit as previously described.

9.6.16.x.s: maitrāvaruṇīm āmikṣām eke 'nūbandhyāyāḥ sthāne samāmananti havirāhutiprabhṛti //
9.6.16.x.d: मैत्रावरुणीम् आमिक्षाम् एके ऽनूबन्ध्यायाः स्थाने समामनन्ति हविराहुतिप्रभृति ॥
9.6.16.x.m: Some teach the curds-and-whey dedicated to Mitra and Varuṇa in place of the concluding animal sacrifice, beginning from the offering of the sacrificial oblation.

9.6.17.b.s: sadohavirdhānānāṃ prathamakṛtān granthīn visrasyodīcī havirdhāne bahirvedi nirvartya /
9.6.17.b.d: सदोहविर्धानानां प्रथमकृतान् ग्रन्थीन् विस्रस्योदीची हविर्धाने बहिर्वेदि निर्वर्त्य ।
9.6.17.b.m: Having untied the previously made knots of the sadas and havirdhāna sheds, and having rolled out the two havirdhāna carts towards the north outside the altar area,

9.6.17.c.s: yat kusīdam apratīttam ity āhavanīyād vedim upoṣati /
9.6.17.c.d: यत् कुसीदम् अप्रतीत्तम् इत्य् आहवनीयाद् वेदिम् उपोषति ।
9.6.17.c.m: with: 'Whatever debt has not been paid back...', he sets fire to the altar area from the āhavanīya fire.

9.6.17.d.m: In the eastern hall, the sacrificer's wife [does likewise] from the gārhapatya fire.

9.6.17.e.s: etam̐ sadhastha pari te dadāmi \\ iti tisṛbhir dhūmam udyantam anumantrayate /
9.6.17.e.d: एतम्̐ सधस्थ परि ते ददामि \\ इति तिसृभिर् धूमम् उद्यन्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
9.6.17.e.m: With the three verses: 'This dwelling, I give thee over...', he accompanies with mantras the smoke rising up.

9.6.17.f.s: viśvalopa viśvadāvasya tvāsañ juhomi \\ ity añjalinā saktūn pradāvye juhuyād yadi miśram iva caritvā manyate /
9.6.17.f.d: विश्वलोप विश्वदावस्य त्वासञ् जुहोमि \\ इत्य् अञ्जलिना सक्तून् प्रदाव्ये जुहुयाद् यदि मिश्रम् इव चरित्वा मन्यते ।
9.6.17.f.m: If he thinks that he has performed [the rites] as if confused, he should offer barley-meal with his cupped hands into a blaze with: 'O all-destroyer, into the mouth of the all-burning fire I offer thee.'

9.6.17.g.s: pṛthagaraṇīṣv agnīn samāropayate prājihitaṃ gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇāgnim̐ śālāmukhīyaṃ gataśriyas tṛtīyam /
9.6.17.g.d: पृथगरणीष्व् अग्नीन् समारोपयते प्राजिहितं गार्हपत्यं दक्षिणाग्निम्̐ शालामुखीयं गतश्रियस् तृतीयम् ।
9.6.17.g.m: He causes the fires to mount upon separate fire-drills: the gārhapatya, the dakṣiṇāgni, the śālāmukhīya, and a third for one who has attained prosperity.

9.6.17.h.s: prācīnam udīcīnaṃ vodavasāya vihāram̐ sādhayitvodavasānīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvapaty āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ pañcakapālaṃ vā /
9.6.17.h.d: प्राचीनम् उदीचीनं वोदवसाय विहारम्̐ साधयित्वोदवसानीयाम् इष्टिं निर्वपत्य् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं पञ्चकपालं वा ।
9.6.17.h.m: Having moved away towards the east or towards the north, and having prepared the sacrificial area, he pours out the udavasānīyā offering [of a cake] on eight potsherds or on five potsherds for Agni.

9.6.17.i.m: Everything of that [offering] is performed inaudibly up to the last after-offering.

9.6.17.j.s: uru viṣṇo vikramasva \\ iti pūrṇāhutim eka udavasanīyāyāḥ sthāne samāmananti /
9.6.17.j.d: उरु विष्णो विक्रमस्व \\ इति पूर्णाहुतिम् एक उदवसनीयायाः स्थाने समामनन्ति ।
9.6.17.j.m: Some teach the full offering with [the mantra], "Stride widely, O Viṣṇu...", in place of the udavasānīyā offering.

9.6.17.k.s: sā yāvadrātrau kiyadrātreṇa vā saṃtiṣṭhate tadaiva sāyamagnihotraṃ juhuyāt kāla eva prātarhomaḥ /
9.6.17.k.d: सा यावद्रात्रौ कियद्रात्रेण वा संतिष्ठते तदैव सायमग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् काल एव प्रातर्होमः ।
9.6.17.k.m: At whatever part of the night, or however late in the night that concludes, right then he should offer the evening Agnihotra; the morning oblation is [offered] at its regular time.

9.7.18.a.s: ukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśy atirātro 'ptoryāmaś cāgniṣṭomasya guṇavikārā bhavanti /
9.7.18.a.d: उक्थ्यः षोडश्य् अतिरात्रो ऽप्तोर्यामश् चाग्निष्टोमस्य गुणविकारा भवन्ति ।
9.7.18.a.m: The Ukthya, the Ṣoḍaśin, the Atirātra, and the Aptoryāma are modifications of the Agniṣṭoma.

9.7.18.b.m: One desirous of cattle should sacrifice with the Ukthya.

9.7.18.c.m: Its procedure is explained by [that of] the Agniṣṭoma.

9.7.18.e.s: kratukaraṇam̐ hutvaitenaiva mantreṇa madhyame paridhāv abhyantaraṃ lepaṃ nimārṣṭi /
9.7.18.e.d: क्रतुकरणम्̐ हुत्वैतेनैव मन्त्रेण मध्यमे परिधाव् अभ्यन्तरं लेपं निमार्ष्टि ।
9.7.18.e.m: Having offered the kratukaraṇa libation, he wipes off the smear on the inside on the middle enclosing-stick with this very mantra.

9.7.18.f.m: In the Ukthya, he seizes a second animal of the pressing day, sacred to Indra-Agni.
