10.4.12.g.d: वितरां मेखलाम्̐ समायच्छते वितरां मुष्टी कुरुते ।
10.4.12.g.m: He loosens his girdle a little; he opens his fists a little.

10.4.12.h.s: svāhā yajñaṃ vāci vāte visṛje \\ iti muṣṭī vācaṃ ca visarjayitvā yathāsukham ata ūrdhvam̐ hastābhyāṃ carati /
10.4.12.h.d: स्वाहा यज्ञं वाचि वाते विसृजे \\ इति मुष्टी वाचं च विसर्जयित्वा यथासुखम् अत ऊर्ध्वम्̐ हस्ताभ्यां चरति ।
10.4.12.h.m: Having released his fists and his speech with the mantra, 'Svāhā! I release the sacrifice into speech, into the wind,' he acts freely with his hands henceforth.

10.4.12.i.m: The rest of the conduct of the consecrated one continues.

10.4.12.k.s: na vrataṃ bhavati daikṣo 'ta ūrdhvaṃ vratakalpaḥ /
10.4.12.k.d: न व्रतं भवति दैक्षो ऽत ऊर्ध्वं व्रतकल्पः ।
10.4.12.k.m: There is no fast-food; henceforth the procedure for the fast-food is that belonging to the consecration.

10.4.12.l.m: With the Saptahotṛ formula he touches King Soma placed on the pressing-stones.

10.4.12.m.s: yatra havirdhānam apaḥ prapādayīta tā anu prapadyate yaśa enam upanāmukaṃ bhavati /
10.4.12.m.d: यत्र हविर्धानम् अपः प्रपादयीत ता अनु प्रपद्यते यश एनम् उपनामुकं भवति ।
10.4.12.m.m: Where water is brought into the Havirdhāna cart-shed, he enters following it; fame approaches him.

10.4.12.n.s: dvādaśa dhenūḥ paṣṭhauhīr vā garbhiṇīḥ kṛttyadhīvāsaṃ cāṃśāv adhvaryave dadāty evam adābhye /
10.4.12.n.d: द्वादश धेनूः पष्ठौहीर् वा गर्भिणीः कृत्त्यधीवासं चांशाव् अध्वर्यवे ददात्य् एवम् अदाभ्ये ।
10.4.12.n.m: He gives twelve milk cows, or four-year-old pregnant heifers, and an upper garment of hide to the adhvaryu for the Aṃśu cup; similarly for the Adābhya cup.

10.4.12.o.s: dhruve gṛhīte na mūtraṃ karoty āvanayanāt /
10.4.12.o.d: ध्रुवे गृहीते न मूत्रं करोत्य् आवनयनात् ।
10.4.12.o.m: When the Dhruva cup has been drawn, he does not urinate until the pouring down.

10.4.12.p.s: vasvyai hiṃ kuru \ tasya prastuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyai \\ iti purastād bahiṣpavamānād vyāhṛtīr daśahotāraṃ ca japati /
10.4.12.p.d: वस्व्यै हिं कुरु \ तस्य प्रस्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्यै \\ इति पुरस्ताद् बहिष्पवमानाद् व्याहृतीर् दशहोतारं च जपति ।
10.4.12.p.m: Before the Bahiṣpavamāna, he mutters the mystic utterances and the Daśahotṛ formula: 'Make him! for the Vasvī; begin the prelude for her, for my acquisition of her.'

10.4.12.q.s: śyeno 'si gāyatrachandās \\ anu tvārabhe \ svasti mā saṃpāraya \\ iti //
10.4.12.q.d: श्येनो ऽसि गायत्रछन्दास् \\ अनु त्वारभे \ स्वस्ति मा संपारय \\ इति ॥
10.4.12.q.m: With the mantra, 'You are the falcon, whose meter is the Gāyatrī; I take hold of you from behind; convey me safely across,'

10.4.13.a.m: he takes hold from behind while the chant is being sung,

10.4.13.b.m: or at the middle strophic verse.

10.4.13.c.s: stutasya stutam asi \\ iti sarvāṇi stotrāṇi stutam̐ stutam anumantrayate /
10.4.13.c.d: स्तुतस्य स्तुतम् असि \\ इति सर्वाणि स्तोत्राणि स्तुतम्̐ स्तुतम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
10.4.13.c.m: With the mantra, 'Of the chanted you are the chant,' he addresses each stotra after it has been chanted.

10.4.13.d.s: śastrasya śastram asi \\ iti sarvāṇi śastrāṇi /
10.4.13.d.d: शस्त्रस्य शस्त्रम् असि \\ इति सर्वाणि शस्त्राणि ।
10.4.13.d.m: With the mantra, 'Of the recited you are the recitation,' all śastras.

10.4.13.e.m: He attaches the phrase 'Endowed with faculty, we win' at every mantra.

10.4.13.f.s: bhūr asi śreṣṭho raśmīnām ity aindravāyave hūyamāna ādityam upatiṣṭhate /
10.4.13.f.d: भूर् असि श्रेष्ठो रश्मीनाम् इत्य् ऐन्द्रवायवे हूयमान आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते ।
10.4.13.f.m: With the mantra, 'You are the earth, best of rays,' while the Aindravāyava cup is being offered, he attends upon the sun.

10.4.13.g.s: yo na indravāyū ity aindravāyave hute 'ṅguṣṭham avabādheta yadi śreyasā spardhetāṅguṣṭhenāṅgulīṃ yadi pāpīyasā /
10.4.13.g.d: यो न इन्द्रवायू इत्य् ऐन्द्रवायवे हुते ऽङ्गुष्ठम् अवबाधेत यदि श्रेयसा स्पर्धेताङ्गुष्ठेनाङ्गुलीं यदि पापीयसा ।
10.4.13.g.m: After the Aindravāyava cup has been offered, with the mantra, 'Whoever [plots against] us, O Indra and Vāyu,' he should press down his thumb if he contends with a superior, or press a finger with his thumb if with an inferior.

10.4.13.h.s: yo no mitrāvaruṇau \\ iti maitrāvaruṇe yo no 'śvinau \\ ity āśvine /
10.4.13.h.d: यो नो मित्रावरुणौ \\ इति मैत्रावरुणे यो नो ऽश्विनौ \\ इत्य् आश्विने ।
10.4.13.h.m: With 'Whoever [plots against] us, O Mitra and Varuṇa' at the Maitrāvaruṇa cup; with 'Whoever [plots against] us, O Aśvins' at the Āśvina cup.

10.4.13.i.s: acchinnasya te rayipate suvīryasya \\ indreṇa sayujo vayam iti śukram̐ hūyamānam anvārabhate /
10.4.13.i.d: अच्छिन्नस्य ते रयिपते सुवीर्यस्य \\ इन्द्रेण सयुजो वयम् इति शुक्रम्̐ हूयमानम् अन्वारभते ।
10.4.13.i.m: With the mantra, 'Of you unbroken, lord of wealth, endowed with great heroes, we, joined with Indra…,' he takes hold from behind while the Śukra cup is being offered.

10.4.13.j.m: When [the priest] brings him his goblet, he consumes it,

10.4.13.l.s: gṛhapate yaja \\ ity ucyamāne hotar etad yaja \\ iti saṃpreṣyati svayaṃ vā niṣadya yajati /
10.4.13.l.d: गृहपते यज \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने होतर् एतद् यज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति स्वयं वा निषद्य यजति ।
10.4.13.l.m: When addressed with 'O householder, sacrifice,' he gives the ritual direction: 'O hotṛ, sacrifice this,' or sits down and sacrifices himself.

10.4.13.m.s: jyotiṣe hiṃ kuru \ tasyai prastuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyai \\ iti purastād ājyānām ekaikasya stotrasya vyāhṛtīś caturhotāraṃ pañcahotāraṃ ca japati /
10.4.13.m.d: ज्योतिषे हिं कुरु \ तस्यै प्रस्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्यै \\ इति पुरस्ताद् आज्यानाम् एकैकस्य स्तोत्रस्य व्याहृतीश् चतुर्होतारं पञ्चहोतारं च जपति ।
10.4.13.m.m: Before each of the Ājya stotras, he mutters the mystic utterances, the Caturhotṛ, and the Pañcahotṛ formulas: 'Make him! for the light; begin the prelude for it, for my acquisition of it.'

10.4.13.n.s: iḍāyai hiṃ kuru \ tasyai prastuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyai \\ iti purastān mādhyaṃdināt pavamānād vyāhṛtīś caturhotāraṃ pañcahotāraṃ ca japati /
10.4.13.n.d: इडायै हिं कुरु \ तस्यै प्रस्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्यै \\ इति पुरस्तान् माध्यंदिनात् पवमानाद् व्याहृतीश् चतुर्होतारं पञ्चहोतारं च जपति ।
10.4.13.n.m: Before the midday Pavamāna, he mutters the mystic utterances, the Caturhotṛ, and the Pañcahotṛ formulas: 'Make him! for Iḍā; begin the prelude for her, for my acquisition of her.'

10.4.13.o.s: suparṇo 'si triṣṭupcchandās \\ anu tvā rabhe \ svasti mā saṃpāraya \\ iti stūyamānam anvārabhate //
10.4.13.o.d: सुपर्णो ऽसि त्रिष्टुप्च्छन्दास् \\ अनु त्वा रभे \ स्वस्ति मा संपारय \\ इति स्तूयमानम् अन्वारभते ॥
10.4.13.o.m: With the mantra, 'You are the fair-winged bird, whose meter is the Triṣṭubh; I take hold of you from behind; convey me safely across,' he takes hold from behind while the chant is being sung.

10.4.14.a.m: Taking hold from behind at the Śukra cup has been explained.

10.4.14.b.s: sanneṣu nārāśam̐seṣu dakṣiṇena vedim avasthitā dakṣiṇā dadāti /
10.4.14.b.d: सन्नेषु नाराशम्̐सेषु दक्षिणेन वेदिम् अवस्थिता दक्षिणा ददाति ।
10.4.14.b.m: When the Nārāśaṃsa goblets are set down, standing south of the altar, he gives the sacrificial gifts:

10.4.14.c.s: gavām̐ saptaikavim̐śatiś caturvim̐śatiḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ śatam̐ sahasraṃ dvādaśaśatam̐ sarvavedasam aparimitā vā /
10.4.14.c.d: गवाम्̐ सप्तैकविम्̐शतिश् चतुर्विम्̐शतिः षष्टिः शतम्̐ सहस्रं द्वादशशतम्̐ सर्ववेदसम् अपरिमिता वा ।
10.4.14.c.m: seven, twenty-one, twenty-four, sixty, a hundred, a thousand, twelve hundred cows, or all his possessions, or an unlimited number.

10.4.14.d.s: manthaudanatilamāṣā hiraṇyaṃ vāso 'virajā ca niyuktāny etāni bhavanti /
10.4.14.d.d: मन्थौदनतिलमाषा हिरण्यं वासो ऽविरजा च नियुक्तान्य् एतानि भवन्ति ।
10.4.14.d.m: Stirred beverage, boiled rice, sesame, black beans, gold, cloth, sheep, and goat are mandatory [gifts].

10.4.14.e.d: अनो रथो ऽधीवासो ऽश्वः पुरुषो हस्ती वानियुक्तानि ।
10.4.14.e.m: A cart, a chariot, an upper garment, a horse, a man, or an elephant are optional [gifts].

10.4.14.f.s: tās \\ rūpeṇa vo rūpam abhyaimi \\ iti hiraṇyam ājyaṃ cādāyābhyeti /
10.4.14.f.d: तास् \\ रूपेण वो रूपम् अभ्यैमि \\ इति हिरण्यम् आज्यं चादायाभ्येति ।
10.4.14.f.m: Taking gold and clarified butter, he approaches them with the mantra: 'By form I approach your form…'

10.4.14.g.s: tutho vo viśvavedā vibhajatu \\ iti madhyam avakramya vibhajati /
10.4.14.g.d: तुथो वो विश्ववेदा विभजतु \\ इति मध्यम् अवक्रम्य विभजति ।
10.4.14.g.m: Stepping into their midst, he distributes them with the mantra: 'May Tutha, all-knowing, distribute you…'

10.4.14.h.s: dvādaśadvādaśa madhyataḥkāribhyaḥ ṣaṭṣaḍ ardhibhyaś catasraścatasras tṛtīyibhyas tisrastisraḥ pādibhyaḥ /
10.4.14.h.d: द्वादशद्वादश मध्यतःकारिभ्यः षट्षड् अर्धिभ्यश् चतस्रश्चतस्रस् तृतीयिभ्यस् तिस्रस्तिस्रः पादिभ्यः ।
10.4.14.h.m: Twelve each to the chief priests, six each to the half-share recipients, four each to the third-share recipients, and three each to the quarter-share recipients.

10.4.14.j.m: The hotṛ, adhvaryu, brahman, and udgātṛ are the chief priests.

10.4.14.k.s: maitrāvaruṇaḥ pratiprasthātā brāhmaṇāccham̐sī prastotā cārdhino 'cchāvāko neṣṭāgnīdhraḥ pratihartā ca tṛtīyinaḥ śeṣāḥ pādinaḥ /
10.4.14.k.d: मैत्रावरुणः प्रतिप्रस्थाता ब्राह्मणाच्छम्̐सी प्रस्तोता चार्धिनो ऽच्छावाको नेष्टाग्नीध्रः प्रतिहर्ता च तृतीयिनः शेषाः पादिनः ।
10.4.14.k.m: The maitrāvaruṇa, pratiprasthātā, brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, and prastotṛ are the half-share recipients; the acchāvāka, neṣṭṛ, āgnīdhra, and pratihartṛ are the third-share recipients; the remaining ones are the quarter-share recipients.

10.4.14.l.s: etat te agne rādha aiti somacyutam iti vibhaktā ānayati /
10.4.14.l.d: एतत् ते अग्ने राध ऐति सोमच्युतम् इति विभक्ता आनयति ।
10.4.14.l.m: With 'This is thy gift, O Agni, coming, stirred by Soma,' he brings them forward after dividing them.

10.4.14.m.s: agreṇa prāgvam̐śam apareṇa sado dakṣiṇenāgnīdhrīyam antareṇa cātvālotkarāv udīcīr utsṛjati /
10.4.14.m.d: अग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शम् अपरेण सदो दक्षिणेनाग्नीध्रीयम् अन्तरेण चात्वालोत्कराव् उदीचीर् उत्सृजति ।
10.4.14.m.m: To the front of the eastern hall, to the west of the sadas, to the south of the āgnīdhra shed, between the cātvāla and the heap of rubbish, he releases them heading north.

10.4.14.n.s: ṛtasya pathā preta candradakṣiṇās \\ iti gacchantīr anumantrayate /
10.4.14.n.d: ऋतस्य पथा प्रेत चन्द्रदक्षिणास् \\ इति गच्छन्तीर् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
10.4.14.n.m: He follows them as they depart with the mantra, 'Go forth along the path of Ṛta, gifts shining like gold!'

10.4.14.o.s: brāhmaṇam adya rādhyāsam ṛṣim ārṣeyam iti hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇābhāgaṃ cādāyāgnīdhram abhyeti /
10.4.14.o.d: ब्राह्मणम् अद्य राध्यासम् ऋषिम् आर्षेयम् इति हिरण्यं दक्षिणाभागं चादायाग्नीध्रम् अभ्येति ।
10.4.14.o.m: With 'May I today satisfy the brāhmaṇa, the ṛṣi descendant of ṛṣis,' he approaches the āgnīdhra shed, having taken gold and a portion of the sacrificial fee.

10.4.14.p.s: etenaiva mantreṇa hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇābhāgaṃ cāgnīdhre dadāti /
10.4.14.p.d: एतेनैव मन्त्रेण हिरण्यं दक्षिणाभागं चाग्नीध्रे ददाति ।
10.4.14.p.m: With that very mantra, he gives the gold and the portion of the sacrificial fee in the āgnīdhra shed.

10.4.14.q.s: vi suvaḥ paśya vy antarikṣam iti sadaḥ prekṣate /
10.4.14.q.d: वि सुवः पश्य व्य् अन्तरिक्षम् इति सदः प्रेक्षते ।
10.4.14.q.m: With 'Look out upon heaven, look out upon the mid-region,' he gazes at the sadas.

10.4.14.r.m: With 'Gifts from us, go to the gods!' [he gazes at] the sacrificial gifts.

10.4.14.s.m: Having entered the sadas by the eastern door,

10.4.15.a.s: ātreyāya hiraṇyam uttamaṃ dadāti tenaiva mantreṇa yenāgnīdhre /
10.4.15.a.d: आत्रेयाय हिरण्यम् उत्तमं ददाति तेनैव मन्त्रेण येनाग्नीध्रे ।
10.4.15.a.m: he gives the best gold to an Ātreya, with the very mantra used in the āgnīdhra shed.

10.4.15.b.s: tasminn avidyamāne ya ārṣeyo 'nūcāno 'nūcānaputras tasmai tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt /
10.4.15.b.d: तस्मिन्न् अविद्यमाने य आर्षेयो ऽनूचानो ऽनूचानपुत्रस् तस्मै तां दक्षिणां दद्यात् ।
10.4.15.b.m: If he is not present, one should give that sacrificial fee to whoever is of ṛṣi descent, learned in the Vedas, and the son of a learned father.

10.4.15.c.s: athartvigbhyo dakṣiṇābhāgān brahman manas te dadāmi tad anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti brahmaṇe brahmasadana āsīnāya \\ idaṃ dadāmi \\ iti yad dāsyan bhavati tad anudiśati brahmaṇe /
10.4.15.c.d: अथर्त्विग्भ्यो दक्षिणाभागान् ब्रह्मन् मनस् ते ददामि तद् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मसदन आसीनाय \\ इदं ददामि \\ इति यद् दास्यन् भवति तद् अनुदिशति ब्रह्मणे ।
10.4.15.c.m: Then, for the portions of the sacrificial fees to the priests: with 'O Brahman, I give you the mind; that I redeem with this,' to the brahman seated on the brahman's seat, he specifies with 'I give this' whatever he is about to give to the brahman.

10.4.15.e.s: hotar vācaṃ te dadāmi tam anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti hotre hotṛṣadana āsīnāya /
10.4.15.e.d: होतर् वाचं ते ददामि तम् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति होत्रे होतृषदन आसीनाय ।
10.4.15.e.m: With 'O Hotṛ, I give you speech; that I redeem with this,' to the hotṛ seated on the hotṛ's seat.

10.4.15.f.s: adhvaryo prāṇaṃ te dadāmi tam anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ ity adhvaryave havirdhāna āsīnāya /
10.4.15.f.d: अध्वर्यो प्राणं ते ददामि तम् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इत्य् अध्वर्यवे हविर्धान आसीनाय ।
10.4.15.f.m: With 'O Adhvaryu, I give you the breath; that I redeem with this,' to the adhvaryu seated in the havirdhāna shed.

10.4.15.g.s: udgātaś cakṣus te dadāmi tad anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ ity udgātra audumbaryām āsīnāya /
10.4.15.g.d: उद्गातश् चक्षुस् ते ददामि तद् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इत्य् उद्गात्र औदुम्बर्याम् आसीनाय ।
10.4.15.g.m: With 'O Udgātṛ, I give you the eye; that I redeem with this,' to the udgātṛ seated near the audumbarī post.

10.4.15.h.s: hotrakāḥ śrotraṃ vo dadāmi tad anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti hotrakebhyo 'ntaḥsadasaṃ yathādhiṣṇiyamā sīnebhyaḥ /
10.4.15.h.d: होत्रकाः श्रोत्रं वो ददामि तद् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति होत्रकेभ्यो ऽन्तःसदसं यथाधिष्णियमा सीनेभ्यः ।
10.4.15.h.m: With 'O Hotrakas, I give you hearing; that I redeem with this,' to the hotrakas seated within the sadas according to their dhiṣṇya hearths.

10.4.15.i.m: And to the pratiprasthātṛ seated in the havirdhāna shed.

10.4.15.j.s: yathāśraddham̐ sadasyāya camasādhvaryubhyaḥ prasarpakebhyaś ca dadāti /
10.4.15.j.d: यथाश्रद्धम्̐ सदस्याय चमसाध्वर्युभ्यः प्रसर्पकेभ्यश् च ददाति ।
10.4.15.j.m: According to his faith, he gives to the sadasya, to the camasādhvaryus, and to the spectators.

10.4.15.k.s: sadasyātmānaṃ te dadāmi tam anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti sadasyāyāntaḥsadasaṃ dakṣiṇārdha āsīnāya /
10.4.15.k.d: सदस्यात्मानं ते ददामि तम् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति सदस्यायान्तःसदसं दक्षिणार्ध आसीनाय ।
10.4.15.k.m: With 'O Sadasya, I give you the self; that I redeem with this,' to the sadasya seated in the southern half within the sadas.

10.4.15.l.s: camasādhvaryavo 'ṅgāni vo dadāmi tāny anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti camasādhvaryubhyo havirdhāna āsīnebhyaḥ /
10.4.15.l.d: चमसाध्वर्यवो ऽङ्गानि वो ददामि तान्य् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति चमसाध्वर्युभ्यो हविर्धान आसीनेभ्यः ।
10.4.15.l.m: With 'O Camasādhvaryus, I give you the limbs; those I redeem with this,' to the camasādhvaryus seated in the havirdhāna shed.

10.4.15.m.s: prasarpakā lomāni vo dadāmi tāny anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti prasarpakebhyo 'ntaḥsadasaṃ dakṣiṇārdha āsīnebhyaḥ /
10.4.15.m.d: प्रसर्पका लोमानि वो ददामि तान्य् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति प्रसर्पकेभ्यो ऽन्तःसदसं दक्षिणार्ध आसीनेभ्यः ।
10.4.15.m.m: With 'O Spectators, I give you the body hairs; those I redeem with this,' to the spectators seated in the southern half within the sadas.

10.4.15.y.s: yām anyo dīyamānāṃ pratyācakṣīta yaṃ dviṣyāt tasmai tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt /
10.4.15.y.d: याम् अन्यो दीयमानां प्रत्याचक्षीत यं द्विष्यात् तस्मै तां दक्षिणां दद्यात् ।
10.4.15.y.m: The sacrificial fee which another might reject when offered, he should give to one whom he hates.

10.4.15.z.m: He indeed would receive it through another.

10.4.15.aa.m: Finally he gives to the pratihartṛ or to an Ātreya.

10.4.15.ab.m: He should not give after the recitation of the two [śastras] to the Maruts.

10.4.15.ac.s: yadi dadyād anūbandhyāvapāyām̐ hutāyāṃ dadyād udavasānīyāyāṃ veṣṭhau //
10.4.15.ac.d: यदि दद्याद् अनूबन्ध्यावपायाम्̐ हुतायां दद्याद् उदवसानीयायां वेष्ठौ ॥
10.4.15.ac.m: If he should give, he should give when the omentum of the anūbandhyā cow has been offered, or at the concluding iṣṭi.

10.5.16.a.s: nītāsu dakṣiṇāsu hariṇasya raghuṣyato 'dhiśīrṣāṇi bheṣajam̐ sakṣetriyaṃ viṣāṇayā viṣūcīnam anīnaśat \\ ity unmucya kṛṣṇaviṣāṇām anu tvā hariṇo mṛgaḥ \ padbhiś caturbhir akramīt \\ māhir bhūmnā pṛdākur iti cātvāle prāsyati /
10.5.16.a.d: नीतासु दक्षिणासु हरिणस्य रघुष्यतो ऽधिशीर्षाणि भेषजम्̐ सक्षेत्रियं विषाणया विषूचीनम् अनीनशत् \\ इत्य् उन्मुच्य कृष्णविषाणाम् अनु त्वा हरिणो मृगः \ पद्भिश् चतुर्भिर् अक्रमीत् \\ माहिर् भूम्ना पृदाकुर् इति चात्वाले प्रास्यति ।
10.5.16.a.m: When the sacrificial fees have been conveyed away, having untied the black buck horn with 'The head-cure of the swift deer has destroyed through the horn the congenital disease in all directions,' he throws it into the cātvāla pit with 'The deer, the beast, has walked after thee with four feet. Do not, through the ground, [become] a serpent, a viper!'

10.5.16.b.m: He gives a boon at the Rathaṃtara [sāman].

10.5.16.c.m: He gives a boon at the Vāmadevya [sāman].

10.5.16.d.m: He gives a boon at the Niṣkevalya [śastra].

10.5.16.e.m: He touches [the adhvaryu] while the āditya cup is being offered.

10.5.16.f.s: āyuṣe hiṃ kuru \ tasyai prastuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyai \\ iti purastād ārbhavāt pavamānād vyāhṛtīḥ pañcahotāraṃ ca japati /
10.5.16.f.d: आयुषे हिं कुरु \ तस्यै प्रस्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्यै \\ इति पुरस्ताद् आर्भवात् पवमानाद् व्याहृतीः पञ्चहोतारं च जपति ।
10.5.16.f.m: Before the Ārbhava Pavamāna chant, he mutters the mystical utterances and the five-hotṛ mantra with 'Utter hiṃ for life! Sing the prastāva for it, for my attainment of it!'

10.5.16.g.s: saghāsi jagatīchandās \\ anu tvārabhe \ svasti mā saṃpāraya \\ iti stūyamānam anvārabhate /
10.5.16.g.d: सघासि जगतीछन्दास् \\ अनु त्वारभे \ स्वस्ति मा संपारय \\ इति स्तूयमानम् अन्वारभते ।
10.5.16.g.m: While the laud is being chanted, he touches [the udgātṛ] with 'Thou art powerful, having the jagatī meter; I follow thee; take me across safely!'

10.5.16.h.s: yatra svaṃ camasaṃ nyante trīn puroḍāśaśakalān dakṣiṇata upāsyati /
10.5.16.h.d: यत्र स्वं चमसं न्यन्ते त्रीन् पुरोडाशशकलान् दक्षिणत उपास्यति ।
10.5.16.h.m: Where they put down their own cup, he casts three pieces of the sacrificial cake to the south.

10.5.16.i.s: tat kṛtvā prācīnāvītaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ vyākhyāya dānaprabhṛtīn pratyāyanāntān piṇḍapitṛyajñamantrāñ japati /
10.5.16.i.d: तत् कृत्वा प्राचीनावीतं कृत्वा षड्ढोतारं व्याख्याय दानप्रभृतीन् प्रत्यायनान्तान् पिण्डपितृयज्ञमन्त्राञ् जपति ।
10.5.16.i.m: Having done that, having worn the sacred cord over the right shoulder, and having recited the six-hotṛ mantra, he mutters the Piṇḍapitṛyajña mantras beginning with the gift and ending with the return.

10.5.16.j.m: He gives a boon at the Yajñāyajñīya [sāman].

10.5.16.k.s: purastād agniṣṭomastotrād vyāhṛtīḥ saptahotāraṃ ca japati /
10.5.16.k.d: पुरस्ताद् अग्निष्टोमस्तोत्राद् व्याहृतीः सप्तहोतारं च जपति ।
10.5.16.k.m: Before the Agniṣṭoma stotra, he mutters the mystical utterances and the seven-hotṛ mantra.

10.5.16.l.s: subhūr asi śreṣṭho raśmīnāṃ priyo devānām̐ sam̐sādhanīyaḥ / \ taṃ svā subho devā abhisaṃviśantu \\ iṣo 'si \ tveṣo 'si nṛmṇo 'si \ yaho 'si \ vrato 'si \ svo 'si \ cāraṇo 'si \ śūdro 'si \\ āryo 'si \ tasya ta iṣasya tveṣasya nṛmṇasya yahvasya vratasya svasya cāraṇasya śūdrasya cāryasya ca bhukṣiṣīya \ yathā tvam̐ sūryo 'si viśvadarśata evam ahaṃ viśvadarśato bhūyāsam ity agniṣṭomaṃ niṣpādyādityam upatiṣṭhate yady astamitaḥ syād āhavanīyam evādityopasthānenopatiṣṭhate /
10.5.16.l.d: सुभूर् असि श्रेष्ठो रश्मीनां प्रियो देवानाम्̐ सम्̐साधनीयः । \ तं स्वा सुभो देवा अभिसंविशन्तु \\ इषो ऽसि \ त्वेषो ऽसि नृम्णो ऽसि \ यहो ऽसि \ व्रतो ऽसि \ स्वो ऽसि \ चारणो ऽसि \ शूद्रो ऽसि \\ आर्यो ऽसि \ तस्य त इषस्य त्वेषस्य नृम्णस्य यह्वस्य व्रतस्य स्वस्य चारणस्य शूद्रस्य चार्यस्य च भुक्षिषीय \ यथा त्वम्̐ सूर्यो ऽसि विश्वदर्शत एवम् अहं विश्वदर्शतो भूयासम् इत्य् अग्निष्टोमं निष्पाद्यादित्यम् उपतिष्ठते यद्य् अस्तमितः स्याद् आहवनीयम् एवादित्योपस्थानेनोपतिष्ठते ।
10.5.16.l.m: Having brought the Agniṣṭoma to completion, with 'Thou art good, the best of rays, dear to the gods, accomplishable; to thee may the gods, O good one, assemble! Thou art food, thou art brilliance, thou art manly strength, thou art youth, thou art the vow, thou art one's own, thou art wandering, thou art a śūdra, thou art an ārya; may I enjoy that food, brilliance, manly strength, youth, vow, one's own, wandering, śūdra, and ārya of thine; just as thou, O Sun, art visible to all, so may I be visible to all,' he reveres the sun; if it has set, he reveres the āhavanīya fire with the very reverence to the sun.

10.5.17.a.m: The hāriyojana libation has been explained.

10.5.17.g.s: huteṣu samiṣṭayajuḥṣu agninā devena pṛtanā jayāmi \\ iti jāgatān viṣṇukramān krāmati /
10.5.17.g.d: हुतेषु समिष्टयजुःषु अग्निना देवेन पृतना जयामि \\ इति जागतान् विष्णुक्रमान् क्रामति ।
10.5.17.g.m: When the samiṣṭayajus formulas have been offered, he strides the viṣṇukrama strides in the jagatī meter with 'With god Agni I conquer the armies!'

10.5.17.h.s: upasṛjan dharuṇaṃ mātre mātaraṃ dharuṇo dhayan / \ rāyaspoṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdharat \\ ity upaniṣkrāmann audumbarīm utkhidati /
10.5.17.h.d: उपसृजन् धरुणं मात्रे मातरं धरुणो धयन् । \ रायस्पोषम् इषम् ऊर्जम् अस्मासु दीधरत् \\ इत्य् उपनिष्क्रामन्न् औदुम्बरीम् उत्खिदति ।
10.5.17.h.m: With the mantra, 'Releasing the calf to the mother, the calf suckling the mother; may he maintain abundant wealth, food, and sap among us,' he touches the audumbarī pillar as he steps out.

10.5.17.i.s: ava te heḍo varuṇa \\ ity unmucya kṛṣṇājinaṃ cātvāle prāsyati /
10.5.17.i.d: अव ते हेडो वरुण \\ इत्य् उन्मुच्य कृष्णाजिनं चात्वाले प्रास्यति ।
10.5.17.i.m: With the mantra, 'Avert your wrath, O Varuṇa…,' he takes off the black antelope skin and casts it into the cātvāla trench.

10.5.17.j.s: ud u tyam \\ citram iti dvābhyām ādityam upatiṣṭhate yady astamitaḥ syād āhavanīyam evādityopasthānenopatiṣṭhate /
10.5.17.j.d: उद् उ त्यम् \\ चित्रम् इति द्वाभ्याम् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते यद्य् अस्तमितः स्याद् आहवनीयम् एवादित्योपस्थानेनोपतिष्ठते ।
10.5.17.j.m: With the two verses, 'Up that [all-knowing god]…' and 'The wonderful [face of the gods]…,' he attends upon the sun; if it has set, he attends upon the āhavanīya fire itself with the prayer to the sun.

10.5.17.k.m: The approach to the musical finale has been explained.

10.5.17.m.s: indriyāj jyaiṣṭhyāc chraiṣṭhyān mā yoṣam ity unmucya kṛṣṇājinam abhyukṣya nidadhāti yadi purastād aprāstaṃ bhavati /
10.5.17.m.d: इन्द्रियाज् ज्यैष्ठ्याच् छ्रैष्ठ्यान् मा योषम् इत्य् उन्मुच्य कृष्णाजिनम् अभ्युक्ष्य निदधाति यदि पुरस्ताद् अप्रास्तं भवति ।
10.5.17.m.m: With the mantra, 'May I not be separated from faculty, seniority, or pre-eminence,' he takes off the black antelope skin, sprinkles it with water, and sets it down, if it was not cast away earlier.

10.5.17.n.s: sumitrā nas \\ ity abhipragāhyānupamajjantau sahaśiraskau snāto 'nyonyasya pṛṣṭhaṃ prakṣālayataḥ pratīpam āplavamānau gāhete /
10.5.17.n.d: सुमित्रा नस् \\ इत्य् अभिप्रगाह्यानुपमज्जन्तौ सहशिरस्कौ स्नातो ऽन्योन्यस्य पृष्ठं प्रक्षालयतः प्रतीपम् आप्लवमानौ गाहेते ।
10.5.17.n.m: Having stepped into the water with 'Propitious to us…,' without submerging their heads, with their heads [wet], they bathe, wash each other's backs, and plunge in swimming against the current.

10.5.17.o.s: vi te muñcāmi raśanās \\ iti mekhalāṃ yajamāno visram̐sayate /
10.5.17.o.d: वि ते मुञ्चामि रशनास् \\ इति मेखलां यजमानो विस्रम्̐सयते ।
10.5.17.o.m: With the mantra, 'I loosen your bonds…,' the sacrificer unties his girdle.

10.5.17.p.m: With the mantra, 'I untie this [noose of Varuṇa]…,' the wife [unties] the loop of her yoke-halter.

10.5.17.q.s: mekhalāṃ yoktraṃ jālaṃ dīkṣitavasane ca praplāvya somopanahanaṃ yajamānaḥ paridhatte somapariśrayaṇaṃ patnī /
10.5.17.q.d: मेखलां योक्त्रं जालं दीक्षितवसने च प्रप्लाव्य सोमोपनहनं यजमानः परिधत्ते सोमपरिश्रयणं पत्नी ।
10.5.17.q.m: Having set floating [in the water] the girdle, the yoke-strap, the netting, and the two garments worn during consecration, the sacrificer puts on the cloth that was used for tying up the soma, and the sacrificer's wife puts on the cloth that was used for enclosing the soma.

10.5.17.r.m: The two come out wearing unwashed garments.

10.5.17.s.m: They give those two [garments] to the adhvaryu at the concluding rite.

10.5.18.e.s: apareṇa śālāmukhīyam upaviśya juhvāṃ pañcagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā kṛṣṇājinam upastha ādhāya mayīndra indriyaṃ jyaiṣṭhyam̐ śraiṣṭhyaṃ dadhātu \\ iti juhoti /
10.5.18.e.d: अपरेण शालामुखीयम् उपविश्य जुह्वां पञ्चगृहीतं गृहीत्वा कृष्णाजिनम् उपस्थ आधाय मयीन्द्र इन्द्रियं ज्यैष्ठ्यम्̐ श्रैष्ठ्यं दधातु \\ इति जुहोति ।
10.5.18.e.m: Having sat down behind the śālāmukhīya fire, having scooped five ladlings into the juhū ladle, and having placed the black-antelope skin upon his lap, he offers with: 'May Indra place in me vigor, seniority, and excellence!'

10.5.18.f.m: He has the black-antelope skin thrown away,

10.5.18.g.m: or he makes it a place to put the offering ladles,

10.5.18.i.m: or he puts it away for another consecration,

10.5.18.j.m: or he may give it to a son or to a Vedic student,

10.5.18.k.m: if it has not been thrown away previously.

10.5.18.l.m: At the concluding rite, he enters upon the ritual observance.

10.5.18.m.s: anūbandhyāvapāyām̐ hutāyāṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ vediśroṇyāṃ pariśrite yajamānasya keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayate 'tra dadāti yad dāsyan bhavati /
10.5.18.m.d: अनूबन्ध्यावपायाम्̐ हुतायां दक्षिणस्यां वेदिश्रोण्यां परिश्रिते यजमानस्य केशश्मश्रूणि वापयते ऽत्र ददाति यद् दास्यन् भवति ।
10.5.18.m.m: When the omentum of the concluding animal sacrifice has been offered, in an enclosure on the southern hip of the altar, he causes the hair and beard of the sacrificer to be shaved; here he gives whatever he intends to give.

10.5.18.n.m: The chip from the sacrificial post, the heart-spit, and the worship of the sacrificial post are explained.

10.5.18.o.m: He gives a pair of cattle at the curd mixture for Mitra-Varuṇa.

10.5.18.p.s: saktuhome hūyamāne \\ ayaṃ no nabhasā puras \\ ity agnim upatiṣṭhate /
10.5.18.p.d: सक्तुहोमे हूयमाने \\ अयं नो नभसा पुरस् \\ इत्य् अग्निम् उपतिष्ठते ।
10.5.18.p.m: While the roasted-barley-meal oblation is being offered, he worships Agni with: 'This one before us with the vapor…'

10.5.18.q.s: sa tvaṃ no nabhasaspate \\ iti vāyum \\ deva sam̐sphāna \\ ity ādityam /
10.5.18.q.d: स त्वं नो नभसस्पते \\ इति वायुम् \\ देव सम्̐स्फान \\ इत्य् आदित्यम् ।
10.5.18.q.m: Vāyu with: 'Do thou, O lord of the vapor…', [and] Āditya with: 'O divine Samsphāna…'

10.5.18.r.s: anaḍvāham anaḍuho vā hiraṇyam audavasānīyāyāṃ dadāti /
10.5.18.r.d: अनड्वाहम् अनडुहो वा हिरण्यम् औदवसानीयायां ददाति ।
10.5.18.r.m: At the audavasānīyā rite, he gives a draft ox, or gold to the value of a draft ox;

10.5.18.s.m: at the full offering [of that rite], according to his capacity.

10.5.18.t.s: apavṛtte ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotre tam evāśvam aśvatarīṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti //
10.5.18.t.d: अपवृत्ते षोडशिनः स्तोत्रे तम् एवाश्वम् अश्वतरीं वा दक्षिणां ददाति ॥
10.5.18.t.m: When the chant of the ṣoḍaśin has ended, he gives that very horse or a mule as sacrificial gift.

10.6.19.a.d: दक्षिणां प्रतिग्रहीष्यन् प्रतिगृह्य वा सप्तदशकृत्वो ऽपानिति ।
10.6.19.a.m: When about to receive, or after having received, a sacrificial gift, he exhales seventeen times.

10.6.19.b.m: With sacrificial grass he should accept a cow or a horse;

10.6.19.d.m: and with fragrance and pleasant speech, a couch.

10.6.19.e.s: barhiḥ pratyuttiṣṭhati barhir vai dakṣiṇāyāḥ priyaṃ dhāma priyo dakṣiṇāyā bhavaty enaṃ dakṣiṇāgacchati /
10.6.19.e.d: बर्हिः प्रत्युत्तिष्ठति बर्हिर् वै दक्षिणायाः प्रियं धाम प्रियो दक्षिणाया भवत्य् एनं दक्षिणागच्छति ।
10.6.19.e.m: Sacrificial grass stands ready: sacrificial grass is indeed the dear abode of the sacrificial gift; he becomes dear to the sacrificial gift, and the sacrificial gift comes to him.

10.6.19.f.s: devā vai varuṇam ayājayan sa yasyaiyasyai devatāyai dakṣiṇām anayat tām avlīnāt te 'bruvan vyāvṛtya pratigṛhṇāma tathā no dakṣiṇā na vleṣyatīti te vyāvṛtya pratyagṛhṇan tato vai tān dakṣiṇā nāvlīnād ya evaṃ vidvān vyāvṛtya dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhṇāti nainaṃ dakṣiṇā vlīnātīti /
10.6.19.f.d: देवा वै वरुणम् अयाजयन् स यस्यैयस्यै देवतायै दक्षिणाम् अनयत् ताम् अव्लीनात् ते ऽब्रुवन् व्यावृत्य प्रतिगृह्णाम तथा नो दक्षिणा न व्लेष्यतीति ते व्यावृत्य प्रत्यगृह्णन् ततो वै तान् दक्षिणा नाव्लीनाद् य एवं विद्वान् व्यावृत्य दक्षिणां प्रतिगृह्णाति नैनं दक्षिणा व्लीनातीति ।
10.6.19.f.m: [The Brāhmaṇa says:] 'The gods sacrificed for Varuṇa. To whatever deity he brought a sacrificial gift, that [deity] crushed it. They said: Let us accept it by turning away, so that the sacrificial gift will not crush us. They accepted it by turning away. Then indeed the sacrificial gift did not crush them. He who, knowing thus, accepts a sacrificial gift by turning away—him the sacrificial gift does not crush.'

10.6.19.g.m: The acceptance is by turning away.

10.6.19.h.m: He shows them for three sacrificial gifts.

10.6.20.a.s: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ pratigṛhṇāmi \ rājā tvā varuṇo nayatu devi dakṣiṇe 'gnaye hiraṇyam \\ tenāmṛtatvam aśyām \\ vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyam astu pratigrahītre \ ka idaṃ kasmā adāt \ kāmaḥ kāmāya \ kāmo dātā \ kāmaḥ pratigrahītā \ kāmam̐ samudram āviśa \ kāmena tvā pratigṛhṇāmi \ kāmaitat te \\ eṣā te kāma dakṣiṇā \\ uttānas tvāṅgīrasaḥ pratigṛhṇātu \ somāya vāsas \\ gnās tvākṛntan \\ apaso 'tanvata \ varūtrayo 'vayan \\ avadhiyo apṛñcata \ rudrāya gām \\ varuṇāyāśvam \\ prajāpataye puruṣam \\ manave talpam \\ tvaṣṭre 'jām \\ pūṣṇe 'vim \\ nirṛtyā aśvataragardabhau \ himavato hastinam \\ gandharvāpsarābhyaḥ sragalaṃkaraṇe \ viśvebhyo devebhyo dhānyam \\ vāce 'nnam \\ brahmaṇa odanam \\ samudrāyāpas \\ uttānāyāṅgīrasāyānas \\ vaiśvānarāya ratham \\ vaiśvānaraḥ pratnathā nākam āruhat \\ divaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhandamānaḥ sumanmabhiḥ \ sa pūrvavaj janayaj jantave dhanam \\ samānam ajmā pariyāti jāgṛvis \\ iti vaiśvānaryarcā rathaṃ pratigṛhṇāti /
10.6.20.a.d: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां प्रतिगृह्णामि \ राजा त्वा वरुणो नयतु देवि दक्षिणे ऽग्नये हिरण्यम् \\ तेनामृतत्वम् अश्याम् \\ वयो दात्रे भूयान् मयो मह्यम् अस्तु प्रतिग्रहीत्रे \ क इदं कस्मा अदात् \ कामः कामाय \ कामो दाता \ कामः प्रतिग्रहीता \ कामम्̐ समुद्रम् आविश \ कामेन त्वा प्रतिगृह्णामि \ कामैतत् ते \\ एषा ते काम दक्षिणा \\ उत्तानस् त्वाङ्गीरसः प्रतिगृह्णातु \ सोमाय वासस् \\ ग्नास् त्वाकृन्तन् \\ अपसो ऽतन्वत \ वरूत्रयो ऽवयन् \\ अवधियो अपृञ्चत \ रुद्राय गाम् \\ वरुणायाश्वम् \\ प्रजापतये पुरुषम् \\ मनवे तल्पम् \\ त्वष्ट्रे ऽजाम् \\ पूष्णे ऽविम् \\ निरृत्या अश्वतरगर्दभौ \ हिमवतो हस्तिनम् \\ गन्धर्वाप्सराभ्यः स्रगलंकरणे \ विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो धान्यम् \\ वाचे ऽन्नम् \\ ब्रह्मण ओदनम् \\ समुद्रायापस् \\ उत्तानायाङ्गीरसायानस् \\ वैश्वानराय रथम् \\ वैश्वानरः प्रत्नथा नाकम् आरुहत् \\ दिवः पृष्ठं भन्दमानः सुमन्मभिः \ स पूर्ववज् जनयज् जन्तवे धनम् \\ समानम् अज्मा परियाति जागृविस् \\ इति वैश्वानर्यर्चा रथं प्रतिगृह्णाति ।
10.6.20.a.m: He accepts a chariot with the verse to Vaiśvānara: 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I accept thee. May King Varuṇa lead thee, O divine dakṣiṇā, gold to Agni! / Through that may I obtain immortality! / May vitality belong to the giver; may comfort be for me, the receiver. / Who has given this to whom? / Desire to desire. / Desire is the giver; / desire is the receiver. / Enter desire, the ocean! / With desire I accept thee. / Desire, this is thine! / This is thy dakṣiṇā, O desire! / May Uttāna Āṅgirasa accept thee! / Cloth to Soma! / The wives of the gods cut thee, / the workers stretched thee, / the protectresses wove thee, / the weavers joined thee. / A cow to Rudra! / A horse to Varuṇa! / A human to Prajāpati! / A couch to Manu! / A she-goat to Tvaṣṭṛ! / A sheep to Pūṣan! / A mule and a donkey to Nirṛti! / An elephant from the Himavat! / A garland and ornament to the Gandharvas and Apsarases! / Grain to the Viśve Devas! / Food to Speech! / Boiled rice to Brahman! / Waters to the ocean! / A cart to Uttāna Āṅgirasa! / A chariot to Vaiśvānara! / Vaiśvānara mounted to the firmament as of old, / praised with excellent prayers, on the ridge of heaven; / producing wealth for the creature, as of old, / watchful, he traverses the common course.'

10.6.20.b.s: sarveṣām̐ sāvitram ekaikasyādito dadhāti tenāmṛtatvam aśyām ity anuṣaṅgam antataḥ //
10.6.20.b.d: सर्वेषाम्̐ सावित्रम् एकैकस्यादितो दधाति तेनामृतत्वम् अश्याम् इत्य् अनुषङ्गम् अन्ततः ॥
10.6.20.b.m: For each [gift], he places the formula to Savitṛ at the beginning, and the subjoined phrase: 'Through that may I obtain immortality' at the end.

10.7.21.a.s: saṃvatsaraṃ caturṇām eko nāśnīyād iti caturhotṝṇām upayogavrataṃ bhavati /
10.7.21.a.d: संवत्सरं चतुर्णाम् एको नाश्नीयाद् इति चतुर्होतॄणाम् उपयोगव्रतं भवति ।
10.7.21.a.m: For a year, one should not eat alone from four: this is the observance for employing the Caturhotṛ formulas.

10.7.21.b.s: yaḥ kāmayeta bahu syāṃ prajāyeteti so 'raṇyaṃ paretya darbhastambe daśahotāram ūnayā pūrṇayā vā srucā juhuyāt /
10.7.21.b.d: यः कामयेत बहु स्यां प्रजायेतेति सो ऽरण्यं परेत्य दर्भस्तम्बे दशहोतारम् ऊनया पूर्णया वा स्रुचा जुहुयात् ।
10.7.21.b.m: He who might desire: 'May I be many, may I propagate', having gone out to the wilderness, should offer the Daśahotṛ formula into a clump of darbha grass with a ladle deficient or full.

10.7.21.c.s: yaḥ prajayā paśubhir naiva prabhaved varāsiṃ paridhāya taptaṃ piban dvādaśa rātrīr adhaḥ śayīta dvādaśyāṃ prātaḥ prāṅ udetya prāṇyāpānyāpraṇan daśahotāraṃ vyākhya \\ indraṃ gaccha svāhā \\ ity apānyāt /
10.7.21.c.d: यः प्रजया पशुभिर् नैव प्रभवेद् वरासिं परिधाय तप्तं पिबन् द्वादश रात्रीर् अधः शयीत द्वादश्यां प्रातः प्राङ् उदेत्य प्राण्यापान्याप्रणन् दशहोतारं व्याख्य \\ इन्द्रं गच्छ स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अपान्यात् ।
10.7.21.c.m: He who fails to prosper with offspring or cattle, having put on a rough woolen garment and drinking hot water, should lie on the ground for twelve nights; on the morning of the twelfth [night], having stepped out towards the east, inhaling, exhaling, and not breathing out, having recited the Daśahotṛ formula, he should exhale with: 'Go to Indra, svāhā!'

10.7.21.d.m: One desiring a son should sacrifice with the Wives of the Gods for a year.

10.7.21.e.s: caturbhir yajurbhir antarā tvaṣṭāraṃ devānāṃ ca patnībhiḥ putrakāmeṇa hotavyam̐ saṃvatsaraṃ cen na jāyeta tad anādṛtya caturhotrā yājayet /
10.7.21.e.d: चतुर्भिर् यजुर्भिर् अन्तरा त्वष्टारं देवानां च पत्नीभिः पुत्रकामेण होतव्यम्̐ संवत्सरं चेन् न जायेत तद् अनादृत्य चतुर्होत्रा याजयेत् ।
10.7.21.e.m: With four yajus formulas between Tvaṣṭṛ and the Wives of the Gods, an offering should be made by one desiring a son; if [a son] is not born within a year, ignoring that, he should cause him to sacrifice with the Caturhotṛ formula.

10.7.21.f.s: rājānam aparuddham̐ saṅgrāme saṃyatte khile 'cchadir darśe caturgṛhītenājyena caturhotrā pūrvām āhutiṃ juhoti graheṇottarām api vā caturhotāraṃ manasānudrutya pūrveṇa graheṇārdhaṃ juhoty ardham uttareṇa yat tatra vinderam̐s tato dakṣiṇā syāc chatam eke samāmananti /
10.7.21.f.d: राजानम् अपरुद्धम्̐ सङ्ग्रामे संयत्ते खिले ऽच्छदिर् दर्शे चतुर्गृहीतेनाज्येन चतुर्होत्रा पूर्वाम् आहुतिं जुहोति ग्रहेणोत्तराम् अपि वा चतुर्होतारं मनसानुद्रुत्य पूर्वेण ग्रहेणार्धं जुहोत्य् अर्धम् उत्तरेण यत् तत्र विन्देरम्̐स् ततो दक्षिणा स्याच् छतम् एके समामनन्ति ।
10.7.21.f.m: For a king who has been expelled, when a battle is joined, on fallow land, in a roofless place where the sky is visible, he offers the prior oblation of clarified butter taken in four ladlings with the Caturhotṛ formula, and the subsequent [oblation] with the graha formula; or having mentally recited the Caturhotṛ formula, he offers half with the prior graha formula, and half with the subsequent one; whatever they may obtain there, from that the sacrificial gift should be; some prescribe a hundred [cows].

10.7.21.g.m: He should cause one desiring offspring to sacrifice with the Caturhotṛ formula.

10.7.21.h.m: For him, the procedure for the oblation is that very one.

10.7.21.j.m: He should cause one desiring cattle to sacrifice with the Pañcahotṛ formula.

10.7.21.k.s: caturgṛhītenājyena pañcahotrā pūrvām āhutiṃ juhoti graheṇottarām api vā pañcahotāram anudrutya pūrveṇa graheṇārdhaṃ juhoty ardham uttareṇa /
10.7.21.k.d: चतुर्गृहीतेनाज्येन पञ्चहोत्रा पूर्वाम् आहुतिं जुहोति ग्रहेणोत्तराम् अपि वा पञ्चहोतारम् अनुद्रुत्य पूर्वेण ग्रहेणार्धं जुहोत्य् अर्धम् उत्तरेण ।
10.7.21.k.m: He offers the prior oblation of clarified butter taken in four ladlings with the Pañcahotṛ formula, and the subsequent [oblation] with the graha formula; or having recited the Pañcahotṛ formula, he offers half with the prior graha formula, and half with the subsequent one.

10.7.21.l.s: tasyaitāś catasro dakṣiṇā aśvo hiraṇyaṃ vāso gauḥ /
10.7.21.l.d: तस्यैताश् चतस्रो दक्षिणा अश्वो हिरण्यं वासो गौः ।
10.7.21.l.m: His sacrificial gifts are these four: a horse, gold, a garment, and a cow.

10.7.21.m.m: And he should cause one who has a rival to sacrifice without a sacrificial gift, with the two offerings and grahas, using the Saptahotṛ formula.

10.7.21.n.s: yo yajñasyānusam̐sthāṃ pāpīyān syāc caturgṛhītenājyena saptahotrā pūrvām āhutiṃ juhoti graheṇottarām //
10.7.21.n.d: यो यज्ञस्यानुसम्̐स्थां पापीयान् स्याच् चतुर्गृहीतेनाज्येन सप्तहोत्रा पूर्वाम् आहुतिं जुहोति ग्रहेणोत्तराम् ॥
10.7.21.n.m: For one who is worse off after the completion of a sacrifice, he offers the prior oblation of clarified butter taken in four ladlings with the Saptahotṛ formula, and the subsequent [oblation] with the graha formula.

10.7.22.a.m: Those connected with the somayāga have been explained.

10.7.22.b.s: abhicaran daśahotāraṃ juhuyāt svakṛta iriṇe pradare vā phaṭ \\ iti vaṣaṭkaroti yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vidyāṃ vidvām̐saṃ yaśo narchet so 'raṇyaṃ paretya darbhastambam udgrathya brāhmaṇaṃ dakṣiṇato niṣādyoccaiś caturhotṝn vyācakṣīta sagrahān sasvāhākārān sasaṃbhārayajuṣkān sapatnīkān sapratigrahaṇamantrān api vā caturhotṝn eva yo brāhmaṇo dakṣiṇata āste varaṃ tasmai dadyād yad evainaṃ tatra yaśa ṛcchati tad varuṇo 'varundha iti vijñāyate /
10.7.22.b.d: अभिचरन् दशहोतारं जुहुयात् स्वकृत इरिणे प्रदरे वा फट् \\ इति वषट्करोति यं ब्राह्मणं विद्यां विद्वाम्̐सं यशो नर्छेत् सो ऽरण्यं परेत्य दर्भस्तम्बम् उद्ग्रथ्य ब्राह्मणं दक्षिणतो निषाद्योच्चैश् चतुर्होतॄन् व्याचक्षीत सग्रहान् सस्वाहाकारान् ससंभारयजुष्कान् सपत्नीकान् सप्रतिग्रहणमन्त्रान् अपि वा चतुर्होतॄन् एव यो ब्राह्मणो दक्षिणत आस्ते वरं तस्मै दद्याद् यद् एवैनं तत्र यश ऋच्छति तद् वरुणो ऽवरुन्ध इति विज्ञायते ।
10.7.22.b.m: Practicing sorcery, he should offer the Daśahotṛ formula in a natural barren soil or in a cleft [in the earth]; he utters the vaṣaṭ-call with: 'Phaṭ!' If fame does not reach a brāhmaṇa learned in sacred knowledge, having gone out to the wilderness and knotted a clump of darbha grass, having seated a brāhmaṇa to the south, he should recite the Caturhotṛ formulas aloud, accompanied by the grahas, the svāhā-utterances, the saṃbhārayajus formulas, the formulas for the wives, and the mantras for accepting gifts, or just the Caturhotṛ formulas; he should give a choice gift to the brāhmaṇa who sits to the south; whatever fame reaches him there, Varuṇa takes hold of it—so it is known from the tradition.

10.7.22.c.s: yady enam ārtvijyād vṛtam̐ santaṃ nirharerann āgnīdhre juhuyād daśahotāraṃ caturgṛhītenājyena navagṛhītenety ekeṣāṃ purastāt pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan pratilomaṃ vigrāhaṃ prāṇān evāsyopadāsayati yady enaṃ punar upaśikṣeyur āgnīdhra eva juhuyād daśahotāraṃ caturgṛhītenājyena navagṛhītenety ekeṣāṃ paścāt prāṅ āsīno 'nulomam avigrāhaṃ prāṇān evāsmai kalpayati /
10.7.22.c.d: यद्य् एनम् आर्त्विज्याद् वृतम्̐ सन्तं निर्हरेरन्न् आग्नीध्रे जुहुयाद् दशहोतारं चतुर्गृहीतेनाज्येन नवगृहीतेनेत्य् एकेषां पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ् तिष्ठन् प्रतिलोमं विग्राहं प्राणान् एवास्योपदासयति यद्य् एनं पुनर् उपशिक्षेयुर् आग्नीध्र एव जुहुयाद् दशहोतारं चतुर्गृहीतेनाज्येन नवगृहीतेनेत्य् एकेषां पश्चात् प्राङ् आसीनो ऽनुलोमम् अविग्राहं प्राणान् एवास्मै कल्पयति ।
10.7.22.c.m: If they should dismiss him while he is chosen for the priestly office, he should offer the Daśahotṛ formula in the Āgnīdhra fire with clarified butter taken in four ladlings—with nine ladlings, according to some—standing facing west in front [of the fire], in reverse order, piecemeal; he thereby exhausts his vital breaths. If they should win him over again, he should offer the Daśahotṛ formula in the Āgnīdhra fire itself with clarified butter taken in four ladlings—with nine ladlings, according to some—seated facing east behind [the fire], in regular order, without break; he thereby establishes the vital breaths for him.

10.7.22.d.s: prāyaścittī vāg ghotā \\ ity ṛtumukhaṛtumukhe ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ juhuyāt /
10.7.22.d.d: प्रायश्चित्ती वाग् घोता \\ इत्य् ऋतुमुखऋतुमुखे षड्ढोतारं जुहुयात् ।
10.7.22.d.m: One who must perform an expiation should offer the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula at the beginning of each season with: "Speech is the hotṛ..."

10.7.22.e.s: yaḥ kāmayeta bahor bhūyān syām iti sa daśahotāraṃ prayuñjīta /
10.7.22.e.d: यः कामयेत बहोर् भूयान् स्याम् इति स दशहोतारं प्रयुञ्जीत ।
10.7.22.e.m: He who desires, 'May I become greater than the many,' should employ the Daśahotṛ formula.

10.7.22.f.s: yaḥ kāmayeta vīro ma ājāyeteti sa caturhotāram /
10.7.22.f.d: यः कामयेत वीरो म आजायेतेति स चतुर्होतारम् ।
10.7.22.f.m: He who desires, 'May a hero be born to me,' [should employ] the Caturhotṛ formula.

10.7.22.g.s: yaḥ kāmayeta paśumān syām iti sa pañcahotāram /
10.7.22.g.d: यः कामयेत पशुमान् स्याम् इति स पञ्चहोतारम् ।
10.7.22.g.m: He who desires, 'May I possess cattle,' [should employ] the Pañcahotṛ formula.

10.7.22.h.s: yaḥ kāmayetartavo me kalperann iti sa ṣaḍḍhotāram /
10.7.22.h.d: यः कामयेतर्तवो मे कल्पेरन्न् इति स षड्ढोतारम् ।
10.7.22.h.m: He who desires, 'May the seasons be favorable to me,' [should employ] the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula.

10.7.22.i.s: yaḥ kāmayeta somapaḥ somayājī syām ā me somapaḥ somayājī jāyeteti sa saptahotāram /
10.7.22.i.d: यः कामयेत सोमपः सोमयाजी स्याम् आ मे सोमपः सोमयाजी जायेतेति स सप्तहोतारम् ।
10.7.22.i.m: He who desires, 'May I be a soma-drinker and a soma-sacrificer; may a soma-drinker and a soma-sacrificer be born to me,' [should employ] the Saptahotṛ formula.

10.7.22.j.s: yaḥ kāmayeta priyaḥ syām iti yaṃ vā kāmayeta priyaḥ syād iti tasmā etam̐ sthāgaram alaṃkāraṃ kalpayitvā daśahotāraṃ dakṣiṇataḥ pañcahotāraṃ paścāt ṣaḍḍhotāram uttarataḥ saptahotāram upariṣṭāt saṃbhāraiś ca patnibhiś ca mukhe 'laṃkṛtyāsyārdhaṃ vrajet priyo haiva bhavati /
10.7.22.j.d: यः कामयेत प्रियः स्याम् इति यं वा कामयेत प्रियः स्याद् इति तस्मा एतम्̐ स्थागरम् अलंकारं कल्पयित्वा दशहोतारं दक्षिणतः पञ्चहोतारं पश्चात् षड्ढोतारम् उत्तरतः सप्तहोतारम् उपरिष्टात् संभारैश् च पत्निभिश् च मुखे ऽलंकृत्यास्यार्धं व्रजेत् प्रियो हैव भवति ।
10.7.22.j.m: He who desires, 'May I become beloved,' or for whomever he desires, 'May he become beloved,' having prepared for him this ornament of sthagara-perfume, with the Daśahotṛ formula to the south, the Pañcahotṛ formula to the west, the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula to the north, the Saptahotṛ formula above, and having adorned his face with the formulas of the collections and the wives, he should approach his side; he indeed becomes beloved.

10.7.22.k.s: teṣāṃ ye homārthe śrūyante sagrahāḥ sasvāhākārās te prayujyeran ye tv ahomārthe 'grahā asvāhākārās te /
10.7.22.k.d: तेषां ये होमार्थे श्रूयन्ते सग्रहाः सस्वाहाकारास् ते प्रयुज्येरन् ये त्व् अहोमार्थे ऽग्रहा अस्वाहाकारास् ते ।
10.7.22.k.m: Among these [formulas], those that are prescribed for offering are to be employed with the cup-formulas and with the svāhā-call; those, however, that are not for offering are without the cup-formulas and without the svāhā-call.

10.7.22.l.s: ye japā ye yājamānās te 'pi kratusaṃyuktāḥ /
10.7.22.l.d: ये जपा ये याजमानास् ते ऽपि क्रतुसंयुक्ताः ।
10.7.22.l.m: Those that are whispered prayers and those belonging to the sacrificer are also connected with the sacrifice.

10.7.22.m.m: For an āhitāgni, both of these [kinds] are unconnected with the sacrifice.

10.8.23.a.m: The brahman priest in the Jyotiṣṭoma should be a descendant of Vasiṣṭha,

10.8.23.b.m: or anyone who has studied the stomabhāga formulas.

10.8.23.c.m: Indeed, the officiating priests hand over the sacrifice to one another.

10.8.23.d.s: yāvad ṛcārtvijyaṃ kriyate hotṛṣv eva tāvad yajño bhavati /
10.8.23.d.d: यावद् ऋचार्त्विज्यं क्रियते होतृष्व् एव तावद् यज्ञो भवति ।
10.8.23.d.m: As long as the priestly duty is performed with the Ṛgveda, so long does the sacrifice remain with the hotṛs.

10.8.23.e.m: As long as with the Yajurveda, so long [does it remain] with the adhvaryus.

10.8.23.f.m: As long as with the Sāmaveda, so long [does it remain] with the udgātṛs.

10.8.23.g.s: yatra kvaca yajñasya virataṃ brahmaṇy eva tāvad yajño bhavati /
10.8.23.g.d: यत्र क्वच यज्ञस्य विरतं ब्रह्मण्य् एव तावद् यज्ञो भवति ।
10.8.23.g.m: Whenever there is a cessation of the sacrifice, so long does the sacrifice remain with the brahman priest.

10.8.23.h.s: tasmād etasminn antardhau brahmā vācaṃyamaḥ syāt /
10.8.23.h.d: तस्माद् एतस्मिन्न् अन्तर्धौ ब्रह्मा वाचंयमः स्यात् ।
10.8.23.h.m: Therefore, in this intermediate state, the brahman priest should restrain his speech.

10.8.23.i.s: yadi pramatto vyāhared vaiṣṇavīm ṛcaṃ japitvā vyāhṛtīś ca punar vācaṃ yacchati /
10.8.23.i.d: यदि प्रमत्तो व्याहरेद् वैष्णवीम् ऋचं जपित्वा व्याहृतीश् च पुनर् वाचं यच्छति ।
10.8.23.i.m: If through negligence he should speak, he restrains his speech again having murmured a verse addressed to Viṣṇu and the sacred utterances.

10.8.23.j.s: rājani mīyamāne 'gnau kriyamāṇe mahāvedyām uttaravedyāṃ ca kriyamāṇāyām̐ rājani hriyamāṇe 'bhiṣūyamāṇe bahiṣpavamāne stūyamāne /
10.8.23.j.d: राजनि मीयमाने ऽग्नौ क्रियमाणे महावेद्याम् उत्तरवेद्यां च क्रियमाणायाम्̐ राजनि ह्रियमाणे ऽभिषूयमाणे बहिष्पवमाने स्तूयमाने ।
10.8.23.j.m: While King Soma is being measured, while the fire is being prepared, while the great altar and the northern altar are being prepared, while King Soma is being carried, while he is being pressed, while the Bahiṣpavamāna chant is being chanted,

10.8.23.k.m: while the ukhā pot is being made, and while the rites of the ukhā pot are being performed,

10.8.23.p.m: during the piling of the fire-altar,

10.8.23.r.s: eteṣu karmasu yathākālaṃ kriyamāṇeṣu dakṣiṇata āste /
10.8.23.r.d: एतेषु कर्मसु यथाकालं क्रियमाणेषु दक्षिणत आस्ते ।
10.8.23.r.m: while these rites are being performed at their proper times, he sits to the south.

10.8.23.s.d: राजन्य् ओह्यमाने ऽग्नौ प्रणीयमाने हविर्धानयोः प्रोह्यमाणयोः ।
10.8.23.s.m: While King Soma is being driven forward, while the fire is being brought forward, while the two Havirdhāna carts are being rolled forward,

10.8.23.t.m: when the ukhā pot is about to be fashioned,

10.8.23.v.m: when they are about to deposit the Nirṛti bricks,

10.8.23.w.m: while the fires of the fire-altar are being brought forward,

10.8.23.x.m: when they go for the Vasatīvarī and the Savanīyā waters,

10.8.23.z.m: and when they are about to descend to the purificatory bath,

10.8.23.ab.s: eteṣu karmasu yathākālaṃ kriyamāṇeṣu dakṣiṇata eti /
10.8.23.ab.d: एतेषु कर्मसु यथाकालं क्रियमाणेषु दक्षिणत एति ।
10.8.23.ab.m: while these rites are being performed at their proper times, he walks along to the south.

10.8.23.ac.s: sadohavirdhāneṣu saṃmīyamāneṣv antareṇa cātvālotkarāv anvetyāpareṇottaravedim atikramya dakṣiṇata upaviśati //
10.8.23.ac.d: सदोहविर्धानेषु संमीयमानेष्व् अन्तरेण चात्वालोत्कराव् अन्वेत्यापरेणोत्तरवेदिम् अतिक्रम्य दक्षिणत उपविशति ॥
10.8.23.ac.m: While the Sadas and the Havirdhāna sheds are being measured out, having gone between the pit and the rubbish-heap and having crossed west of the northern altar, he sits down to the south.

10.8.24.a.m: He sits by until the time of the Vaisarjana offerings.

10.8.24.b.s: hoṣyamāṇeṣu vaisarjaneṣu yathetaṃ pratyetyottareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ parītya pūrveṇa dvāreṇa prāgvaṃśaṃ praviśyāpareṇa śālāmukhīyam atikramya dakṣiṇata upaviśati /
10.8.24.b.d: होष्यमाणेषु वैसर्जनेषु यथेतं प्रत्येत्योत्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयं धिष्णियं परीत्य पूर्वेण द्वारेण प्राग्वंशं प्रविश्यापरेण शालामुखीयम् अतिक्रम्य दक्षिणत उपविशति ।
10.8.24.b.m: When the Vaisarjana offerings are about to be made, having returned the way he came, having walked around to the north of the Āgnīdhra mound, having entered the eastern hall by the eastern door, and having crossed west of the Śālāmukhīya fire, he sits down to the south.

10.8.24.c.s: evā vandasva \\ ity upasthe rājānaṃ kurute /
10.8.24.c.d: एवा वन्दस्व \\ इत्य् उपस्थे राजानं कुरुते ।
10.8.24.c.m: With: "Praise thus..." he places King Soma on his lap.

10.8.24.d.m: He sits by until the Vaisarjana offering.

10.8.24.e.m: When the Vaisarjana offering has been offered, he walks behind the fire,

10.8.24.g.s: āgnīdhrīyaṃ prāpya dakṣiṇata upaviśaty ā vaisarjanahomād anvāste hute vaisarjane 'nyasmai rājānaṃ pradāyottareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ parītya rājānaṃ pratyādāya somo jigāti gātuvit \\ iti saumyarcāpareṇa dvāreṇa havirdhāne praviśyādhvaryave rājānaṃ pradāya yathetaṃ pratyetyāpareṇottaravedim atikramya dakṣiṇata upaviśati /
10.8.24.g.d: आग्नीध्रीयं प्राप्य दक्षिणत उपविशत्य् आ वैसर्जनहोमाद् अन्वास्ते हुते वैसर्जने ऽन्यस्मै राजानं प्रदायोत्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयं धिष्णियं परीत्य राजानं प्रत्यादाय सोमो जिगाति गातुवित् \\ इति सौम्यर्चापरेण द्वारेण हविर्धाने प्रविश्याध्वर्यवे राजानं प्रदाय यथेतं प्रत्येत्यापरेणोत्तरवेदिम् अतिक्रम्य दक्षिणत उपविशति ।
10.8.24.g.m: Having reached the Āgnīdhra mound, he sits down to the south and sits by until the Vaisarjana offering; when the Vaisarjana offering has been offered, having handed over King Soma to another, having walked around to the north of the Āgnīdhra mound, having taken back King Soma, having entered the Havirdhāna shed by the western door with the verse addressed to Soma: "Soma moves forward, knowing the way...", having handed King Soma over to the adhvaryu, having returned the way he came, and having crossed west of the northern altar, he sits down to the south.

10.8.24.h.m: He sits by until the offering of the omentum of the animal for Agni and Soma.

10.8.24.i.m: When the omentum has been offered, he purifies himself with water.

10.8.24.j.s: vasatīvarīṣu parigṛhyamāṇāsu vācaṃ yacchaty ā subrahmaṇyāyāḥ /
10.8.24.j.d: वसतीवरीषु परिगृह्यमाणासु वाचं यच्छत्य् आ सुब्रह्मण्यायाः ।
10.8.24.j.m: While the Vasatīvarī waters are being enclosed, he restrains his speech until the Subrahmaṇyā litany.

10.8.24.k.m: When they are awakened in the deep night, he awakens.

10.8.24.l.s: upākṛte prātaranuvāke vācaṃ yacchaty ā paridhānīyāyāḥ /
10.8.24.l.d: उपाकृते प्रातरनुवाके वाचं यच्छत्य् आ परिधानीयायाः ।
10.8.24.l.m: When the morning recitation has been undertaken, he restrains his speech until the concluding verse.

10.8.24.m.s: savanīyāsu prapādyamānāsu pūrveṇa dvāreṇa havirdhāne praviśyāgreṇa kharaṃ parītya dakṣiṇata upaviśati //
10.8.24.m.d: सवनीयासु प्रपाद्यमानासु पूर्वेण द्वारेण हविर्धाने प्रविश्याग्रेण खरं परीत्य दक्षिणत उपविशति ॥
10.8.24.m.m: While the Savanīyā waters are being brought forward, having entered the Havirdhāna shed by the eastern door and having gone around in front of the mound, he sits down to the south.

10.8.25.b.s: graheṣu gṛhyamāṇeṣu vācaṃ yacchaty āgrayaṇasya grahaṇāt /
10.8.25.b.d: ग्रहेषु गृह्यमाणेषु वाचं यच्छत्य् आग्रयणस्य ग्रहणात् ।
10.8.25.b.m: While the cups [of soma] are being drawn, he restrains his speech until the drawing of the āgrayaṇa cup.

10.8.25.c.m: When they glide forth to the bahiṣpavamāna [stotra], he glides forth holding on [to the one preceding him].

10.8.25.d.s: brahman stoṣyāmi \\ ity ucyamāne deva savitar etat te prāha \ tat pra ca suva pra ca yaja \ bṛhaspatir brahmā \\ āyuṣmatyā ṛco mā gāta tanūpāt sāmnaḥ \ satyā va āśiṣaḥ santu satyā ākūtayas \\ ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ ca vadata \ stuta devasya savituḥ prasave \\ om̐ stuta \\ iti prasauti /
10.8.25.d.d: ब्रह्मन् स्तोष्यामि \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने देव सवितर् एतत् ते प्राह \ तत् प्र च सुव प्र च यज \ बृहस्पतिर् ब्रह्मा \\ आयुष्मत्या ऋचो मा गात तनूपात् साम्नः \ सत्या व आशिषः सन्तु सत्या आकूतयस् \\ ऋतं च सत्यं च वदत \ स्तुत देवस्य सवितुः प्रसवे \\ ओम्̐ स्तुत \\ इति प्रसौति ।
10.8.25.d.m: When [the udgātṛ] says, 'O brahman, I shall chant,' he gives the impulse with: 'O divine Savitṛ, this he has proclaimed to you; impel it and offer it; Bṛhaspati is the brahman priest. Stray not from the life-giving verse; [stray not] from the body-protecting sāman. True be your blessings, true your intentions; speak truth and order; chant in the impulse of the god Savitṛ; om, chant!'

10.8.25.e.m: This is the procedure for all stotras.

10.8.25.f.s: raśmir asi \ kṣayāya tvā \ kṣayaṃ jinva \\ ity ekatrim̐śataḥ stomabhāgāḥ stotre stotra uttaramuttaram ādadhāti /
10.8.25.f.d: रश्मिर् असि \ क्षयाय त्वा \ क्षयं जिन्व \\ इत्य् एकत्रिम्̐शतः स्तोमभागाः स्तोत्रे स्तोत्र उत्तरमुत्तरम् आदधाति ।
10.8.25.f.m: With the thirty-one stomabhāga mantras beginning 'A ray art thou, for dwelling thee, cheer the dwelling,' he assigns [a verse] consecutively to each stotra.

10.8.25.g.s: dvādaśāgniṣṭome trayodaśātyagniṣṭome pañcadaśokthye ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśini saptdaśa vājapeya ekānnatrim̐śatam atirātre trayastrim̐śatam aptoryāme /
10.8.25.g.d: द्वादशाग्निष्टोमे त्रयोदशात्यग्निष्टोमे पञ्चदशोक्थ्ये षोडश षोडशिनि सप्त्दश वाजपेय एकान्नत्रिम्̐शतम् अतिरात्रे त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शतम् अप्तोर्यामे ।
10.8.25.g.m: Twelve [stomabhāga mantras] in the Agniṣṭome; thirteen in the Atyagniṣṭoma; fifteen in the Ukthya; sixteen in the Ṣoḍaśin; seventeen in the Vājapeya; twenty-nine in the Atirātra; thirty-three in the Aptoryāma.

10.8.25.h.s: stute bahiṣpavamāne yathetaṃ pratyetyāpareṇottaravedim atikramya dakṣiṇata upaviśati savanīyasyā vapāyā homād anvāste /
10.8.25.h.d: स्तुते बहिष्पवमाने यथेतं प्रत्येत्यापरेणोत्तरवेदिम् अतिक्रम्य दक्षिणत उपविशति सवनीयस्या वपाया होमाद् अन्वास्ते ।
10.8.25.h.m: When the bahiṣpavamāna [stotra] has been chanted, having returned the way he came, and having stepped past the rear of the uttaravedi, he sits down to the south; he sits attending until the offering of the omentum of the savanīya [animal victim].

10.8.25.i.s: hutāyāṃ vapāyāṃ mārjayitvā pūrveṇa dvāreṇa sadaḥ praviśyāgreṇa praśāstrīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ parītya dakṣiṇata upaviśaty āsam̐sthānād anvāste /
10.8.25.i.d: हुतायां वपायां मार्जयित्वा पूर्वेण द्वारेण सदः प्रविश्याग्रेण प्रशास्त्रीयं धिष्णियं परीत्य दक्षिणत उपविशत्य् आसम्̐स्थानाद् अन्वास्ते ।
10.8.25.i.m: When the omentum has been offered, having purified himself with water, having entered the sadas by the eastern door, and having gone around in front of the praśāstṛ's dhiṣṇya hearth, he sits down to the south; he sits attending until the conclusion.

10.8.25.j.s: yatrāsmai camasam āharati taṃ bhakṣayati yathetare camasān /
10.8.25.j.d: यत्रास्मै चमसम् आहरति तं भक्षयति यथेतरे चमसान् ।
10.8.25.j.m: Whenever [the unnetṛ] brings him his cup, he consumes it just as the others [consume] their cups.

10.8.25.k.m: During the stotra and śastra, he restrains his speech.

10.8.25.l.m: When the pressing is concluded, he steps out the way he came.

10.8.25.m.s: evaṃ vihita uttarayoḥ savanayoḥ saṃcaro brahmatvaṃ ca /
10.8.25.m.d: एवं विहित उत्तरयोः सवनयोः संचरो ब्रह्मत्वं च ।
10.8.25.m.m: In this manner are prescribed the movement and the office of the brahman priest for the two subsequent pressings.

10.8.25.n.s: ādhvaryava evāto 'nyāni karmāṇi brāhmaṇa āmnātāni bhavanti /
10.8.25.n.d: आध्वर्यव एवातो ऽन्यानि कर्माणि ब्राह्मण आम्नातानि भवन्ति ।
10.8.25.n.m: Other rites than these handed down in the Brāhmaṇa belong solely to the office of the adhvaryu.

10.8.25.o.m: In this manner is prescribed the office of the brahman priest for the sacrificial forms; the office of the brahman priest.

11.1.2.a.s: sa uttarakratvarthaḥ / anyatra sādyaskrebhyo vājapeyāt ṣoḍaśinaḥ sārasvatāc ca satrāt / agniśinastomo yathopadiṣṭaṃ vā / rātrisatreṣu samahāvrateṣv aśravaṇārthā punaścitiḥ //
11.1.2.a.d: स उत्तरक्रत्वर्थः । अन्यत्र साद्यस्क्रेभ्यो वाजपेयात् षोडशिनः सारस्वताच् च सत्रात् । अग्निशिनस्तोमो यथोपदिष्टं वा । रात्रिसत्रेषु समहाव्रतेष्व् अश्रवणार्था पुनश्चितिः ॥
11.1.2.a.m: It is intended for the subsequent sacrifices; except for the Sādyaskra rites, the Vājapeya, the Ṣoḍaśin, and the Sārasvata satra; or for the Agniṣṭoma as taught [by some teachers]; in night-satras and rites with the Mahāvrata, a repiling is not prescribed by Vedic revelation.

11.1.3.a.s: api vā dhāryamāṇe 'gnau prajāpatis tvā sādayatu \ tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda \\ ity antarvedim abhimṛśet / tisro vā svayamātṛṇṇā upadhāya tāsām upadhānakalpaḥ svayamātṛṇṇā sāma purīṣaṃ viśvajyotiḥ / evaṃ vihitā dvitīyāh purīṣā tṛtīyā //
11.1.3.a.d: अपि वा धार्यमाणे ऽग्नौ प्रजापतिस् त्वा सादयतु \ तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेदिम् अभिमृशेत् । तिस्रो वा स्वयमातृण्णा उपधाय तासाम् उपधानकल्पः स्वयमातृण्णा साम पुरीषं विश्वज्योतिः । एवं विहिता द्वितीयाह् पुरीषा तृतीया ॥
11.1.3.a.m: Or, while the fire is being kept, he should touch the middle of the altar with: 'May Prajāpati seat thee; with that deity, like Aṅgiras, sit firm.' Or, having set down three svayamātṛṇṇā [naturally perforated bricks], the procedure for placing them is: svayamātṛṇṇā, sāman, loose earth, viśvajyotiḥ; in this manner the second [layer] is arranged; the third [layer] of loose earth.

11.1.4.a.s: api vā tisraś ca svayamātṛṇṇāḥ sarvāś ca viśvajyotiṣas tāsām upadhānakalpaḥ svayamātṛṇṇā sāma purīṣaṃ viśvajyotir evaṃ vihitā dvitīyā tṛtīyasyāṃ tu viśvajyotiḥ prathamā / atha purīṣam / atha svayamātṛṇṇām / atha sāma //
11.1.4.a.d: अपि वा तिस्रश् च स्वयमातृण्णाः सर्वाश् च विश्वज्योतिषस् तासाम् उपधानकल्पः स्वयमातृण्णा साम पुरीषं विश्वज्योतिर् एवं विहिता द्वितीया तृतीयस्यां तु विश्वज्योतिः प्रथमा । अथ पुरीषम् । अथ स्वयमातृण्णाम् । अथ साम ॥
11.1.4.a.m: Or there are three svayamātṛṇṇā bricks and all the viśvajyotiṣ bricks; the procedure for their placement is: svayamātṛṇṇā, sāman, loose earth, viśvajyotiḥ; the second is arranged in this manner; but in the third, the viśvajyotiḥ is first, then loose earth, then the svayamātṛṇṇā, then the sāman.

11.1.5.a.s: taṃ ceṣyamāṇo 'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyām āpūryamāṇapakṣe vā puṇye nakṣatra ṛtvijo vṛtvā //
11.1.5.a.d: तं चेष्यमाणो ऽमावास्यायां पौर्णमास्याम् आपूर्यमाणपक्षे वा पुण्ये नक्षत्र ऋत्विजो वृत्वा ॥
11.1.5.a.m: Intending to pile it on a new moon, on a full moon, or in the waxing fortnight under an auspicious lunar mansion, having chosen the priests;

11.1.6.a.s: bṛhaspatipurohitā devānāṃ devāḥ prathamajās \\ devā deveṣu parākramadhvaṃ prathamā dvitīyeṣu dvitīyās tṛtīyeṣu \ trir ekādaśās trayastrim̐śās \\ anu va ārabhe \\ idam̐ śakeyaṃ yad idaṃ karomi svāhā \\ ity āhutiṃ juhoti //
11.1.6.a.d: बृहस्पतिपुरोहिता देवानां देवाः प्रथमजास् \\ देवा देवेषु पराक्रमध्वं प्रथमा द्वितीयेषु द्वितीयास् तृतीयेषु \ त्रिर् एकादशास् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शास् \\ अनु व आरभे \\ इदम्̐ शकेयं यद् इदं करोमि स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आहुतिं जुहोति ॥
11.1.6.a.m: he offers an oblation with: 'The gods whose domestic priest is Bṛhaspati, the firstborn gods; gods, stride forward among the gods, the first among the second, the second among the third; thrice eleven, the thirty-three; I take hold after you; may I be capable of this that I do, svāhā!'

11.1.7.a.s: juhūm̐ sruvaṃ ca saṃmṛjya caturgṛhītam ājyam aṣṭagṛhītaṃ vā gṛhītvā yuñjānaḥ prathamaṃ manas \\ iti yajuraṣṭamābhir ṛgbhir antarvedy ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan sāvitrāṇy ekām āhutiṃ juhoti //
11.1.7.a.d: जुहूम्̐ स्रुवं च संमृज्य चतुर्गृहीतम् आज्यम् अष्टगृहीतं वा गृहीत्वा युञ्जानः प्रथमं मनस् \\ इति यजुरष्टमाभिर् ऋग्भिर् अन्तर्वेद्य् ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन् सावित्राण्य् एकाम् आहुतिं जुहोति ॥
11.1.7.a.m: Having wiped the juhū and sruva ladles, and having taken four ladlings or eight ladlings of clarified butter, standing upright within the altar, he offers one oblation of Savitṛ formulas with the eight verses that have a yajus as the eighth, beginning 'Yoking the mind first.'

11.1.8.a.s: yaṃ kāmayeta pāpīyānt syād ity ekaikaṃ tasya juhuyāt / yaṃ kāmayeta vasīyant syād iti sarvāṇi tasyānudrutya juhuyāt //
11.1.8.a.d: यं कामयेत पापीयान्त् स्याद् इत्य् एकैकं तस्य जुहुयात् । यं कामयेत वसीयन्त् स्याद् इति सर्वाणि तस्यानुद्रुत्य जुहुयात् ॥
11.1.8.a.m: For one whom he desires, 'May he become worse off,' he should offer them one by one; for one whom he desires, 'May he become better off,' he should offer them reciting all consecutively.

11.1.9.a.s: yadi kāmayeta cchandām̐si yajñayaśasenārpayeyam ity ṛcam antimāṃ kuryāt / yadi kāmayeta yajamānaṃ yajñayaśasenārpayeyam iti yajur antimaṃ kuyāt //
11.1.9.a.d: यदि कामयेत च्छन्दाम्̐सि यज्ञयशसेनार्पयेयम् इत्य् ऋचम् अन्तिमां कुर्यात् । यदि कामयेत यजमानं यज्ञयशसेनार्पयेयम् इति यजुर् अन्तिमं कुयात् ॥
11.1.9.a.m: If he should desire, 'May I endow the metres with sacrificial glory,' he should make a verse the last; if he should desire, 'May I endow the sacrificer with sacrificial glory,' he should make a yajus the last.

11.1.10.a.m: With a fourfold ladling [he offers] the subsequent [oblation] with: 'Complete the stoma with the verse.'

11.1.11.a.s: devasya tvā \\ iti caturbhir abhrimādatte // khādirīṃ vaiṇaivīṃ vā kalmāṣīm̐ suṣirām asuṣirāṃ vobhayataḥkṣṇū tām anyatarataḥkṣṇū tāṃ vā pālāśīm audumbarīm arkamayīm̐ śamīmayīṃ vā / yo vā kaścana vṛkṣaḥ phalagrahis tasya muṣṭimātriṃ prādeśamātrīm aratnimātriṃ bāhumātriṃ vyāmamātrīm aparimitāṃ vā //
11.1.11.a.d: देवस्य त्वा \\ इति चतुर्भिर् अभ्रिमादत्ते ॥ खादिरीं वैणैवीं वा कल्माषीम्̐ सुषिराम् असुषिरां वोभयतःक्ष्णू ताम् अन्यतरतःक्ष्णू तां वा पालाशीम् औदुम्बरीम् अर्कमयीम्̐ शमीमयीं वा । यो वा कश्चन वृक्षः फलग्रहिस् तस्य मुष्टिमात्रिं प्रादेशमात्रीम् अरत्निमात्रिं बाहुमात्रिं व्याममात्रीम् अपरिमितां वा ॥
11.1.11.a.m: With the four mantras beginning 'At the impulse of the god Savitṛ,' he takes the spade: of khadira or bamboo wood, spotted, hollow or not hollow, sharpened on both sides or sharpened on one side, or of palāśa, udumbara, arka, or śamī wood; or of whatever tree bears fruit; a fist long, a span long, a cubit long, an arm's length, a fathom long, or of unlimited size.

11.1.12.a.s: imām agṛbhṇan raśanām ṛtasya \\ ity aśvābhidhānīm ādāya pratūrtaṃ vājinn ādrava \\ ity aśvam abhidadhāti //
11.1.12.a.d: इमाम् अगृभ्णन् रशनाम् ऋतस्य \\ इत्य् अश्वाभिधानीम् आदाय प्रतूर्तं वाजिन्न् आद्रव \\ इत्य् अश्वम् अभिदधाति ॥
11.1.12.a.m: Having taken the horse's halter with 'They grasped this bridle of cosmic order,' he halters the horse with 'Speed forward, swift courser!'

11.1.13.a.s: tūṣṇīṃ gardabhasyādāya yuñjāthām̐ rāsabhaṃ yuvam iti gardabham //
11.1.13.a.d: तूष्णीं गर्दभस्यादाय युञ्जाथाम्̐ रासभं युवम् इति गर्दभम् ॥
11.1.13.a.m: Silently taking [the halter] of the donkey, [he halters] the donkey with 'Yoke the donkey, you two.'

11.1.14.a.s: yogeyoge tavastaram iti tisṛbhir aśvaprathamāḥ prāñco gacchanti yatra mṛdaṃ khaniṣyanto bhavanti //
11.1.14.a.d: योगेयोगे तवस्तरम् इति तिसृभिर् अश्वप्रथमाः प्राञ्चो गच्छन्ति यत्र मृदं खनिष्यन्तो भवन्ति ॥
11.1.14.a.m: With the three verses beginning 'In every yoke more mighty,' with the horse leading, they go eastward to where they are about to dig the earth.

11.1.15.a.s: agniṃ purīṣyam aṅgirasvad acchehi \\ iti yena dveṣyeṇa saṃgaccheta tam abhimantrayetāpaśyan nirdiśati //
11.1.15.a.d: अग्निं पुरीष्यम् अङ्गिरस्वद् अच्छेहि \\ इति येन द्वेष्येण संगच्छेत तम् अभिमन्त्रयेतापश्यन् निर्दिशति ॥
11.1.15.a.m: If he should encounter anyone whom he hates, he should address him, or point without looking [at him], with: 'Go for Agni Purīṣya, like Aṅgiras.'

11.1.16.a.s: agniṃ purīṣyam aṅgirasvad acchemas \\ iti vā //
11.1.16.a.d: अग्निं पुरीष्यम् अङ्गिरस्वद् अच्छेमस् \\ इति वा ॥
11.1.16.a.m: Or with: 'We go for Agni Purīṣya, like Aṅgiras.'

11.1.17.a.s: sūryasyodayanaṃ prati valmīkavapām upatiṣṭhate \\ agniṃ purīṣyam aṅgirasvad bhariṣyāmas \\ iti //
11.1.17.a.d: सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति वल्मीकवपाम् उपतिष्ठते \\ अग्निं पुरीष्यम् अङ्गिरस्वद् भरिष्यामस् \\ इति ॥
11.1.17.a.m: Facing the sunrise, he stands before the anthill with: 'We shall bring Agni Purīṣya, like Aṅgiras.'

11.1.18.a.s: atraike samāmananti ( agniṃ purīṣyam aṅgirasvad bharāmaḥ ) //
11.1.18.a.d: अत्रैके समामनन्ति ( अग्निं पुरीष्यम् अङ्गिरस्वद् भरामः ) ॥
11.1.18.a.m: Here some recite: 'We bring Agni Purīṣya, like Aṅgiras.'

11.1.19.a.s: anv agnir uṣasām agram akhyat \\ iti valmīkavapāyāḥ prakrāmati //
11.1.19.a.d: अन्व् अग्निर् उषसाम् अग्रम् अख्यत् \\ इति वल्मीकवपायाः प्रक्रामति ॥
11.1.19.a.m: With 'Agni has looked along the front of the dawns,' he steps away from the anthill.

11.1.20.a.s: āgatya vājy adhvanas \\ ākramya vājin pṛthivīm iti dvābhyāṃ mṛtkhanam aśvam ākramayati //
11.1.20.a.d: आगत्य वाज्य् अध्वनस् \\ आक्रम्य वाजिन् पृथिवीम् इति द्वाभ्यां मृत्खनम् अश्वम् आक्रमयति ॥
11.1.20.a.m: With the two verses, 'The courser having come from the road' and 'Stepping upon the earth, O courser,' he makes the horse step on the clay pit.

11.1.21.a.s: dyaus te pṛṣṭham ity aśvasya pṛṣṭham̐ saṃmārṣṭi //
11.1.21.a.d: द्यौस् ते पृष्ठम् इत्य् अश्वस्य पृष्ठम्̐ संमार्ष्टि ॥
11.1.21.a.m: With 'Heaven is thy back,' he wipes the horse's back.

11.1.22.a.s: abhitiṣṭha pṛtanyatas \\ adhare santu śatravaḥ / \ indra iva vṛtrahā tiṣṭha \\ apaḥ kṣetrāṇi saṃjayan \\ iti yaṃ dveṣṭi tam adhas padam aśvasya manasā dhyāyati /
11.1.22.a.d: अभितिष्ठ पृतन्यतस् \\ अधरे सन्तु शत्रवः । \ इन्द्र इव वृत्रहा तिष्ठ \\ अपः क्षेत्राणि संजयन् \\ इति यं द्वेष्टि तम् अधस् पदम् अश्वस्य मनसा ध्यायति ।
11.1.22.a.m: With 'Step upon the attackers; let the enemies be below; stand like Indra slaying Vṛtra, winning waters and fields,' he contemplates in his mind the one whom he hates under the horse's foot.

11.1.23.a.s: utkrāma \\ udakramīt \\ iti dvābhyāṃ mṛtkhanād aśvam utkramayanti //
11.1.23.a.d: उत्क्राम \\ उदक्रमीत् \\ इति द्वाभ्यां मृत्खनाद् अश्वम् उत्क्रमयन्ति ॥
11.1.23.a.m: With the two mantras, 'Step out!' and 'He has stepped out,' they lead the horse out of the clay pit.

11.1.24.a.s: apo devīr upasṛja \\ ity aśvasya pade 'pa upasṛjati //
11.1.24.a.d: अपो देवीर् उपसृज \\ इत्य् अश्वस्य पदे ऽप उपसृजति ॥
11.1.24.a.m: With 'Pour out the divine waters,' he pours water onto the horse's footprint.

11.1.25.a.s: tasmin hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya jigharmy agnim \ ā tvā jigharmi \\ iti manasvatībhyām ekām āhutiṃ juhoti //
11.1.25.a.d: तस्मिन् हिरण्यं निधाय जिघर्म्य् अग्निम् \ आ त्वा जिघर्मि \\ इति मनस्वतीभ्याम् एकाम् आहुतिं जुहोति ॥
11.1.25.a.m: Having placed gold upon it, he offers a single oblation with the two manasvatī verses beginning 'I sprinkle Agni' and 'I sprinkle thee.'

11.1.26.a.s: apādāya hiraṇyam \\ pari vājapatis \\ iti tisṛbhir abhryā mṛtkhanaṃ parilikhati ( bāhyāṃ varṣīyasīm ) //
11.1.26.a.d: अपादाय हिरण्यम् \\ परि वाजपतिस् \\ इति तिसृभिर् अभ्र्या मृत्खनं परिलिखति ( बाह्यां वर्षीयसीम् ) ॥
11.1.26.a.m: Having removed the gold, he traces around the clay pit with the spade using the three verses beginning 'Around the lord of food,' [making the outer line wider].

11.1.27.a.m: With the two verses beginning 'At the impulse of the god Savitṛ,' he digs.

11.1.28.a.s: apāṃ pṛṣṭham asi \\ iti puṣkaraparṇam āharati / etayaiva viveṣṭayati / upariṣṭāt kṛṣṇājinam uttareṇa mṛtkhanam \\ śarma ca stho varma ca sthas \\ iti // dvābhyāṃ prācīnagrīvam uttaralomāstṛṇāty uttaraṃ puṣkaraparṇam adhastāddaṇḍam uttānam //
11.1.28.a.d: अपां पृष्ठम् असि \\ इति पुष्करपर्णम् आहरति । एतयैव विवेष्टयति । उपरिष्टात् कृष्णाजिनम् उत्तरेण मृत्खनम् \\ शर्म च स्थो वर्म च स्थस् \\ इति ॥ द्वाभ्यां प्राचीनग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमास्तृणात्य् उत्तरं पुष्करपर्णम् अधस्ताद्दण्डम् उत्तानम् ॥
11.1.28.a.m: With: "You are the back of the waters..." he brings a lotus-leaf. With this very [formula] he wraps it. He spreads a black-antelope skin on top, north of the clay-pit, with the two [formulas]: "You two are protection, and you two are armor...", with the neck pointing east and the hair upward, and [upon it] the lotus-leaf with its stalk underneath and turned upward.

11.1.29.a.d: पुरीष्यो ऽसि विश्वभरास् \\ इति मृदम् अभिमृश्य ॥
11.1.29.a.m: Having touched the clay with: "You are earthy, all-supporting..."

11.1.30.a.s: kṛṣṇājine puṣkaraparṇe ca saṃbharati tvām agne puṣkarād adhi \\ iti tisṛbhir gāyatrībhir brāhmaṇasya / uttarābhis triṣṭugbhī rājanyasya jagatībhir vaiśyasya //
11.1.30.a.d: कृष्णाजिने पुष्करपर्णे च संभरति त्वाम् अग्ने पुष्कराद् अधि \\ इति तिसृभिर् गायत्रीभिर् ब्राह्मणस्य । उत्तराभिस् त्रिष्टुग्भी राजन्यस्य जगतीभिर् वैश्यस्य ॥
11.1.30.a.m: he collects [it] upon the black-antelope skin and lotus-leaf with the three Gāyatrī verses beginning: "You, O Agni, from the lotus..." for a brāhmaṇa, with the following Triṣṭubh verses for a rājanya, and with Jagatī verses for a vaiśya.

11.1.31.a.s: yaṃ kāmayeta vasīyānt syād ity ubhayībhis tasya saṃbharet / gāyatrībhiś ca triṣṭugbhiś ca //
11.1.31.a.d: यं कामयेत वसीयान्त् स्याद् इत्य् उभयीभिस् तस्य संभरेत् । गायत्रीभिश् च त्रिष्टुग्भिश् च ॥
11.1.31.a.m: For him whom he desires, 'May he become wealthier,' he should collect it with both—with the Gāyatrī and with the Triṣṭubh verses.

11.1.32.a.s: janiṣvā hi jenyas \\ iti saṃbhṛtām abhimantrayate //
11.1.32.a.d: जनिष्वा हि जेन्यस् \\ इति संभृताम् अभिमन्त्रयते ॥
11.1.32.a.m: With: "Be born, indeed, as noble..." he recites over the collected [clay].

11.1.33.a.s: saṃ te vāyur mātariśvā dadhātu \\ iti mṛtkhane 'pa upasṛjati //
11.1.33.a.d: सं ते वायुर् मातरिश्वा दधातु \\ इति मृत्खने ऽप उपसृजति ॥
11.1.33.a.m: With: "May Vāyu Mātariśvan unite you..." he pours water into the clay-pit.

11.1.34.a.s: saṃlobhya mṛtkhanam̐ samudgṛhya kṛṣṇājinasyātnān sujāto jyotiṣā saha \\ iti mauñjenārkamayeṇa vā trivṛtā dāmnopanahyati //
11.1.34.a.d: संलोभ्य मृत्खनम्̐ समुद्गृह्य कृष्णाजिनस्यात्नान् सुजातो ज्योतिषा सह \\ इति मौञ्जेनार्कमयेण वा त्रिवृता दाम्नोपनह्यति ॥
11.1.34.a.m: Having blended [the earth in] the pit where clay was dug and seized the corners of the black antelope skin, he ties it up with a triple-stranded cord of muñja grass or arka fiber, with the mantra: 'Well-born together with light...'

11.1.35.a.s: ud u tiṣṭha svadhvarā \\ iti dvābhyām uttiṣṭhati //
11.1.35.a.d: उद् उ तिष्ठ स्वध्वरा \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् उत्तिष्ठति ॥
11.1.35.a.m: He stands up with the two [verses]: 'Arise, O thou who hast good sacrifices...'

11.1.36.a.s: sa jāto garbho asi rodasyos \\ iti harati //
11.1.36.a.d: स जातो गर्भो असि रोदस्योस् \\ इति हरति ॥
11.1.36.a.m: He carries it, with [the mantra]: 'Born art thou, the embryo of heaven and earth...'

11.1.37.a.s: sthiro bhava vīḍvaṅgas \\ iti gardabhasya pṛṣṭha āsādayati //
11.1.37.a.d: स्थिरो भव वीड्वङ्गस् \\ इति गर्दभस्य पृष्ठ आसादयति ॥
11.1.37.a.m: He places it on the back of the donkey, with: 'Be firm, strong-limbed...'

11.1.38.a.s: śivo bhava prajābhyas \\ ity āsannam abhimantrayate //
11.1.38.a.d: शिवो भव प्रजाभ्यस् \\ इत्य् आसन्नम् अभिमन्त्रयते ॥
11.1.38.a.m: He addresses it once set down, with: 'Be auspicious to offspring...'

11.1.39.a.s: praitu vājī kanikradat \\ iti tisṛbhir atvaramāṇā aśvaprathamāḥ pratyāyanti //
11.1.39.a.d: प्रैतु वाजी कनिक्रदत् \\ इति तिसृभिर् अत्वरमाणा अश्वप्रथमाः प्रत्यायन्ति ॥
11.1.39.a.m: Without hurrying, with the horse foremost, they return with the three [verses]: 'May the steed go forward neighing...'

11.1.40.a.s: agniṃ purīṣyam aṅgirasvad bharāmas \\ iti yena dveṣyeṇa saṃgaccheta tam abhimantrayetāpaśyan nirdiśati //
11.1.40.a.d: अग्निं पुरीष्यम् अङ्गिरस्वद् भरामस् \\ इति येन द्वेष्येण संगच्छेत तम् अभिमन्त्रयेतापश्यन् निर्दिशति ॥
11.1.40.a.m: With the mantra: 'We bear the earthy Agni, like the Aṅgirases...', if he should encounter anyone hateful, he should address him, or without looking [at him], he indicates [him].

11.1.41.a.s: uttareṇa vihāraṃ pariśrite \\ oṣadhayaḥ pratigṛhṇītāgnim etam iti dvābhyām oṣadhīṣu puṣpavatīṣu phalavatīṣūpāvaharati //
11.1.41.a.d: उत्तरेण विहारं परिश्रिते \\ ओषधयः प्रतिगृह्णीताग्निम् एतम् इति द्वाभ्याम् ओषधीषु पुष्पवतीषु फलवतीषूपावहरति ॥
11.1.41.a.m: To the north of the sacrificial area, in an enclosed space, he brings it down upon plants possessing flowers and fruit, with the two [verses]: 'O plants, receive this Agni...'

11.1.42.a.m: He unties it with: 'Wide with radiance...'

11.1.43.a.s: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvas \\ iti tisṛbhir apa upasṛjati //
11.1.43.a.d: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस् \\ इति तिसृभिर् अप उपसृजति ॥
11.1.43.a.m: He pours water upon it with the three [verses]: 'You, Waters, are indeed healing...'

11.1.44.a.s: mitraḥ sam̐sṛjya pṛthivīm iti dvābhyāṃ sam̐sarjanīyaiḥ sam̐sṛjati // armakapālair veṇvaṅgārair vrīhituṣaiḥ palāśakaṣāyaiś ca śarkarābhiḥ piṣṭābhiḥ kṛṣṇājinalomabhir ajalomabhir yac cānyad dṛḍhārtham upārthaṃ manyate //
11.1.44.a.d: मित्रः सम्̐सृज्य पृथिवीम् इति द्वाभ्यां सम्̐सर्जनीयैः सम्̐सृजति ॥ अर्मकपालैर् वेण्वङ्गारैर् व्रीहितुषैः पलाशकषायैश् च शर्कराभिः पिष्टाभिः कृष्णाजिनलोमभिर् अजलोमभिर् यच् चान्यद् दृढार्थम् उपार्थं मन्यते ॥
11.1.44.a.m: With the two verses: 'Mitra, having mixed the earth...', he mixes [the clay] with the mixing materials: potsherds from an abandoned site, bamboo charcoal, rice husks, decoction of palāśa bark, crushed gravel, hair from a black antelope skin, goat's hair, and whatever else he considers suitable for firmness and useful.
